title: SUPPLY TECHNICIAN (TITLE 5)
description:
This National Guard position is for a SUPPLY TECHNICIAN (TITLE 5), Position Description Number T5278000 and is part of the FL USPFO, National Guard.

As a Supply Technician, GS-2005-07 you will analyzes possible redistribution of equipment through transfer, loan or assignment. Reviews and processes external as well as internal loans/leases that may impact readiness or mission requirements. Processes and accounts for through agency coordination the in coming and outgoing federal property assignment. Processes and tracks equipment changes in Modified Table of Organization and Equipment (MTOE) or Table of Distribution and Allowance (TDA). Process electronic requests for TDA and MTOE changes through NGB to DA to achieve the actual Letter of Authorization (LOA). Reviews and requests LOA for Discretionary items, Commercial non-Standard items, Common Table of Allowance (CTA) items, and non-Property Book Unit Supply Enhanced (PBUSE) system. Monitors and maintains tracking and accountability of all Rapid Fielding Initiatives within the state or unit of assignment. Reviews all commercial requests for property, Procurement Web (PR WEB), Delivery Orders for authorizations. Performs extensive fact finding, investigating and recommends corrective action to resolve problems. Coordinates with Force Integration Readiness Officer and establishes a suspense file for equipment authorizations awaiting MTOE/TDA/CTA changes. Manages receipt documents for the Total Package Fielding, Rapid Fielding Initiative and Special Procured federal property from any source.

title: Client Relations Representative - Fort Lauderdale
description:
POSITION: Client Relations Representative

Location: Fort Lauderdale, HQ | Full-time onsite + Travel

FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt


Who We Are

At Retirement Income Source, a Sound Income Group company, we empower clients through education-driven financial planning. Our seven-step process helps avoid common retirement pitfalls while aligning strategies with long-term goals. We believe peace of mind comes from understanding your options and making informed decisions with a trusted advisor.


Position Summary

This is a sales-focused client relationship and business development role, not a traditional administrative support position.


The Client Relations Representative (CRR) serves as the first point of contact for prospective and existing clients while driving appointment generation, supporting advisor growth initiatives, and creating an exceptional client experience. This role is responsible for converting warm leads into qualified appointments, executing marketing events, supporting new client onboarding, and maintaining consistent outreach activity that contributes directly to advisor production and firm growth.


Success in this role is measured through appointment generation, client engagement, event execution, outreach activity, and overall contribution to advisor and business growth.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Development & Appointment Setting

Approximately 70% of this role is phone-based client outreach and relationship-building activity.

  • Conduct outbound follow-up with workshop attendees, seminar leads, marketing inquiries, referrals, and existing clients.
  • Generate and schedule qualified appointments for Advisors.
  • Re-engage inactive prospects, dormant leads, and appointment no-shows.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up cadences until prospects are booked, declined, or disqualified.
  • Build rapport and establish trust through professional, consultative conversations.
  • Accurately document all client interactions and activity within CRM systems.
  • Track and report key performance metrics, including outreach volume, appointments scheduled, kept appointments, and conversion outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Advisors to identify opportunities for increased client engagement and business development.

Marketing & Event Execution

In partnership with Advisors and the Marketing team:

  • Support the planning and execution of workshops, seminars, client appreciation events, and community outreach initiatives.
  • Coordinate event logistics, including venue communication, RSVPs, attendee tracking, room setup, and marketing collateral.
  • Assist with attendee registration, check-in, and event-day support.
  • Conduct same-day or next-day follow-up with attendees and no-shows to maximize appointment conversion opportunities.
  • Represent the firm professionally at public-facing events and engage with prospective clients.
  • Provide event feedback, attendance reporting, and recommendations for improving event effectiveness and return on investment.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate client records and CRM data integrity.
  • Monitor and report on outreach activity and performance metrics to support business objectives.
  • Partner with Advisors and internal teams to ensure seamless client experiences.
  • Demonstrate accountability for individual performance goals and team success.

title: Client Partner (Dubai)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Client Partner to join SpaceXSI's world-class team of media professionals. As part of X Ads Sales MENA team you will drive revenue growth by building strong relationships with Fortune 500 companies and their advertising agencies. In this role, you will create impactful, consultative sales strategies to showcase advertising products, helping advertisers connect with consumers and achieve their marketing goals. Ideal candidates are passionate about SpaceXSI's mission to preserve free expression and choice, thrive in collaborative environments, and bring a deep understanding of the social media landscape to fuel innovative advertising solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Establish and nurture collaborative business relationships with top MENA advertisers, as well as their marketing agencies.
  • Develop consultative sales presentations to demonstrate how our advertising products can be leveraged to effectively engage consumers.
  • Partner with advertisers to build and execute high-impact campaigns, measure performance, and drive renewals and upselling opportunities to fuel revenue growth.
  • Stay at the forefront of thought leadership by immersing yourself in the evolving social media landscape and adapting to X's ongoing product developments.
  • Mentor new team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture as the organization grows

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of experience in digital media sales, working with top MENA enterprises.
  • Established relationships with marketing decision-makers at companies and agencies.
  • Proven track record of developing and growing a book of business.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.
  • Deep understanding of X, the social media landscape, and opportunities for marketers to leverage these platforms.
  • Expect to travel to Saudi and other GCC countries at least 5 days each month.
  • Experience with other tech platforms preferred.
  • Experience in Tech, Telco and Auto preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Fluency in English and Arabic is a must as it is required to deal with stakeholders based in Saudi.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role

Senior engineer who ships production software and AI systems on cloud infrastructure that is reliable, secure, and cost-disciplined. You design applications and services, operate inference platforms and pipelines, and treat unit economics (tokens, GPU-hours, idle capacity) as engineering constraints.

You partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver working software, higher reliability, and lower cost per unit of AI value.

What You Will Do

Software development

  • Design, build, and ship production services, APIs, and (where needed) user-facing interfaces.
  • Own the full lifecycle: implementation, tests, code review, CI/CD, deploy, and maintenance.
  • Write maintainable code in Python plus one more stack (TypeScript/Node, Go, or Java).

AI engineering

  • Build and operate production AI systems: RAG, evaluation, fine-tuning, serving, and inference optimization.
  • Turn prototypes into reusable platform capabilities with CI/CD, eval, and governance.

Cloud infrastructure

  • Architect AWS/GCP environments with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD for apps and model pipelines.
  • Own observability and incident response; partner on SOC 2/SOX and least-privilege IAM.

Cost control

  • Treat cloud and AI spend as an engineering problem: visibility, attribution, budgets, and reduction.
  • Optimize GPUs, inference routing, model choice, and right-sizing; track cost per request/token and GPU idle.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of professional software development, owning production systems (not only scripts or notebooks).
  • Shipped backend services/APIs and production AI/ML (LLMs, RAG, serving).
  • Strong Python plus a second stack; PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent serving.
  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD.
  • Proven work reducing or governing cloud/AI spend.
  • Clear communication of technical and cost tradeoffs; you run what you build.

Preferred

  • Full-stack (React/Next.js), vector databases, inference optimization, FinOps tooling, SOX/SOC 2, Copilot/Cursor.

What Success Looks Like

  • Production software and AI with SLOs and real ownership — not demos.
  • Reliability stays high while GPU and cloud waste trends down.
  • Cost per unit of AI value is visible and improving; teams reuse libraries, IaC, and cost guardrails.

Pay Transparency

Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the compensation range is:

Canada
$137,000—$165,000 CAD

title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis and Capital Investment - International Division
description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

Join our team!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Director FP&A and Capital Investment is a key member of the company’s finance team and is responsible for supporting all financial planning and analysis activities across the International Division of Top Aces Inc. The director will be responsible for the division’s annual budget process, financial forecasting, financial strategic planning and business performance analysis activities. Additionally, the director will be responsible for supporting the effort to enhance the company’s continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving profitability and efficiency. The director will provide project financial support, return on investment (ROI) analysis along with KPI development, measurement and analysis. The successful candidate will have demonstrable leadership competencies, strong attention to detail, and will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment. The candidate will demonstrate a successful track record of working collaboratively in a dynamic environment and a matrix organizational structure.

  • Own the division’s annual budgeting and financial planning process (quarterly forecasts and strategic plan 5-year forecast) and review all associated financial plans and budgets.
  • Develop, lead, and manage core FP&A activities.
    • Lead the development of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow forecasts and partner with internal stakeholders to optimize working capital (prepayments, inventory) and cash flow generation.
    • Lead the development of scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and risks & opportunities.
  • Oversee capex financial management and capex forecasting improvement initiatives.
  • Lead inventory financial management and work with key stakeholders to optimize the level of inventory.
  • Oversee the preparation of the International Division monthly management accounts, FP&A reports and dashboards, including presentations to SLT and the company’s Board of Directors.
  • Support the division’s Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to evaluate and review new business and investment opportunities, including new business pricing, client Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), payback period and return on capital (RONA) analyses.
  • Support the executive team decision-making by providing insightful data and analysis with the objective of improving Top Aces’ profitability and efficiency.
  • Build and develop the skill sets of finance professionals under her/his direction.

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required with concentration in finance and/or accounting or comparable business field preferred.
  • CPA and/or MBA preferred
  • 10-15 years of experience in relevant accounting, or financial leadership roles.
  • Significant expertise with data analysis and reporting.
  • Ability to handle multiple assignments on a timely basis with a high degree of accuracy.
  • High level of motivation and aptitude for problem solving, with a strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as strategic thinking to effectively interface with external stakeholders and the division’s Senior Leadership Team.
  • Ability to translate financial data into strategic insights.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, possessing a high sense of urgency.
  • Ability to perform all work in support of our Corporate Values of Excellence, Service, Integrity … Together.

Working Conditions:

  • May be required to travel from time to time
  • May be required to work overtime or longer hours when Top Aces Requires

Supervisory, Training and Advisory Responsibilities:

  • May be required to provide regular guidance, advice and training, as requested by the supervisor, to other employees supporting the function.

Occupational Health and Safety:

Employees are responsible for:

  • Working in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety acts and regulations
  • Following safe work practices and procedures and using safeguards and personal protective equipment
  • Reporting hazards (such as unsafe situations and activities) to their supervisor immediately.

Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:

Position requires Level II clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program

By joining Top Aces, you will find:

  • A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
  • Opportunities for development and growth;
  • Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
  • A flexible schedule;
  • Attractive benefit plan.

Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.


Equal Employment Opportunity

At Top Aces, all employees are welcome regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability or age. The masculine form may be used in this job description solely for ease of reading but refers to men, women and gender diversity.

title: MILITARY & FAMILY READINESS SPECIALIST-TITLE 5
description:
THIS IS A NATIONAL GUARD TITLE 5 EXCEPTED SERVICE POSITION. This National Guard position is for a MILITARY & FAMILY READINESS SPECIALIST-TITLE 5, Position Description Number PDT57014P1 and is part of the KY J1, National Guard. ** NOTE: Indefinite employment is temporary and is expected to last more than one year but no more than five consecutive years. This appointment will not exceed 01 NOV 2031 and will not be extended without further competition.

As a MILITARY & FAMILY READINESS SPECIALIST-TITLE 5, GS-0301-9, you will serve as an independent advisor in accomplishing all objectives of the Soldier & Family Readiness Program (SFRP) for the Army National Guard. Provide input to develop, articulate, and implement the Family Readiness Program at the State level, inclusive of family readiness, family assistance, employment outreach, volunteer training and management and improvement of quality of life and well-being of Service members and families. Ensure accurate and timely input into the NGB-approved system of record for all applicable Service Members and Family case information, unit support, community outreach, training provision, volunteer management and other Family Program data. Conduct briefings at the local, unit and state levels to provide necessary information to leadership, commanders, Soldiers, Families, Soldier and Family Readiness Groups (SFRGs) and community partners. Provide support during 24/7 EFAC operations, Yellow Ribbon Reintegration activities, Recruit Sustainment Program activities, drill and annual training periods. Provide training and technical support to Commanders and Family Readiness Liaisons to support their Unit Family Readiness program, Soldier/Family Readiness Groups (SFRGs), and volunteers. Assist higher headquarters in planning and coordinating resources for family assistance at deployment cycle support and steady-state readiness activities. title: Insurance Specialist
description:
This position serves as an Insurance Specialist within the Policy Maintenance Center of the Veterans Benefits Administration's Insurance Service, Department of Veterans Affairs. The Insurance Service & Operations Center provides insurance products and services to Veterans, Service members, and military families, honoring the Nation's heroes by offering policyholders peace of mind and beneficiaries financial security.

Reviews work items, suspense payment actions, and out of balance policies. Assesses policy billing, transaction history, liabilities, and funds in suspense. Conducts complex policy and loan audits and calculates complex refund actions to determine appropriate allocation of funds on a policy to bring the account current, to resolve or establish indebtedness. Completes system actions and, when applicable calculates, interest prior to releasing a payment, establishing a lien, or developing to recoup funds. Responsible for processing returned payments, completing research and development to locate payees and proper application of funds. Prepares and releases correspondence to customers which explain policy actions and money due or owed. Conducts research and development of information into missing government checks initiated by the Department of Veterans Affairs Insurance program regarding inquiries to the Treasury Department. Initiates status of checks through the TCIS (Treasury Check Information System) to determine the status of funds available and refund the available funds. If funds are determined to be unavailable, the incumbent determines whether fraudulent activity or an incorrect payee was involved. Research, contacts and interacts with the Veteran and the Check Claims Department of the Treasury. If an incorrect payee is involved, the incumbent initiates recovery of funds. Coordinates with peers and supervisors throughout the workday to resolve complex policy issues and ensure timely completion of priority workload. Responsible for processing loan and cash surrenders actions, processing underwriting applications such as reinstatements and conversions, and overdue dividend payments. Receives control listings to be reviewed, suspense payment lists, suspended accounts list, billing alter policies, which are audited and corrected. Reviews and adjusts policies regarding Allotment and Deduction from Benefit billing payment, correcting the policy balance and paid to information. This includes, but is not limited to, disbursement of dividends held on account, reinstatement of lapsed insurance, calculating monetary requirements for reinstatements of lapsed or automatically surrendered insurance, auditing years of activity (premiums and loans), and missing check processing.

title: Guest Arrival Expert
description:

First impressions are everything. When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable. The same goes for departures. When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay. We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.. Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. title: Section Chief
company: Office of the Assistant Secretary for Administration and Management
description:
The Office of the Assistant Secretary for Administration and Management (OASAM) provides the infrastructure and support that enables the U.S. Department of Labor to perform its mission. OASAM provides leadership and support for information technology, human resources management, procurement, business operations, safety and health, space management, civil rights, emergency management, security, budget, and performance.

There is one vacancy available. The position may be located in any of the following cities: Washington, DC; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; New York City, NY; Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX; Philadelphia, PA; or San Francisco, CA. For detailed office locations, please visit: DOL offices. This position is in the Division of Compensation and Processing (DCP) within the Office of Human Resources (OHR), OASAM. The employee serves as a section chief and first-line supervisor, responsible for planning, directing, organizing, and overseeing the work of assigned staff performing duties that include, but are not limited to, the following: Lead a section of the division by planning and organizing the work of HR staff, setting and adjusting short and long term priorities, providing advice and technical direction to staff, and monitoring performance. Apply knowledge of HR systems, forms, action codes, and personnel action processing to interpret HR regulations, use technical processing methods, and ensure accurate and compliant personnel actions across multiple hiring and pay systems. Analyze technical HR problems and propose resolutions, workflow improvements, or corrective measures that improve the quality and compliance of personnel action processing. Plan and execute audits of personnel actions to identify error trends, evaluate workflow effectiveness, and use findings to develop targeted training and corrective strategies for HR staff. Lead the planning, execution, and monitoring of department-wide projects by establishing milestones, directing team activities, assessing progress, and recommending new policies or procedures that improve program efficiency and effectiveness. Provide training, coaching, and support to HR staff, supervisors, and employees to build understanding of HR processes, resolve issues, and improve the quality and responsiveness of services. Review personnel action data, identify discrepancies, and coordinate with customers to obtain required information, ensuring records are complete, accurate, and aligned with service expectations. Prepare written documents such as training materials, job aids, reports, policy recommendations and briefing materials that convey technical HR information. Represent the agency and division in meetings, briefings, and conferences by presenting program information, summarizing assessments, and communicating recommendations to stakeholders.

title: Product Owner
description:
The Product Owner is responsible for translating product strategy into a well-defined, executable backlog and guiding delivery through strong scrum practices. This role partners closely with engineering, design, QA, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and operations to ensure priorities are clear, defects are managed effectively, releases are communicated well, and delivered capabilities align to customer and business needs. The Product Owner is expected to bring strong judgment, disciplined prioritization, attention to delivery quality, and the ability to keep teams aligned on scope, progress, and outcomes.

What You Will Do:

  • Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria are clear, prioritized, and aligned to product strategy, customer needs, and company goals.
  • Lead scrum practices for the team, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily collaboration, sprint reviews, and retrospectives in partnership with engineering and scrum team members.
  • Partner with engineering, design, QA, and stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable requirements, sequencing work to maximize value delivery and team focus.
  • Make day-to-day prioritization decisions across new feature development, technical enablers, customer commitments, and production issues, balancing business value, urgency, and feasibility.
  • Drive defect management processes, including triage, prioritization, root-cause follow-up, and communication on severity, impact, and resolution status.
  • Support release planning and readiness by coordinating scope, validating completion against acceptance criteria, and ensuring clear communication of release content, timing, risks, and downstream impacts.
  • Serve as the primary point of clarity for the delivery team by answering requirement questions, removing ambiguity, and helping the team make timely decisions during the sprint.
  • Use product, operational, and customer feedback data to inform backlog priorities, continuous improvement opportunities, and post-release adjustments.
  • Communicate sprint progress, backlog tradeoffs, release updates, and delivery risks clearly to stakeholders across product, technology, and business teams.
  • Help strengthen team ways of working by improving backlog hygiene, sprint predictability, release discipline, and cross-functional coordination.

What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or a related role supporting agile software delivery, preferably in a B2B environment.
  • Hands-on experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining acceptance criteria for delivery teams.
  • Working knowledge of scrum practices and experience participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Experience coordinating defect triage and resolution processes in partnership with engineering and QA teams.
  • Experience supporting release planning, release readiness, and stakeholder communications for software deployments.
  • Ability to evaluate competing priorities using customer impact, business value, technical constraints, and delivery risk.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong understanding of agile delivery principles and the ability to maintain a healthy, value-driven backlog.
  • Ability to break down complex initiatives into clear stories, define done criteria, and support consistent sprint execution.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering and QA to manage defects, production issues, and release quality.
  • Comfort communicating release scope, sprint outcomes, dependencies, and risks to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through across multiple workstreams and timelines.
  • Experience helping teams improve delivery processes, backlog discipline, or scrum maturity is a plus.

Success in This Role

Success in this role is measured by the ability to keep the team focused on the highest-value work, maintain a clear and actionable backlog, support predictable sprint execution, manage defects with urgency and discipline, and communicate releases effectively to stakeholders. Success also includes improving delivery quality, strengthening scrum practices, and ensuring the team consistently delivers outcomes that meet customer and business expectations.

The Perks of Working at Fusable:

We believe in taking care of our team. Fusable provides a comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k)-retirement plan; paid time off; paid holidays; and life and disability insurance. Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan terms. A complete description of compensation, incentive opportunities, and benefits will be provided to qualified applicants during the hiring process.

Every team member also enjoys:

  • Flexible work schedules
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • 13 Paid Company holiday observances
  • Remote work opportunities
  • A casual dress work environment
  • Physical fitness reimbursement
  • Discounts on various events, travel, and dining

Equal Employment Opportunity

Fusable is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all employment practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, age, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by law.

Disclaimer:

Fusable is committed to equitable compensation practices and complies with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. For jurisdictions that require pay scale disclosure, a general compensation range may be provided during the initial stages of the interview process. Final compensation will be based on multiple factors including experience, skills, certifications, and overall fit for the role.

Pay Transparency:

$115,000 to $145,000 annually

The base salary or hourly range listed above represents the good faith estimate of the compensation Fusable reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire. title: Team Lead - Electron Vehicle Development
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Electron Vehicle Development team owns the structures, mechanisms, and fluids systems that make Electron fly. The team generates, analyses, and implements new designs and design improvements across the vehicle, working closely with Production, Program Management, and the wider Electron Engineering group to make every vehicle better, cheaper, and lower risk than the last.

As Team Lead, you'll lead a team of Vehicle Development Engineers and deliver engineering projects that meet requirements, on time and with the right level of engineering rigour. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set priorities, unblock your team, make the risk/reward calls, and act as deputy to the Electron Engineering Manager whenever needed.

YOU'LL GET TO:

Own & Ship

  • Lead day-to-day delivery of vehicle engineering projects across structures, mechanisms, and fluids systems
  • Act as subject matter expert and quality approver for all engineering change within the Vehicle Development team
  • Contribute to design reviews, ensuring workflows, processes, and products meet internal and external standards and best practice
  • Drive right-first-time GD&T and a lean, efficient approach to project management

Solve & Fix

  • Quickly analyse and resolve manufacturing discrepancies and non-conformances
  • Drive down quality defects and time lost to non-conformances caused by vehicle system design
  • Assess risk before it happens, put mitigations in place, and verify they hold for future vehicles
  • Make risk/reward trade calls using engineering, program, and production input to protect both the rocket and the business

Lead & Scale

  • Lead risk reduction, cost saving, performance improvement, and engineer-to-order projects across team boundaries
  • Prioritise competing development projects to get the best outcomes for the business and deliver team and department AOPs
  • Act as the interface between Program Management and Production so vehicle configuration requirements are delivered on time
  • Build and refine the team's strategic plan, aligned with management and business goals

Grow & Deliver

  • Lead, motivate, and develop your team, including building performance management plans and improving poor performance
  • Coach engineers on technical best practice, lean project management, and how to deliver a positive return on investment
  • Identify single points of failure in the team and remove them through cross-training and developing capable deputies
  • Give the wider business clear visibility of status, blockers, and the decisions needed to move forward

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

CORE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in aerospace, mechanical, or mechatronic engineering, or an equivalent qualification
  • 5+ years developing, testing, or analysing mechanical systems
  • Strong technical ability in at least one domain of mechanical engineering: materials, structures, mechanisms, or fluids and pneumatics systems
  • A strong understanding of signal acquisition and measurement, including error and accuracy
  • Sound analytical skills and the ability to think at a systems level
  • Good hands-on engineering skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to clearly convey your understanding to others
  • A strong leader with a proven ability to deliver results

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience leading and developing a team of engineers
  • Experience as quality approver or SME for engineering change
  • Strong GD&T knowledge and a track record of right-first-time design
  • Experience resolving non-conformances in a production environment
  • Experience leading cost saving initiatives with a measurable return
  • Experience building strategic plans and presenting metrics that steer business decisions
  • A track record of driving cross-functional projects and resolving conflict through influence and communication

EXPECTATIONS:

  • Ownership mentality: you take responsibility for your team's decisions, attitude, and results
  • Thrive under pressure and tight deadlines, adapting quickly when priorities change
  • Balance speed with quality, moving quickly while maintaining appropriate rigour
  • No task is beneath you. Roll up your sleeves and do what's needed for mission success
  • A "How can I help?" mindset. Approachable, positive, and focused on making others better
  • Ready to step in as deputy for the Engineering Manager at any time, for any length of time
  • Domestic and international travel may be required

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

title: Director, Infrastructure Engineering
description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

As OneTrust scales its platform and expands globally, our infrastructure must keep pace — growing more automated, more resilient, and more self-service for the engineering teams that depend on it. Today, infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment work is distributed across the R&D organization without a single accountable owner driving strategy, standards, and automation maturity end to end.

We're looking for a Director, Infrastructure Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for the infrastructure our products run on — from cloud architecture and CI/CD pipelines to deployment automation and platform reliability. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the technical direction, build a high-performing team of DevOps and infrastructure automation engineers, and give every engineer at OneTrust faster, safer, more reliable ways to ship.

Your Mission

In this role, you will:

  • Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment automation across R&D, aligning investment with product and platform growth.
  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of DevOps engineers, infrastructure automation engineers, and deployment engineers, building a strong bench of technical talent across US and India.
  • Drive infrastructure-as-code (IaC) adoption and standards (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to make environment provisioning repeatable, auditable, and self-service for product engineering teams.
  • Own CI/CD pipeline architecture and tooling, reducing deployment friction and time-to-production while improving release reliability and rollback safety.
  • Set the strategy for multi-cloud/hybrid infrastructure management, container orchestration, and platform scalability to support current and future product growth.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to embed security guardrails, access controls, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO) directly into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Own infrastructure reliability and observability — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on-call practices — in partnership with Engineering and SRE stakeholders.
  • Lead cost optimization efforts across cloud spend, right-sizing infrastructure investment against usage and business need.
  • Act as the primary point of escalation and decision-maker for infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment-related incidents and cross-team dependencies.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership to represent infrastructure needs in roadmap planning and major technical decisions.
  • Evaluate and select tooling and vendor partnerships that support the team's automation-first, self-service infrastructure vision.

You Are

  • A builder who thinks in systems — you see infrastructure as a product that serves internal customers, not just a cost center to keep the lights on.
  • An automation-first leader who instinctively looks to eliminate manual, repeatable work and replace it with reliable, self-service tooling.
  • A calm, decisive operator under pressure — comfortable owning incident response and making fast, well-reasoned calls when systems are down.
  • A people leader who invests in growing engineers' technical depth and career paths, not just managing their day-to-day output.
  • A pragmatic communicator who can translate deep technical tradeoffs into business terms for non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  • Security- and compliance-minded by default, treating guardrails as part of good infrastructure design rather than a separate workstream.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, willing to make and revisit decisions as the organization and its infrastructure needs evolve.

Your Experience Includes

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or cloud operations, including 4+ years in a people leadership role.
  • Proven experience building and leading DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Deep hands-on background with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
  • Strong track record architecting and scaling CI/CD pipelines and release automation for enterprise-grade, high-availability software products.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, zero-downtime migrations).
  • Working knowledge of security, compliance, and regulatory frameworks relevant to SaaS infrastructure (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR).
  • Experience managing distributed or globally-located engineering teams (US/India or similar) preferred.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Security, and Product leadership to align infrastructure strategy with business priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

  • OneTrust Careers on YouTube

title: Analyst - Weekend - ENGLISH & GERMAN speaking
description:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.
Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.
Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

The role

As a Rapid Intelligence Analyst, you will be at the heart of international news coverage.

You will monitor political, economic and social developments, analyse national and international media sources, and identify the information that matters most to our clients.

Using modern media monitoring technology, you will research and assess news in real time, turning significant developments into short, accurate and easy-to-understand notifications known as Real-Time Alerts.

You will join an international team that helps leading companies and organisations stay informed about relevant events.

Duties and responsibilities

The role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

Monitor media and identify developments

  • Monitor national and international media to identify breaking news, emerging trends and significant developments.
  • Research traditional media, including print, online, radio and TV, as well as social media platforms.
  • Follow political, economic and social developments and assess their potential significance for our clients.

Analyse and assess information

  • Assess news for timeliness, relevance and significance to different audiences.
  • Distinguish important developments and critical events from less relevant information.
  • Verify information carefully to ensure clients receive accurate, reliable and relevant content.

Produce real-time alerts

  • Summarise complex issues quickly, accurately and clearly.
  • Produce professional Real-Time Alerts that keep clients informed of important developments as they happen.
  • Maintain high editorial standards, clear wording and content tailored to the target audience.

Collaborate internationally

  • Work closely with team members and colleagues around the world.
  • Communicate regularly with internal stakeholders to support the reliable delivery of our monitoring services.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of editorial processes and the quality of our information products.

Essential skills and experience

  • Excellent English skills (at least C1) and good German skills (at least B2).
  • A degree in media, communications, political science, social sciences, economics or a related field, or an equivalent qualification.
  • An interest in current political, economic and social developments, with a good understanding of international news.
  • The ability to understand complex information quickly, assess its relevance and summarise it clearly.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to recognise connections and critically evaluate information.
  • A careful and independent approach to work, with the ability to stay organised during periods of intense news activity.
  • Strong communication skills, a team-oriented mindset and a sense of responsibility.
  • An openness to new technologies and the ability to learn digital research and media monitoring tools quickly.

What matters most is your ability to identify relevant information and present it clearly. Alongside qualifications, curiosity, analytical thinking and sound news judgement are particularly valued.

Working hours and work arrangement

Our Rapid Intelligence services help international clients stay informed about important news and developments around the clock, including weekends. This role focuses primarily on weekend coverage.

What to expect:

  • Working hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week.
  • Weekend shifts: 8 hours per day on Saturdays and Sundays, from 5:00 am to 1:00 pm Bulgarian time, totalling 16 hours per week.
  • Weekday hours: The remaining four hours per week will usually be used to provide cover for other team members. These hours will be worked during the week, with the specific schedule agreed in advance.

What We Offer

Upon joining Cision, you will immediately have access to a range of benefits that are fully or partially funded by the company or can be selected at your own cost and form part of your overall benefits package. These benefits include:

  • Health Insurance
  • Life Assurance

  • Flexible benefits allowance
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Headspace
  • Global Wellbeing Days

  • Manage the emotional distress experienced by clients and their families in avoiding and resolving crisis situation. Exercise discretion and independent judgment when determining a course of action. Maintain the ability to compare and evaluate possible courses of conduct and actions, or make a decision beyond standardized lines, as required by circumstances.
  • Build client relationships, as well as business relationships and strategic partnerships with other agencies and external resources.
  • Mediate between clients/families and other professional services to facilitate care plans, strengths assessments, and establish access to other resources and providers.
  • Assert expertise in behavioral healthcare when dealing with courts, social services, professionals, doctors and education systems on behalf of the individual client/family to facilitate goals and objectives of client, care team and organization.
  • Advocate for resources on behalf of the client and family with state, government and private agencies. Complete forms and facilitate processes as deemed appropriate by circumstances.
  • Recognize and demonstrate sensitivity to cultural and ethnic differences.
  • Help others succeed by demonstrating exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to work with persons with severe and persistent mental illness and/or serious emotional disturbance, and the ability to react effectively in a wide variety of human service situations. Effectively manage conflict, promote change and growth, and inspire the development of all clients served.
  • Complete all documentation and reporting requirements thoroughly and on time.
  • Interact positively with other members of the agency and team, including active participation in supervision activities, team meetings, continuing education, etc.
  • Regularly travel and transport clients and/or families in and around the region, and provide direct care and support as needed.
  • Complete a comprehensive series of job-specific training in field of case management and social services and maintain on-going education regarding professional development, State, Federal, organizational and professional standards, including regulations, laws, compliance and ethical standards and practices.


Essential Functions:


Achieve Results

  • Ensure that all clients seen in this facility are treated with dignity and respect, and experience effective yet minimally restrictive case management intervention. Meet or exceed the organization’s access standards for timely service.
  • Develop, implement, monitor and/or modify treatment plans (according to Medicaid and agency standards), as appropriate, in order to achieve client-specific goals. Ensure that treatment plans reflect a balance of client input, information from strengths and needs assessment, and other clinical assessments, as appropriate.
  • Meet or exceed departmental goals and expectations for productivity standards.
  • Ensure that each client receives the highest level and quality of services available.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure that all treatments and interventions are delivered consistent with their programmatic intent and outcomes. Comply with all relevant laws, regulations, standards and best practices in order to satisfy case supervision requirements.
  • Actively research and engage in the identification of internal and external resources and benefits which may be advantageous to the clients being served. Ensure all clients are appropriately connected or linked to resources necessary for them to accomplish their expected treatment plans and outcomes.
  • Ensure regular and consistent communication/feedback with supervisors regarding the practical application of professional training, best practices, philosophies and standards consistent with those taught and directed by the organization.

Relationships

  • Develop and maintain respectful, courteous and professional relationships with all clients and their families. Work closely with all others involved in delivery of services to ensure that client needs are being met.
  • Maintain positive, effective working relationships with other staff members, volunteers, donors, vendors, and other internal resource relationships critical to the efficient and effective operation of the organization.
  • Develop and expand positive working relationships with current referral sources and related external partners and continue to seek out additional community services and benefits which may be of value to clients served.

Leadership and Workplace Culture

  • Uphold and ensure all activities and conduct are compliant with internal policies, as well as all relevant laws and regulations. Model the values and the mission of the organization at all times, and act as good stewards of the organization’s resources.
  • Proactively seek out and engage in professional development activities in order to remain current with best practices.
  • Demonstrate behaviors that contribute to team cohesion and result in a positive, effective work team environment.

title: Lead Health Technician (Audiology)
description:
This position is located in the Audiology and Speech Pathology Service at the Edward Hines Jr. VA Hospital and it's CBOC satellites. The duties and responsibilities are carried out throughout the medical center including all clinical and other patient care areas involved with the service. The Lead Health Technician (Audiology) supports the function of the clinical programs in Audiology.

Primary responsibility is for patient care, supporting diagnostic and treatment procedures, patient charting, and patient education, which do not require a full professional audiology education or the knowledge and skills represented by audiology licensure. Support functions include both direct patient care and administrative duties. Direct patient care and administrative duties may include, but are not limited to, the following: Greeting and escorting patients. Schedule appointments. Patient instruction and counseling on hearing loss or hearing aids either on an individual basis or in a group setting. Conducting hearing pass/fail screenings without interpretation. Non-diagnostic otoscopy. Cerumen management. Taking earmold impressions. Hearing aid troubleshooting and repair. Providing basic hearing aid information for patients and caregivers. Performing listening checks on hearing aids. Electroacoustic analysis of devices. Pairing hearing aids and accessories via Bluetooth technology. Programming previously stored settings into hearing aids. Activating remote controls. Document patient interactions in the medical records. Managing office supplies. Tracking loaner stock hearing aid inventory. Electronic ordering. Processing ROES transactions (e.g., certifying/issuing hearing aids, entering orders and repairs). Manage infection control, patient safety, and clinical supplies for the audiology clinic. Provide basic counseling to employees concerning test results and criteria for employee referral to the hearing conservation program. Provide biological checks and calibration of audiometric instrumentation. Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:30am to 4:00pm Telework: Not available Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Functional Statement #: 10557F Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not authorized

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job. Designated Drug-Testing Position: All applicants tentatively selected for VA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with VA. Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959. Must be proficient in written and spoken English. Subject to background/security investigation. Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP). Complete all application requirements detailed in the "Required Documents" section of this announcement. As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1 or 2-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your trial period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Teach Abroad in China (Beijing/Shanghai)
description:
Location: Beijing, and Shanghai China (work visa provided)

Job Type: Full-Time

About TAL

TAL (Xueersi) is a leading educational institution in China focusing on children’s quality education. We provide systematic, fun English reading courses for kids aged 2–12, with professional curriculum systems, complete teaching support and a friendly international teaching team. We sincerely invite passionate native English-speaking teachers to join our team and grow together with Chinese children.

About This Role

If you’re a young educator curious about China, fond of working with bright minds and passionate about early childhood English education, we’d love to have you on board! Here you’ll get to explore profound Chinese culture alongside children from all backgrounds, guide kids to discover the world through interesting reading lessons, and jointly make education warmer and more wonderful. No matter if you’re a new graduate with zero teaching experience, as long as you carry love and patience for kids, this is the ideal platform for you to grow and realize your teaching dreams in Beijing.

As an English Teacher at TAL, your responsibilities include:

  • Deliver high-quality English reading classes for children aged 2–6 and design lively, interactive classroom activities based on our official curriculum system.
  • Take part in regular team lesson planning, demo lesson recording, lesson refinement and curriculum optimization meetings.
  • Answer students’ learning questions after class, maintain positive communication with children and parents to deliver excellent teaching service experience.
  • Complete teaching assessments and collaborative team tasks as required by the campus.
  • Working Hours: 40 working hours per week with two rest days every week.

What We're Looking For:

  • Native-level English proficiency with clear, standard pronunciation and strong verbal communication skills
  • Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree; candidates majoring in Education or Preschool Education are highly preferred.
  • Required Qualifications & Certifications: Valid teaching qualification, 120-hour+ TESL/TEFL certificate; TESL/TEFL Diploma holders are prioritized.
    • Candidates who do not currently hold TESL/TEFL certificates are still encouraged to apply; certification support or sponsorship may be available for eligible candidates.
  • No prior teaching experience required.
  • Love children, have a passion for English education and hold professional child-oriented teaching concepts.
  • Able to prepare lessons independently, proficient in classroom management and communicating with young kids.
  • Accept flexible seasonal schedule adjustments during peak teaching periods and actively participate in team teaching research.
  • Abide by non-compete and confidentiality agreements.

Pay & Benefits Structure:

  • Pre-tax monthly salary: RMB 25,000 – 35,000 (housing allowance included), determined by your teaching background and interview performance.
  • 40 working hours per week; you are entitled to all statutory public holidays in China.
  • Full sponsorship for Z Work Visa, Foreigner Work Permit and Residence Permit.
  • Chinese social insurance covered.
  • Supplementary commercial medical insurance provided.
  • Airport pick-up service and one week of complimentary hotel accommodation upon arrival.
  • Continuous on-the-job training and complete career development support.
  • Open and inclusive corporate culture, comfortable working environment and regular team-building activities.

TAL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST (SUCCESS ENGINEER)
description:

You will lead technical engagement, solution adoption, and cross-functional integration; assess customer needs; identify implementation gaps and adoption barriers; and recommend actions to improve system use, service delivery, customer readiness, and mission outcomes.

As a INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST (SUCCESS ENGINEER) you will be responsible for the following duties: - Serves as a senior technical advocate and technical translator within the Office of Customer Success (OCS), Enablement Division, bridging the gap between customer needs and DCSA technical capabilities for assigned enterprise portfolios, including NBIS, NI2, and other critical DCSA systems. - Supports Customer Executives, Account Managers, and customer-facing account teams by translating customer needs into detailed technical requirements and articulating those requirements to the appropriate DCSA technical and program stakeholders, identifying technical constraints and dependencies, and enabling more accurate alignment between customer expectations and DCSA technical solutions. - Leads proof-of-concept, pilot, and technical validation efforts across multiple stakeholders by assessing technical fit, configuring and validating use cases in test or demonstration environments, identifying integration and operational barriers, and helping ensure DCSA solutions are positioned to deploy correctly and demonstrate required value. - Explains system architectures, maps customer environments to DCSA solutions, reviews integration requirements, verifies application programming interface behavior, assesses configuration compatibility, evaluates interoperability considerations, tests technical workflows, and confirms deployment readiness criteria for assigned systems and portfolios. - Troubleshoots and helps resolve complex technical issues involving connectivity, configuration, APIs, identity and access dependencies, interoperability, and related operational factors affecting adoption, implementation, and customer success. - Coordinates with internal technical organizations, including system program offices, implementation teams, hosting and infrastructure teams, identity and access teams, help desk, operations and sustainment teams, and data and integration teams, to support technical planning, issue resolution, deployment readiness, and continuity of customer support. - Supports the full customer technical lifecycle, including pre-adoption technical enablement, onboarding and implementation activities during adoption, and post-deployment technical success and escalation management.
