title: Supervisory Transportation Security Inspector - Surface
description:
Securing Travel, Protecting People - At the Transportation Security Administration, you will serve in a high-stakes environment to safeguard the American way of life. In cities across the country, you would secure airports, seaports, railroads, highways, and/or public transit systems, thus protecting America's transportation infrastructure and ensuring freedom of movement for people and commerce.

This Supervisory Transportation Security Inspector - Surface position is located at Security Operations, Surface Operations, West Region, Denver International Airport (DEN), Transportation Security Administration, Department of Homeland Security (DHS). Duties include but are not limited to: Works independently with responsibility for ensuring regulatory compliance of persons and transportation systems and entities regulated under Title 49 Code of Federal Regulation (CFR) Part 1500 series. Leads in the administration of critical and complex compliance and enforcement programs designed to protect the nation's public transportation systems. Performs the full range of regulatory compliance activities in inspections, structured oversight, and other compliance activities in Surface Operations. Serves as a technical specialist and primary point of contact to the Regional Security Director (RSD), Regional Operations Director (ROD), regional and local field staff, and industry stakeholders on surface-related transportation security regulations demonstrating substantial knowledge and understanding of one or more modal specialties, sufficient to provide specialized support. Provides guidance to lower-level technical staff on how to solve difficult issues and serving as a team leader in assigning, overseeing, guiding and reviewing the work of other TSIs on selected inspections and non-inspections activities, when required. Supervising and mentoring a team of Transportation Security Inspectors (TSIs) in Surface Operations. Conducts regulatory inspections and investigations, and supports criminal investigations related to alleged or suspected security violations. Responds to and coordinates security incidents, threats, violations or potential violations. Coordinates, participates, and provides overt and covert presence, including high visibility activities, to detect and reduce identified security threats and vulnerabilities. Coordinating and participating in covert and overt tests/audits, vulnerability assessments. Plans and assigns work, setting priorities, developing performance standards, reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave, coaching and identifying developmental and training needs for employees. Manages studies and analyses that provide operating direction on feasibility of implementing security programs and support for surface operations. Reviewing and approving data pertinent to investigations, inspections, and incidents entered into the Performance and Results Information System (PARIS) and security assessments captured into Surface Data Management System (SDMS) for subordinate TSIs. Partners with key stakeholders to address complex issues related to security operations. Provides for and arranging necessary skills development and specialization training; recommends corrective or disciplinary actions; and recommends promotions, and reassignments. Resolves routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit. Provides advice, counsel and instructions to employees on work and administrative matters. Provides input to budget requests or other resource requirements. Maintains frequent contact with the other work units and activities throughout the field activity to provide or receive services and exchange information about work operations. Performs other duties as assigned by the Regional Security Director (RSD) and/or Regional Operations Director (ROD). Supervisory/Managerial duties include serving as a first line supervisor for the organization. This includes but is not limited to: assigning work, setting priorities, and reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave; coaching and developing employees; recommending corrective or disciplinary actions; assisting in budget planning and projecting short-term needs; managing projects within assigned resources; resolving routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit; and when required, coordinating with customers outside the immediate organization. This position is designated as an Emergency Essential (EE) position. This designation requires the employee to remain in a duty status if an emergency arises.

You must possess U.S. Citizenship or be a U.S. National. You must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret level security clearance. You must pass pre-employment drug screening AND you will be subject to post-employment random drug and alcohol testing. Selective Service registration is required. You must hold and maintain a valid driver's license. Must be able to obtain and maintain a government travel card. Successfully complete the Basic Transportation Security Inspections and Surface courses. You must be available for "on call" work and be available for duty within the U.S. and possibly worldwide to protect U.S. transportation interests. You must be available to work various shifts, including frequently changing and uncommon tours of duty. Undertaking extensive travel, at times overnight, as required. You must, on an annual basis, or as directed, complete the OGE-450 Confidential Financial Disclosure Report, to include an annual ethics training course. You must be able to walk on uneven surfaces such as railroad ballast and/or crushed rocks, etc. for an extended period of time. Supervisory/Managerial Trial Period Requirements: Unless previously completed, you must satisfactorily complete a one-year supervisory trial period to continue in this supervisory/managerial position. If you fail to meet the conditions of employment or any other pre-employment requirements, such as missing any of the scheduled appointments, the hiring agency may rescind their tentative offer of employment. Applying to this announcement certifies that you give permission for TSA to share your application with others in DHS for similar positions. Any offers of employment made pursuant to this announcement will be consistent with all applicable authorities, including Presidential Memoranda, Executive Orders, interpretive U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) guidance, and Office of Management and Budget plans and policies concerning hiring. These authorities are subject to change.

As a participant in the Pathways Recent Graduates Program, you will receive both formal and on-the-job training to develop the required knowledge and skill to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position.

Screening and vetting to grant or deny complex applications and petitions for immigration benefits based on electronic or paper applications, petitions, and in-person interviews.

title: Specialist Real Estate & Construction
description:
About the opportunity

The Specialist Real Estate & Construction is responsible for end-to-end site management, from scouting and lease negotiation to serving as the primary point of contact between Talabat and its landlords across all locations. This individual will work closely with internal stakeholders across business functions to ensure real estate solutions align with operational needs and landlord relationships are proactively managed. This role requires strong negotiation skills, relationship management, and an ability to troubleshoot real estate-related issues across departments.



What's On Your Plate:




Construction & Engineering Leadership



  • Lead and oversee construction projects from design phase through final delivery, managing all engineering and architectural requirements.



  • Proficient in interpreting architectural layouts, blueprints, and engineering specifications to ensure compliance with standards and timelines.



  • Coordinate with consultants, contractors and suppliers to resolve site-specific challenges, manage budgets, and maintain project schedules.



Tendering, Negotiation & Market Pricing



  • Manage tender processes for construction materials, equipment, and services, ensuring competitive bidding and best value outcomes.



  • Explore and analyze market pricing for construction materials, labor, and equipment to optimize project budgets without compromising quality.



  • Negotiate contracts with vendors, contractors, and suppliers to secure favorable pricing, delivery schedules, and service terms.



Deal Structuring & Negotiation



  • Lead commercial negotiations with landlords, property managers, and brokers to secure favorable lease terms and conditions.



  • Draft, review, and finalize Letters of Intent (LOIs).



Cross-Functional Collaboration



  • Legal: Partner with internal and external legal counsel to draft, review, and execute lease agreements, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.



  • Finance: Work closely with the finance team to develop business cases, secure budget approvals, and track project CAPEX and OPEX.



  • Procurement: Coordinate with procurement to align on vendor onboarding, equipment sourcing, and fit-out materials needed for the new locations.



  • Act as the primary point of contact for these departments, removing roadblocks and driving tasks to completion to "get things done.



Location Scouting & Real Estate



  • Conduct market research to identify potential locations for new dark kitchen facilities in high-potential neighborhoods.



  • Support lease negotiations with landlords and property managers to secure favorable terms aligned with operational needs.



  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sites through direct outreach, brokers, and real estate networks.



Qualifications & Requirements



  • Construction & Engineering Background: Strong background in construction management, civil engineering, or facilities engineering. Proven ability to manage complex construction projects from planning to execution.



  • Cloud Kitchen & Operational Experience: Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in cloud kitchen operations, F&B logistics, or similar high-volume food service facilities. Demonstrated expertise in operational excellence and vendor management.



  • Tendering & Market Pricing Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage tender processes, analyze market pricing trends, and negotiate competitive contracts with vendors and contractors to optimize cost efficiency.



  • Technical Proficiency: Expert-level ability to read and interpret architectural blueprints, engineering drawings, and construction specifications. Familiarity with construction management software and project tracking tools.



  • Project Management & Coordination: Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple construction projects, operational rollouts, and budget oversight simultaneously.



  • Cross-Functional Fluency & Secondary Real Estate Skills: Strong ability to communicate effectively across operations, finance, and construction teams. Basic experience with commercial real estate negotiations and site selection is a plus but secondary to core construction and operational expertise.




Who we are

Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

As a Network Engineer, you will design, operate, and optimize the enterprise network that powers True Anomaly’s engineering, manufacturing, and cloud-connected environments. You’ll work across complex on-prem topologies, hybrid cloud connectivity, and secure networking architectures to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability.

You’ll be joining a rapidly growing environment where your expertise will directly influence the stability and performance of our mission-critical infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure including routing, switching, segmentation, VPN, and firewall services.
  • Operate and support Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Juniper switching/routing platforms (or equivalent vendor experience).
  • Build and maintain hybrid connectivity between on-prem environments and major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues including routing loops, BGP/OSPF behavior, latency, packet loss, and inter-VLAN connectivity.
  • Manage network performance, capacity planning, telemetry, and monitoring.
  • Implement and maintain network security practices including segmentation and firewall rule hygiene.
  • Support compliance-driven requirements aligned to CMMC and contribute to environments where ITAR or FedRAMP considerations may be present (not core to the role).
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for critical network escalations.
  • Document architectures, change plans, diagrams, and runbooks.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and cloud engineering teams in a high-velocity, fast-moving environment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer supporting enterprise-class environments.
  • Strong knowledge of routing/switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, STP, DNS, DHCP).
  • Hands-on experience with firewalls (Palo Alto preferred) and routing/switching (Juniper preferred).
  • Experience supporting hybrid or cloud-connected networks (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with packet captures, performance metrics, and logs.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-team collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with compliance-driven environments (CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP) — helpful but not required.
  • Availability to participate in an on-call rotation.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Active or previously held TS/SCI clearance (preferred but not required).
  • Experience with security-focused networking architectures or compliance programs (CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP).
  • Network automation or scripting experience (Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar).
  • Relevant certifications such as PCNSE, JNCIS/JNCIP, CCNP, or equivalent.
  • Experience with SD-WAN, multi-site networking, or data center architectures.
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or high-security, compliance-heavy environments.

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $105,000 - $140,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach, CA. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.
  • Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
  • Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location - Bengaluru, India

About the team

The Data Intelligence & Analytics organization builds the core data platform and internal products that power decision-making across the company. We design and operate large-scale data systems, own the company’s data lake, ingestion infrastructure, and platform tooling, and develop end-to-end applications that transform complex datasets into fast, reliable, business-critical products used daily by go-to-market, product, and engineering teams. Our work sits at the intersection of data platforms, distributed systems, and product development, giving engineers the opportunity to own meaningful problems across the stack and build systems that truly run the business.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced data scientist to join our Bangalore team and help scale the next generation of our AI/ML models. In this role, you will train predictive models and the workflows behind AI-driven applications, Agents, Chatbots that power teams across the company, including go-to-market, engineering, and product. Because the products we build are initiated and owned by the team, you will be involved end-to-end — from shaping requirements and designing systems to implementation, deployment, and long-term ownership.

You will focus on building scalable, reliable AI/ML models, services and GenAI powered application backends, partnering closely with data and full-stack engineers to deliver new features and operate the pipelines and platforms behind our products. Our stack spans multiple languages and technologies, including Python, React, and TypeScript, and continues to evolve. Many of our applications also incorporate strong AI components, giving you opportunities to work with modern AI infrastructure and tools such as vector databases, MCP-based services, and Workers AI.

What you'll do

  • Partner and align with business leaders, stakeholders, product managers and internal teams to understand the business and product challenges and goals and address them using predictive analytics in a globally distributed environment.
  • Understand data landscape i.e tooling, tech stack, source systems etc. and work closely with the data engineering team to improve the data collection and quality.
  • Understand business/product strategy and high-level roadmap and align analysis efforts to enable them with data insights and help achieve their strategic goals.
  • Strong audience focused presentation and storytelling skills focused on key takeaways in a crisp and concise manner.
  • Define, implement, and train statistical, machine learning, deep learning and generative AI models.
  • Use software engineering best practices to publish model scores/insights/learnings at scale within the company.
  • Ability to define and spot macro and micro levels trends with statistical significance on a regular basis and understand key drivers driving those trends.
  • Active role in hiring, growing, and mentoring the data scientist team in Bengaluru.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • Bachelors or M.S in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields.
  • 5+ years of data scientist experience with proven industry experience in a large scale environment (PBs scale & globally distributed teams). fast-growing SaaS business based company is preferred.
  • Strong experience working with business functions such as Finance, Sales, and Marketing to build models and drive impactful business outcomes (eg: customer and revenue growth)
  • Strong experience in scientific computing using Python
  • Experience with Spark, SQL, Tableau, Google Analytics, BigQuery (or any other Big data/Cloud equivalent) etc.
  • Experience working with and processing structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience with data engineering and data analysts teams within the function.
  • Proven track record of applying data insights and machine learning in order to address business needs and drive revenue.
  • Proficiency in large language models and the frameworks (Langchain, Langgraph, etc.) necessary for implementing GenAI applications, such as AI Agents, chatbots and related use cases.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills catered to different audiences within the company.
  • Capable of working closely with business, engineering, and product teams to ensure data initiatives are aligned with business needs.
  • Experience in hiring data scientists and establishing team best practices is preferred.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. title: Supervisory Contract Specialist
description:
Serves as a Contracts Branch Manager in the office of Acquisition and Contracting (AAQ). Incumbent has responsibility for overseeing the award and administration of all contractual actions for assigned customers and programs, including a full range of types of contracts and procurements (e.g., technical and nontechnical support services, IT, and major NAS systems acquisitions, construction, supplies, non-support services).

Providing leadership direction and guidance to branch personnel; managing work assignments and distribution across the branch; serving as an advisor to agency officials on acquisition strategies and standards; establishing and implementing operating policies and procedures for the branch; ensuring functions are carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and agency policy; implementing consistent standards and best practices across the branch; reviewing, monitoring, and evaluating the effectiveness of branch procurement functions; and collaborating with other branch managers and the division manager and actively engaging as a member of the division leadership team in the leadership of AAQ and division initiatives. The incumbent supervises the work of subordinate employees, plans and assigns tasks, monitors and evaluates employee performance, and approves employee leave. Positions are at the highest non-executive managerial level in a particular job category. Manages the work of a large, multi-level organization typically through subordinate managers. Integrates work of multiple organizations to meet strategic goals of the organization and the FAA, participates in strategic planning for the FAA, and makes commitments (program, budget, etc) for a major organization. Directs the work of subordinate employees and/or managers for multiple organizational units/projects/programs and across multiple functions and/or disciplines within a major subdivision. Work includes complex projects/programs based on the objectives of the major subdivision, the LOB/SO, and frequently the FAA. Managerial duties typically affect managers and employees for more than one organizational unit/project/program, and include: strategic planning; communicating the organization's vision and objectives; setting priorities; assigning tasks and responsibilities; monitoring and evaluating performance of organizational units, managers, and/or employees; coaching and developing staff and organizational capabilities; approving leave; and taking or approving corrective/disciplinary actions as appropriate. Defines, acquires, and allocates budget, staff, and other resources to accomplish objectives for multiple organizational units/projects/ programs and across multiple functions and/or disciplines. Manages budget and either reallocates resources among organizational units/projects/programs or acquires additional resources as needed. Leads and integrates the budget planning processes for all organizational units/projects/programs under his/her control, and projects both short-term and long-term future needs. Participates in planning efforts that cross organizational lines within the major subdivision and LOB/SO. Applies a detailed knowledge of the technical aspects of the work that is directed; a detailed knowledge of budget, human resource management, and other administrative policies and procedures; and a comprehensive understanding of the objectives of the major subdivision, the LOB/SO, and the FAA. Also applies a thorough understanding of the principles of management and strategic planning, and the ability to integrate the work of multiple organizational units/projects/programs to accomplish mission objectives. Contacts are routinely internal and external to the major subdivision. Internal contacts are with subordinates, peers, and higher level management to discuss the statuses and results of projects/programs and plan for the future. May represent the major subdivision, LOB/SO, or the FAA externally as a primary point of contact for policies/ procedures or other project/program purposes. Has the authority, within guidelines, to make commitments for the major subdivision, to establish new policies/procedures, and to make exceptions. Work is typically governed by established policies, procedures and mission objectives which leave considerable room for discretion.

We are not accepting applications from noncitizens.

title: Supervisory AI/ML Engineer
description:
The Supervisory Artificial Intelligence (AI) / Machine Learning (ML) Engineer serves as the agency's senior supervisory data scientist leading mission critical analytics to detect and mitigate consumer product hazards. This position is located in the Directorate for Epidemiology (EP), Office of Risk Reduction (EXRR) at the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC).

This position is officially titled Supervisory Data Scientist (Artificial Intelligence). The working title is Supervisory AI/ML Engineer. The Supervisory AI/ML Engineer is directly responsible for the end-to-end data science lifecycle from problem framing and experiments design through data curation, model development, validation, and interpretability, producing statistically rigorous insights that help to shape agency policy and enforcement prioritization and improves detection accuracy. Work reflects expertise in statistical learning, algorithmic innovation, and causal inference, applying advanced methods to varied structured/unstructured sources at scale. The incumbent leads a team that builds AI agents that operationalize safety analytics using tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Python agents, and retrieval pipelines to accelerate triage and decision flow. Integrates agents with APIs, event streams, dashboards, and case management systems to reduce cycle time from signal to action and support proactive hazard detection. Serves as a technical expert on data science principles and concepts to construct data fusion products that merge data from multiple systems. Maintains state of the art knowledge of AI/ML development through close contact with industry and other federal activities; participates in AI/ML working groups, communities of practice, and CPSC or governmentwide forums. The Supervisory AI/ML Engineer: Leads and defines the agency's data science research agenda for hazard detection and product risk modeling; establishes methodological standards, reproducibility protocols, and peer review processes. Leads large-scale, analytically intensive data science program through advanced data science methodologies, statistical modeling, and applied ML. Helps to transform hazard detection processes by replacing manual systems with automated data-driven approaches capable of evaluating high-volume, high-velocity datasets. Leads the design and implementation of advanced technical solutions (e.g. supervised / unsupervised, Natural Language Processing (NLP), deep learning, agent native and opensource generative pretrained transformers (GPTs), and multiagent orchestration) to extract actionable insights, rigorously evaluate model performance, and enhance product safety decision making. The role emphasizes data quality, performance, and interoperability in modern cloud environments (Azure), enabling the Commission's strategic acceleration toward a proactive product safety operating model. Ensures strong cross functional collaboration to advance organizational priorities and deliver the CPSC mission. Leads data storytelling that transforms complex data and model outputs into clear narratives, decision briefs, and visual analytics (dashboards, reports) for technical and nontechnical audiences; and surfaces foresights by identifying leading indicators, signals, and trends; perform scenario analysis and "what-if" simulations to anticipate emerging hazards and shorten time to intervention. Communicates uncertainty, assumptions, and limitations to senior leaders and horizontal agency offices; connects insights to current internal and external policy, enforcement, and program impacts; and serves as a architect and implements end-to-end ML pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment. Implements model monitoring (drift, data/feature quality, bias, and business KPIs), alerting, and automated rollback to keep systems safe and responsive. Designs high quality data pipelines (ingest, transform, validate) across structured and unstructured sources; enforces data contracts, lineage, and documentation. Partners with analytics teams to make datasets discoverable and performant for iterative model development. Mentors and guides junior AI/ML engineers through structured coaching, technical reviews, and career development support. Provides hands-on supervision in designing ML pipelines, coding best practices, and responsible AI principles. Fosters a learning culture by organizing knowledge-sharing sessions, pair programming, and code walkthroughs. Sets clear expectations, provides actionable feedback, and ensures alignment with agency standards for quality, security, and compliance. Encourages innovation while maintaining rigor in documentation, reproducibility, and governance artifacts. Drives adoption and change management.

Please see http://www.sss.gov for more information. False statements or responses on these forms can jeopardize your employment opportunity and subject you to disciplinary action, including removal from Federal service. title: FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST
description:
THIS IS A NATIONAL GUARD TITLE 5 EXCEPTED SERVICE POSITION. This National Guard position is for a FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST, Position Description Number T6379000 and is part of the ME HQ MEANG, National Guard.

The purpose of this position is to plan, coordinate, and perform financial management analysis, quality reviews, and administrative finance tasks at the squadron and group levels. Duties include budgeting, financial analysis, operational finance, and administrative support to ensure compliance with policies, regulations, and readiness requirements. The use of this position description is contingent upon the 6F0X1 CSS position being earned and authorized on the Unit Manning Document (UMD). MAJOR DUTIES: Budget and Financial Management. The Financial Analyst serves as the CSS point of contact for day-to-day budget and financial issues, working closely with the Comptroller Flight's budget office to obtain, monitor, and track organizational funds. The incumbent collaborates with commanders and supervisors to create spend plans and integrates them into the overall base budget. Additionally, the Financial Analyst provides advice on budget matters, including types of funding available, effects of budgetary changes, and the status and use of funds. The position also involves preparing narrative justifications for projected funding needs and submitting them to the Comptroller Flight's Budget Office. Training functional contacts and program managers on financial management procedures is a key responsibility. Provides additional operational support as determined by leadership. Government Travel Card (GTC) and Pay Operations. The Financial Analyst monitors government travel card (GTC) accounts and ensures compliance with regulations. This includes initiating GTC applications for eligible members, briefing members on statements of understanding, and collecting and instructing members on completing GTC computer-based training. The incumbent performs GTC account maintenance, including closing accounts for retiring or separating members and placing accounts in the cloud for transferring members. Additionally, the Financial Analyst provides interpretation of financial guidance to unit commanders, Resource Advisors (RAs), and other personnel, including briefing entitlements for deployments, schools, long tours, and newcomer orientations. Orders and Participation Management. Serves as Unit Workday Control Officer (UWCO), responsible for monitoring and advising on the use of all workdays and dollars. The Financial Analyst approves and tracks unit orders, including annual training (AT), special training (ST), military personnel appropriation (MPA), regular scheduled drill (RSD), deployment, and inactive duty training (IDT) orders using the Air National Guard Reserve Order Writing System (AROWS). The incumbent monitors and approves participation rosters, calculates IDT days performed, and finalizes rosters for leadership and members. Approved processed amendments, validating needs, and providing updated documentation to members are also required. Establishing and tracking orders in AROWS ensures proper documentation and compliance. Audits, Internal Controls, and Systems Utilization. Auditing and internal controls are critical aspects of the role. The Financial Analyst performs random audits on travel claims, reviews Inspector General (IG) reports, and identifies and corrects deficiencies. The incumbent manages internal control procedures to protect against fraud, waste, and abuse, verifies and validates commitments and obligations, and ensures compliance with quality assurance initiatives, internal control review guides, and self-inspection checklists. The Financial Analyst utilizes current financial management systems to accomplish budgeting and operational finance tasks, such as executing funds and documenting transactions. Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Case Manager Homeless Outreach
description:
Case Manager – Homeless Outreach


Make a Difference Where It Matters Most


Are you passionate about helping individuals rebuild their lives? Do you believe that stable housing, compassionate support, and recovery-focused care can transform lives? If so, we'd love to have you join our team.

As a Case Manager, you'll work directly with adults experiencing chronic homelessness who have co-occurring serious mental illness (SMI) and substance use disorders. You'll provide intensive, community-based services that help individuals secure housing, improve daily functioning, manage mental health symptoms, and achieve greater independence.

This is a highly rewarding role for someone who enjoys building meaningful relationships, meeting people where they are, and making a lasting impact in the community.

What You'll Do

As a Case Manager, you will:

  • Build trusting, respectful relationships with clients while fostering hope and supporting recovery.
  • Conduct outreach in locations where individuals experiencing homelessness are commonly found, including shelters, day centers, food kitchens, the Frank Williams Housing Resource Center, and other community partner agencies.
  • Help clients obtain and maintain safe, affordable, and stable housing.
  • Teach and reinforce independent living skills, including budgeting, personal care, medication management, communication, and other daily living activities.
  • Support clients in overcoming barriers to recovery through individualized, strengths-based service planning.
  • Utilize Motivational Interviewing and other evidence-based practices to engage clients in services.
  • Coordinate care and connect clients with community resources such as peer support, outpatient treatment, vocational services, healthcare providers, and other supportive programs.
  • Assist with crisis prevention and intervention when needed.
  • Educate and collaborate with family members and natural supports when appropriate.
  • Provide transportation and accompany clients to appointments, housing meetings, and community activities as medically necessary.
  • Complete timely, accurate documentation in accordance with agency and regulatory standards.
  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team to ensure high-quality, person-centered care.

Enterprise Data Services (EDS)

Contract

Permanent, Full-Time

Line Relationship

Data Architect

About the Team

Enterprise Data Services (EDS) is responsible for Bottomline's Enterprise Data Warehouse, Enterprise Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Data Governance, and strategic data platforms.

Our mission is to transform business operations, products, and decision-making through trusted data and AI-powered capabilities. Our technology strategy is centred around Snowflake and its native AI ecosystem, including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, Snowpark, and enterprise data products such as Customer Cube.

We operate at the intersection of Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Analytics, Governance, and Platform Engineering, building the foundations that enable the organisation to become truly AI-first.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise AI & Data Architect to define and lead the future-state architecture for Bottomline's Data, Analytics, AI, and Cloud Platforms.

This role combines AI Architecture, Enterprise Data Architecture, Data Engineering Architecture, and Cloud Platform Architecture to ensure the organisation can scale trusted data products, AI-native solutions, and business-critical analytics on a secure, governed, resilient, and cost-effective foundation.

The Enterprise AI & Data Architect will report directly to the Senior Director of AI & Data Services and work closely with the existing Data Architect through a dotted-line relationship. Together, these roles will define and govern the enterprise architecture strategy for data, analytics, AI, integration, and cloud platforms.

While the Data Architect focuses on information architecture, data modelling, governance, and enterprise data standards, the Enterprise AI & Data Architect will focus on AI architecture, platform architecture, data engineering standards, cloud infrastructure, and the technical enablement of enterprise-scale AI solutions.

This role is both strategic and hands-on, requiring the ability to define long-term architecture roadmaps whilst also guiding engineering teams through the delivery of complex initiatives.

What You Will Do

Enterprise AI Strategy & Architecture

  • Support the enterprise AI architecture roadmap.
  • Develop reference architectures for Generative AI, Agentic AI, Predictive AI, and AI-powered analytics.
  • Establish standards and design patterns for Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, and Cortex Analyst.
  • Define architecture principles for AI platforms, reusable AI services, and enterprise AI products.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to Bottomline.
  • Create architectural blueprints that enable scalable and governed AI adoption across the organisation.

Data Platform & Data Engineering Architecture

  • Define architecture standards for the Enterprise Data Warehouse and strategic data products.
  • Design scalable, AI-ready data architectures that support analytics, machine learning, and enterprise reporting.
  • Establish patterns for batch, streaming, CDC, event-driven, and real-time data integration.
  • Define standards for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, deployment, and operational support.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure solutions are performant, scalable, maintainable, and cost-efficient.
  • Guide architecture for Customer Cube and other strategic data products.
  • Drive adoption of modern DataOps, DevOps, and platform engineering practices.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture

  • Define cloud architecture patterns supporting Snowflake, AI workloads, data pipelines, and analytics services.
  • Establish standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), platform automation, and deployment frameworks.
  • Design scalable and resilient architectures capable of supporting enterprise AI workloads.
  • Define standards for observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and platform health management.
  • Support infrastructure modernisation and platform optimisation initiatives.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams to ensure enterprise-grade operational practices.

Resilience, Disaster Recovery & Operational Readiness

  • Define architectural standards for disaster recovery, backup, resilience, and business continuity.
  • Ensure critical data and AI platforms have documented and tested recovery capabilities.
  • Guide architecture decisions related to high availability and system resilience.
  • Support audit, risk, compliance, and security initiatives through robust architectural controls.
  • Define operational readiness requirements for production AI and data services.

AI Governance & Responsible AI

  • Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks.
  • Define standards for model evaluation, monitoring, explainability, fairness, and risk management.
  • Create architectural guardrails for AI development and deployment.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Governance teams to ensure regulatory alignment.
  • Drive adoption of responsible AI principles across all AI initiatives.

Architecture Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Data Architect to develop a unified enterprise data and AI architecture strategy.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and design reviews.
  • Define and maintain architecture standards across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Analytics, and Platform Engineering.
  • Mentor engineers and architects on best practices and emerging technologies.
  • Review and approve solution architectures for major strategic initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership.

Business & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Translate business strategy into executable technology roadmaps.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support organisational AI adoption and transformation initiatives.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Data Architecture, AI Architecture, Cloud Architecture, or related disciplines.
  • Strong experience designing large-scale enterprise data platforms and modern cloud architectures.
  • Deep understanding of Data Engineering, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning ecosystems.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Experience designing scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise systems.
  • Experience defining architecture standards, governance processes, and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional technology initiatives.

Strong Preference

  • Deep experience with Snowflake and associated platform services.
  • Experience with Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, and Snowpark.
  • Experience with Neo4J/native graph databases.
  • Experience building AI-ready enterprise data platforms.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI architectures, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, vector search, semantic layers, evaluation frameworks, and LLMOps.
  • Experience with AWS cloud architecture and platform engineering.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code and automated deployment frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, and Information Security.

Nice to Have

  • Fintech, Payments, Banking, or B2B SaaS experience.
  • Snowflake certification(s).
  • Cloud Architecture certification(s).
  • Experience presenting architecture strategy to Executive Leadership Teams.
  • Experience supporting enterprise AI transformation programmes.
  • Knowledge of Data Mesh, Lakehouse, or modern distributed data architecture patterns.

Our Technology Stack

Data & AI Platform

Snowflake; Cortex AI; Cortex Agents; Cortex Search; Cortex Analyst; Snowpark; Dynamic Tables; Enterprise Data Warehouse

Cloud & Infrastructure

AWS; Infrastructure as Code; CI/CD Pipelines; Platform Automation; Monitoring & Observability Tooling

Engineering

Python; SQL; Git; DataOps; DevOps

Analytics

Power BI; Streamlit; Enterprise Semantic Models

Why This Role Is Different

  • Shape the future of Bottomline's enterprise AI and data ecosystem.
  • Own architecture across AI, Data, Analytics, Cloud, and Platform Engineering.
  • Influence strategic technology and investment decisions.
  • Build reusable enterprise capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
  • Operate at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution.
  • Work directly with senior leadership on high-impact initiatives.
  • Drive the adoption of trusted, governed, and scalable AI solutions across the organisation.

Your First 90 Days

Days 1-30: Understand

  • Review the current data, AI, analytics, and platform architecture landscape.
  • Meet key stakeholders across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and Business teams.
  • Assess strategic programmes including Customer Cube and enterprise AI initiatives.
  • Identify architecture opportunities, gaps, and risks.

Days 30-60: Define

  • Develop the enterprise AI and data architecture roadmap.
  • Publish initial architecture principles, standards, and governance processes.
  • Define target-state architectures for strategic AI and data platforms.
  • Establish architecture review and approval processes.

Days 60-90: Enable

  • Launch architecture governance forums.
  • Support delivery teams with reference architectures and reusable patterns.
  • Define platform engineering, infrastructure, and observability standards.
  • Deliver initial architecture blueprints for strategic programmes.
  • Present the enterprise AI and data architecture roadmap to senior leadership.

Success Measures

After 12 months, success would include:

  • Enterprise AI and Data Architecture adopted across strategic initiatives.
  • Standardised architecture and engineering standards implemented across Data and AI teams.
  • Customer Cube established as a strategic enterprise data product.
  • Increased delivery velocity through reusable architecture patterns and shared services.
  • Reduced technical debt and improved platform maintainability.
  • Improved Snowflake performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Fully governed AI development lifecycle with measurable quality controls.
  • Mature disaster recovery and resilience capabilities across critical platforms.
  • Strong collaboration between Data Architecture, Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams.
  • Demonstrable business outcomes delivered through scalable, trusted, and AI-enabled solutions.

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

title: Telephone Operator
description:

The décor evokes the feel of the Greek islands, using whites and blues, with an expansive terrace overlooking the pool and Arabian Sea. Live bouzouki music and vibrant ambiance add to the dining experience on select evenings.
Your Day to Day
The Telephone Operator is responsible for delivering exceptional guest service through the efficient, professional, and courteous handling of all incoming and outgoing telephone calls and guest requests. The role serves as a central communication point between guests, hotel departments, and external callers, ensuring that every interaction reflects the hotel's service culture and commitment to delivering memorable guest experiences.
Key Responsibilities

  • Answer all incoming internal and external telephone calls promptly and professionally, following the hotel's telephone etiquette standards.


  • Handle guest inquiries, transfer calls accurately, and provide relevant information about hotel facilities, services, operating hours, and ongoing promotions.


  • Manage wake-up calls, message taking, call forwarding, and other telephone-related services accurately and efficiently.


  • Ensure that all messages are recorded completely and delivered to the appropriate recipients without delay.


  • Handle external callers courteously and ensure calls are directed to the relevant departments or colleagues.


  • Receive, record, coordinate, and follow up on guest requests received through telephone calls and other designated communication channels.


  • Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, Room Service, Front Office, Concierge, and other relevant departments to ensure timely service delivery.


  • Monitor pending requests and follow up with the responsible departments to ensure completion within established service standards.


  • Communicate updates to guests when necessary and ensure that outstanding requests are properly handed over between shifts.


  • Escalate complaints, urgent requests, and service recovery situations to the appropriate supervisor or manager.


  • Deliver personalized, warm, and professional service in every interaction, demonstrating genuine care and a commitment to guest satisfaction.


  • Anticipate guest needs and provide clear, accurate, and helpful information.


  • Handle guest complaints and concerns with empathy, patience, and professionalism, taking appropriate action within the scope of authority.


  • Ensure that every guest interaction reflects the hotel's brand standards and service culture.


  • Maintain a positive and composed attitude when dealing with demanding situations or high call volumes.


What We Are Looking For

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Tourism, or a related field is an advantage.


  • Previous experience in a Guest Service Center, Telephone Operator, Front Office, or customer service role is preferred.


  • Experience in a five-star or luxury hotel environment is an advantage.


  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are an asset.


  • Basic computer literacy and the ability to learn hotel operating systems.


  • Strong telephone etiquette, active listening, and interpersonal skills.


What We Offer
We’ll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.
Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.
So go on - show us how your passion and personality are the perfect fit to deliver memorable experiences to our guests.

title: Midweight Motion Designer
description:
Landor is looking for a Midweight Motion Designer to join our London studio. Could this be you?

We are Landor, part of WPP

World-leading brand experts,
underpinned by the most expansive strategic & creative capabilities in our category.

We make brands more valuable and less vulnerable.

We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. We strategically join the dots between our design, experience, governance and measurement capabilities, and always connect our brand work to business outcomes.

Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace & architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design).

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit .

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Motion Designer to join our multidisciplinary team in London, bringing brand identities to life through best-in-class motion design. Working across all Landor clients, you'll use your expertise in 2D and 3D motion design and video editing to create dynamic brand assets, brand films, social content and campaigns that elevate brands and engage audiences. Motion plays an increasingly central role in our branding work, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how global brands behave across digital products, campaigns, experiences and social platforms.

In this fast-paced studio environment, you'll collaborate with designers, strategists and creatives to push the boundaries of motion. Your core focus will be motion design and animation, supported by strong video editing skills that help craft compelling brand stories across multiple touchpoints. From high-energy digital activations to refined, cinematic brand expressions, you'll bring a deep understanding of movement, pacing, editing and storytelling to every project.

What you’ll need

You are a motion specialist with a passion for bringing brands to life through movement. With an expert grasp of animation principles, you know how to transform static design into fluid, engaging and expressive motion. Equally confident editing short videos, you understand how pacing, rhythm and sequencing can shape powerful narratives and create memorable brand experiences. You have a sharp eye for detail, timing and craft, ensuring every piece of work feels refined and impactful.

Comfortable working across multiple clients, industries and visual styles, you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two projects are the same.

You're highly proficient in Cinema4D, Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro and Illustrator, with the ability to develop compelling motion narratives that extend brand identities beyond the static. Experience with generative AI workflows for motion, as well as emerging tools such as Cavalry, would be an advantage. You're a natural problem-solver, always experimenting with movement, transitions, composition and editing techniques to find the strongest creative solution. Above all, you bring energy, originality and a deep understanding of how motion and film can amplify brand storytelling.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

We build brands. We build futures. Landor, a WPP company, is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics, committed to a culture of respect where everyone belongs and can progress in their careers.

title: Senior Associate Corporate Finance
description:
About the opportunity

As Senior Associate, Corporate Finance, you will own and execute the Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) framework, while also driving the treasury planning. Reporting directly to the Head of Corporate Finance within the Treasury team, you will play a vital role in risk transfer, assessing profitability, allocating capital, and defining incentives for business units by assigning net interest income.

What You'll Do

  • FTP Ownership: Maintain and evolve the internal FTP regime to centralize liquidity and interest rate risks, pricing risk accurately to steer balance sheet profitability.
  • Treasury Controlling & Reporting: Own day-to-day data consolidation, PnL monitoring, and tracking of core Treasury KPIs.
  • Planning & Forecasting: Partner with Treasury and Finance to drive the multi-year budget and strategic planning process.
  • Audit & Regulatory Readiness: Lead the documentation of technical assumptions and balance sheet models for internal/external audits.
  • Data & Automation: Upgrade reporting pipelines using SQL to eliminate data bottlenecks and scale infrastructure.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate closely with ALM, Short-Term Desk (STIRM), Risk, and Finance to ensure regulatory compliance and strategic alignment.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years in Bank Treasury, Financial Services, or Top-Tier Consulting.
  • Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of bank balance sheet management, deposit modeling, capital planning, and European regulatory frameworks (CRR, CRD IV/V, KWG).
  • Technical Skills: Advanced Excel proficiency; strong SQL skills are a major plus.
  • Education: Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a quantitative field.

What you need to be successful:

  • Professional Experience: 3+ years of professional experience within a Top Tier consulting firm, financial services firm, or digital bank.
  • Treasury Foundations: Clear theoretical understanding and practical experience within bank treasury structures.
  • Modeling Frameworks: Strong interest or exposure to structural financial concepts such as funds transfer pricing mechanisms, capital planning and deposit modeling.
  • Technical Toolkit: Demonstrated capability handling spreadsheet applications (Excel); advanced data querying skills (SQL) are highly valued.
  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Quantitative Economics, or an equivalent technical qualification.
  • Regulatory Awareness: Solid operational understanding of the European regulatory landscape, including banking guidelines and frameworks relevant to capital, leverage, and interest rate (e.g., CRR, CRD IV, KWG frameworks).

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

description:
About Us:

What You'll Do:

LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!

The Customer Technical Architect (CTA) serves as the premier technical authority and trusted advisor for strategic enterprise accounts. Acting at the intersection of Internet Infrastructure, Cloud Migrations, and next-generation Agentic AI observability, the CTA ensures enterprise clients successfully design, integrate, scale, and monitor complex digital experiences across multi-cloud and AI-driven environments. Customer Architects will work closely across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services and Product teams to provide technical know-how, common tooling and frameworks that solve common customer problems that fall outside the current goals of the product organization and scope of professional service engagements. Customer Architects will also help to translate internal, customer and prospect requests into actionable information with clear business outcomes for the Product and Engineering organizations to be able to prioritize and address.

Here's a closer look at this key role:
Technical Architecture & Strategic Advisory

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key enterprise accounts, building trusted technical relationships with C-level executives, principal architects, and engineering leads.
  • Understand complex business and operational requirements and translate them into robust, scalable observability architectures.
  • Conduct Executive Architecture Reviews, health checks, and strategic planning sessions to align platform usage with business objectives.

Agentic AI & Modern Observability Frameworks

  • Architect and implement comprehensive observability strategies for Agentic AI, autonomous agent networks, and LLM-backed applications.
  • Leverage and advise clients on modern context protocols including Model Context Protocol (MCP), WebMCP, and tool-use interfaces to securely connect AI agents with telemetry, APIs, and data sources.
  • Establish performance and reliability metrics for autonomous agents, evaluating execution accuracy, tool selection, reasoning latency, token consumption, and agent-to-agent communication paths.
  • Guide enterprise clients in leveraging AI/ML insights to automate incident management, anomaly detection, and self-healing IT capabilities.

Enterprise Cloud Migration & Digital Experience Modernization

  • Architect pre- and post-migration observability strategies for large-scale enterprise cloud migrations (on-premise to AWS, Azure, GCP, or multi-cloud hybrid topologies).
  • Establish telemetry baselines to ensure zero degradation of digital experience, end-user latency, or application performance during complex cloud transitions.
  • Provide technical oversight on Internet pathing, DNS reliability, BGP path health, and CDN distribution performance during migration phases.

Network Pathing, Integration & API Architecture

  • Design end-to-end telemetry architectures across multi-cloud, containerized (Kubernetes), and edge application environments with deep emphasis on core Internet network pathing (BGP, DNS, TCP/IP, ISP routing, CDN).
  • Guide clients on building custom API integrations, automation workflows, and monitoring pipelines using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and custom REST/GraphQL endpoints.
  • Serve as an advanced technical escalation point to troubleshoot complex routing, latency, and digital experience challenges.

Enablement, Thought Leadership & Product Alignment

  • Deliver best-practice technical workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations to empower customer engineering and operations teams.
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, establishing a direct feedback loop with Product, Engineering, and AI R&D teams to influence product roadmaps.
  • Author technical whitepapers, architectural integration patterns, and best-practice guides for internal and customer-facing knowledge bases and technical blogs.
What You'll Need:
  • 6+ years in senior customer-facing technical roles (Customer Technical Architect, Principal Solutions Architect, Principal Customer Success Engineer, or Lead Technical Account Manager).
  • Proven track record of supporting large global enterprises, Fortune 500, or Global 2000 accounts through complex cloud and digital transformations.
  • Hands-on experience or deep understanding of building, deploying, and monitoring Agentic AI workflows, multi-agent frameworks, and LLM-driven architectures.
  • Direct exposure to emerging AI integration standards including Model Context Protocol (MCP), and custom tool-calling/agentic API interfaces.
  • Familiarity with tracking AI-specific telemetry: execution loops, context degradation, tool response latency, token consumption, model drift, and safety guardrails.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide Cloud Migration observability initiatives (monitoring application & latency impact during migration to cloud-native/Kubernetes).
  • Expert-level understanding of Internet infrastructure and network pathing: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol), ISP routing, DNS architectures, HTTP/3, SSL/TLS, and CDN distribution networks.
  • Understanding of multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native application deployment models.
  • Strong expertise in modern integration patterns, web APIs (REST, GraphQL), webhooks, and data pipelines.
  • Hands-on scripting capabilities in Python, Bash, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (Terraform,Ansible) and incident routing ecosystems (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Jira, Slack).
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and technical writing abilities with strong analytical and troubleshooting instincts.
  • Ability to articulate complex technical, network pathing, and AI architectures to C-level executives and engineering teams alike.
  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Willingness to travel periodically for key executive engagements, architectural workshops, or onsite enablement.

title: Fabrication Technician
description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

As a Fabrication Technician on our Fab team, you will own turning raw stock into finished, boat ready components. That spans setting up and running our CNC equipment, fabricating and welding metal parts, fixtures, and assemblies, and keeping our fab shop safe, organized, and moving. Day to day focus shifts between machining, welding, and general fabrication based on what the shop and the build schedule need.

We're looking for someone fired up by the mission and ready to build. You'll thrive here if you move fast, take ownership, and care about the details.

This is a full-time, on-site role at our Los Angeles headquarters.

What You'll Do

  • Setting up and operating CNC mills (3 and 5 axis), including programming parts with support from our CNC lead
  • Running manual mills and lathes for one off parts, rework, and secondary operations
  • Fabricating brackets, mounts, enclosures, and structural components from drawings, sketches, and verbal direction across Production and R&D builds
  • Cutting, bending, forming, and drilling sheet metal, plate, tube, and bar stock using saws, shears, press brakes, and drill presses
  • Welding and assembling steel, aluminum, and stainless steel parts using MIG and TIG processes
  • Deburring, tapping, finishing, and assembling machined parts
  • Building jigs, fixtures, and shop tooling that make our builds faster and more repeatable
  • Inspecting parts with calipers, micrometers, and gauges to verify dimensions and tolerances
  • Supporting engineers with rapid prototypes and sharing hands on feedback on design for manufacturability
  • Keeping the fab shop clean, safe, and stocked with consumables, tools, and materials

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands on experience in metal fabrication and machining in a production, prototype, or job shop environment
  • Experience setting up and operating CNC mills
  • Experience with MIG welding on mild steel
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and basic GD&T
  • Proficiency with precision measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, and height gauges
  • Experience with common shop equipment: bandsaws, shears, press brakes, grinders, and drill presses
  • Comfort shifting between machining, welding, and fabrication work as priorities change
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision at a fast but sustainable pace
  • Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy
  • This is an active role that will require consistent physical activity and standing for a majority of the shift
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull 50 lbs

Bonus Qualifications

  • CAM programming experience with Fusion, Mastercam, or similar
  • 5 axis CNC setup and operation
  • Experience with TIG welding aluminum or stainless steel
  • Experience in marine, automotive, aerospace, or EV manufacturing
  • Experience working with composites, fiberglass, or other nonmetallic materials
  • Familiarity with CAD tools like Fusion, SolidWorks, or NX for reviewing models and drawings
  • Comfortable pushing a fast but sustainable pace
  • Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base pay for this role is $35.50 hourly.

Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  • Healthcare benefits — 99% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision
  • Parental leave — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Generous time off — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure
  • Income protection — Life and disability insurance for all employees
  • Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access
  • Water fund — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose
  • Professional development — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend
  • Safety Support — Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe
  • Captain training — Training and access to take Arc boats out with friends and family
  • Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite
  • Relocation assistance — Available depending on role eligibility.

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

  • Ownership over both your work and the company’s success
  • Empathy for colleagues and for customers
  • Humility in problem solving and collaboration
  • Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly
  • Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

What you’ll do:

  • Conceptualize and develop compelling campaign creative from end to end – taking embryonic ideas towards their strongest possible 360 degree creative execution.
  • Create memorable films, commercials, and 360° campaigns, including brand partnership work.
  • Art direct photography and video shoots, from treatments and mood boards through to final selects.
