  • Provide meaningful feedback to in-house art directors and designers (across a breadth of disciplines, like graphic, motion, digital, video, editing, etc) across a variety of formats
  • Compellingly represent the thinking behind your team’s work to key stakeholders, creative directors and team members Compellingly represent the thinking behind your work to key stakeholders, creative directors and team members, including partnering with the US creative team to adapt flagship campaigns for EMEA markets when needed.
  • Bring depth to conceptual creative direction, art direction, and design
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to explore more ideas faster and bring concepts to life, while owning the craft and quality of the final work



What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience as an art director with an emphasis on producing film, commercials, and 360 campaigns (with 3+ of those years in a creative leadership role)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Visual Communications, Design, Advertising, or equivalent experience
  • A book of work with examples of outstanding creative across a variety of brands
  • Excellent leadership, mentorship, and interpersonal skills, with a track record of inspiring creative teams to achieve their best work

title: (2027 PhD/ABD graduates) Senior Associate (Finance Practice)
description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

CRA’s Finance practice consultants use their expertise in finance, accounting, and economics to help their clients address significant legal and regulatory issues. Typically, we are retained to quantify economic damages in the context of large, complex commercial litigation matters. Our work often requires the development of fact-specific financial models to help our clients effectively resolve disputes involving valuation issues (shareholder class actions and other corporate valuation disputes), as well as matters regarding the functioning of financial markets and institutions (alleged market manipulation and insider trading). The analyses are summarized in the form of an expert report, which sets forth our conclusory opinions (including the underlying analytical support for those opinions) in court.

Senior Associates work closely with CRA colleagues and academic experts on project teams. Successful candidates have a strong working knowledge of financial, accounting, and economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:

  • Independently conceptualize and identify issues, designing complex economic and financial models to analyze economic and financial data;
  • Guide programming, model building and/or regression analysis in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, SAS, R or Python);
  • Draw conclusions and generate insights for leading academics and senior leaders based on models and data analysis;
  • Draft and present portions of client deliverables including expert reports summarizing our opinions, conclusions, and recommendations and third party financial, market and industry data;
  • Interact directly with clients (attorneys, industry professionals and government entities) on a variety of finance, strategy and economics issues;
  • Assist regulators and financial institutions with analysis of trading on exchanges and in OTC markets for a wide spectrum of contracts;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of economic analyses and opinions;
  • Facilitate internal and client meetings (when appropriate) with effective communication;
  • Supervise, coach and delegate work to junior analysts;
  • Identify and raise potential project revenue opportunities to senior staff;
  • Assist with practice development activities (mentoring, training, recruiting, thought leadership).

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD in Finance or Accounting, graduating in late 2026 or 2027;
  • Solid working knowledge of finance, accounting, and economic empirical methodologies;
  • Command of a broad range of research and quantitative analysis skills (including strong Excel skills);
  • Curious and analytic thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritization skills.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals;
  • Academic Research Paper – please include a recent research paper.
  • Letters of Recommendation – please submit any letters of recommendation to LORsubmission@crai.com

Career Growth & Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 day a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. To learn more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA, please read here.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary and other compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $180,000 – $212,500. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position may be eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation.

CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

title: UAS Pilot/Flight Test & Mission Operator
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview:

The UAS Pilot/Flight Test & Mission Operator is based in El Segundo, California, and supports the full lifecycle of unmanned aircraft operations at CHAOS — from development, verification, validation, and production acceptance testing through fielded customer missions, demonstrations, and operational deployments. This role suits someone who thrives in dynamic, hands-on environments, is equally comfortable in a structured test-range setting and an unpredictable field deployment, and can move fluidly between rigorous test-card execution and customer-facing mission support. The role requires the ability to fly Group 1, Group 2, and Group 3 UAS platforms across a range of airframe types and propulsion systems — including fixed-wing, VTOL, multirotor, turbine, and electric ducted fan (EDF) aircraft, among others.

Depending on qualification and assignment, the operator may serve as Remote Pilot in Command, Pilot at the Controls, Ground Control Station Operator, Visual Observer, Test Conductor, Payload/Sensor Operator, Range Safety Observer, Mission Coordinator, or Test Technician. You'll be embedded with customers and engineering teams alike, integrating CHAOS systems into existing infrastructure and ensuring reliability under real-world conditions.

Beyond flying and mission support, this role carries direct ownership of the aircraft itself — building, maintaining, and repairing UAS airframes and subsystems, including composite structural repair, so platforms stay mission-ready in the field and at the range.

Responsibilities:

  • Review flight-test plans, test cards, mission objectives, engineering requirements, aircraft limitations, risk assessments, airspace/site conditions, and success, abort, and go/no-go criteria.
  • Participate in test-readiness reviews, safety reviews, preflight briefings, post-mission debriefs, and lessons-learned activities.
  • Coordinate with flight-test engineers, software and mechanical engineers, avionics personnel, maintainers, range personnel, program managers, and customer stakeholders.
  • Prepare and inspect aircraft, payloads, batteries, propulsion components, ground control stations, communications equipment, and support systems; verify configuration against approved test or mission documentation.
  • Perform preflight functional checks of flight controls, navigation, propulsion, power, command-and-control links, payloads, sensors, contingency modes, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Operate across Group 1, Group 2, and Group 3 UAS platforms as assigned — including fixed-wing, VTOL, multirotor, turbine, EDF, and other propulsion systems — adapting procedures, checklists, and risk controls to the size, weight, speed, and complexity of each class of aircraft.
  • Execute test cards or mission plans within approved operating limitations, making clear callouts for aircraft state, test-point or mission status, hazards, anomalies, and abort conditions.
  • Maintain situational awareness of aircraft position, airspeed, altitude, heading, telemetry, battery condition, airspace, personnel, obstacles, and environmental conditions throughout flight.
  • Initiate hold, abort, contingency, or emergency actions whenever unexpected behavior, configuration discrepancies, or uncontrolled hazards occur.
  • Operate electro-optical, infrared, mapping, or other mission and inspection payloads when qualified, and verify collected data meets test or mission requirements.
  • Record test-point completion, mission results, operator observations, aircraft behavior, timing, and deviations from expected performance; preserve and annotate telemetry, video, flight logs, and instrumentation data.
  • Prepare discrepancy reports, anomaly reports, test summaries, flight logs, maintenance notifications, and production-acceptance or mission-deliverable records.
  • Support troubleshooting, fault isolation, regression testing, and hardware/software-in-the-loop testing, and provide operator feedback on handling qualities, human-machine interfaces, and procedures.
  • Protect customer information and maintain data integrity during collection, transfer, storage, and delivery.
  • Maintain accountability for aircraft, tools, batteries, spares, vehicles, and field-support equipment.
  • Build, assemble, and configure UAS airframes and subsystems from component and kit-level parts, including structural, propulsion, avionics, and payload integration.
  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of UAS airframes, propulsion systems, control surfaces, wiring harnesses, and payload mounts.
  • Inspect, repair, and fabricate composite structures (carbon fiber, fiberglass, and sandwich-core panels) using lay-up, bonding, patch-repair, and finishing techniques appropriate to airframe requirements.
  • Diagnose structural and material damage (delamination, cracking, impact damage) and determine appropriate repair, rework, or scrap disposition in accordance with engineering guidance.
  • Document build configurations, repair actions, materials used, and cure/inspection records to maintain airframe traceability and configuration control.
  • Willing to travel (typically 50%+) to customer and test sites for deployments, troubleshooting, and mission support, both CONUS and OCONUS.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Current FAA Remote Pilot Certificate with a Small UAS Rating, or ability to obtain one before conducting independent operations.
  • At least two years of UAS operations, flight testing, aviation maintenance, avionics, military aviation, robotics testing, or comparable technical experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to configure, inspect, and safely operate remotely piloted aircraft across fixed-wing, multirotor, rotary-wing, or hybrid platforms, including transmitter/receiver setup, flight-mode programming, command-and-control links, and failsafe configuration.
  • Ability to fly Group 1, Group 2, and Group 3 UAS platforms, with demonstrated proficiency across fixed-wing, VTOL, multirotor, turbine, EDF, and other propulsion systems, and transitioning between aircraft of different sizes, weights, and performance envelopes.
  • Ability to interpret test plans, test cards, mission plans, engineering drawings, technical manuals, checklists, and aircraft limitations.
  • Working knowledge of aircraft systems, flight controls, propulsion, electrical systems, navigation, communications, telemetry, airspace, and aviation weather.
  • Strong technical writing, observation, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to remain calm and make clear safety callouts under abnormal or emergency conditions.
  • Demonstrated experience building, maintaining, and repairing UAS or model-aircraft airframes and subsystems, including propulsion, wiring, and structural components.
  • Working knowledge of composite materials (carbon fiber, fiberglass, foam-core) and basic repair techniques such as bonding, patching, and lay-up appropriate to small unmanned aircraft.
  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and basic fabrication or repair equipment in a shop or field-maintenance environment.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to remote test and customer locations, including outdoor work in varying terrain and weather.
  • Ability to satisfy customer, program, export-control, background, and drug-testing requirements applicable to assigned work.
  • Must currently hold, or be able to obtain and maintain, a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Associate or bachelor's degree in aerospace, aviation, engineering technology, unmanned systems, electronics, geography/surveying, or a related field.
  • Three or more years of flight-test, UAS, experimental-aircraft, developmental-testing, or fielded-mission experience across multiple aircraft configurations.
  • Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, Mission Planner, QGroundControl, ATAK, or comparable flight and ground-control software.
  • Experience with electro-optical, infrared, LiDAR, multispectral, mapping, or other stabilized mission payloads.
  • Knowledge of test-readiness reviews, test-card discipline, envelope expansion, requirements verification, and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with controlled-airspace, night, operations-over-people, waiver-supported, or beyond-visual-line-of-sight operations.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Git, MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW, or other engineering and issue-tracking tools.
  • Military UAS operator, air vehicle operator, instructor/standardization operator, test pilot, or flight-test engineering background.
  • Experience operating under a Safety Management System, AS9100, or formal configuration/quality-management process.
  • Formal training or hands-on experience in composite fabrication and repair (carbon fiber, fiberglass, sandwich-core structures), such as composite-repair coursework, aerospace manufacturing, or model-aircraft/RC fabrication background.
  • Experience building or scratch-fabricating fixed-wing, multirotor, or hybrid UAS airframes, including 3D printing, CNC, or composite lay-up techniques.
  • Experience with structural repair documentation, non-destructive inspection methods, or airframe damage assessment.

Required Competencies:

  • Procedural discipline, test-card and checklist execution, configuration awareness, technical observation, and anomaly recognition.
  • Aeronautical decision-making, crew resource management, risk management, and situational awareness.
  • Cross-functional communication, technical troubleshooting, and professional customer-facing presence.
  • Accurate technical documentation, attention to detail, composure under pressure, and willingness to exercise stop-work authority.
  • Hands-on mechanical aptitude for airframe build, maintenance, and composite structural repair.

Physical & Work Requirements:

  • Work at flight-test ranges, airports, laboratories, manufacturing facilities, and remote/outdoor field sites in variable weather and terrain.
  • Stand, walk, kneel, or remain at a control station for extended periods; lift or carry up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Manipulate tools, connectors, batteries, aircraft components, computers, and ground-support equipment; wear required personal protective equipment.
  • Work early mornings, evenings, nights, weekends, or extended test/mission windows, and travel for multi-day campaigns.


Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 350 employees and counting across 5 global offices
Salary Range: $130,000-$180,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

title: National Registry Acct. Mgr. & Training Lead

Department: Compliance Services

FLSA Status: Salaried Non-Exempt

Responsibilities

The National Registry of CPE Sponsors is a program offered by NASBA to recognize CPE program sponsors who provide continuing professional education (CPE) programs in accordance with nationally recognized standards. CPE program sponsors receive approved status on the Registry by demonstrating compliance with The Statement on Standards for Continuing Professional Education (CPE) Programs (Standards) as well as NASBA Registry program requirements.

As Account Manager and Training Lead, the employee will review and analyze National Registry Applications and CPE programs for compliance with the Standards and education quality. This position also serves as an internal resource for Account Managers by providing training, standards guidance, review support, and specialized expertise in QAS™ Self Study, Nano Learning, and Blended Learning. Responsibilities and duties include:

· Analyze QAS™ self-study, Nano and Blended Learning CPE programs for instructional design quality and compliance with the Standards.

· Analyze group programs for compliance with the Standards and educational quality.

· Review applications to the National Registry, including program course list; promotional materials or course announcements; administrative policies; evaluation forms; and certificates of completion.

· Perform compliance desk audits of sponsors.

· Create formal correspondence to sponsors including requests for additional materials, revisions to application materials, and instructional design checklist and instructional design review recommendations for compliance. Ensure CPE-related databases and spreadsheets are maintained and appropriate follow-up is made for all CPE programs.

· Answer CPE-related inquiries and requests from CPAs, state accountancy boards and sponsors.

· Serve as the primary trainer and onboarding resource for National Registry Account Managers, including training on the Standards, Registry policies, review processes, systems, and application procedures.

· Develop and maintain training materials, job aids, guidance and other resources used by Account Managers.

· Support the administration of Salesforce and Form Assembly by maintaining templates, workflows, and resolving operational issues, along with identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and data quality.

· Educational Research: Researching sponsor questions, educational processes to provide justification for the Standards, and new concepts introduced by sponsors or staff members.

· Participate in National Registry Summit and assist in LinkedIn Page content creation.

· Perform other duties, including administrative/clerical, as required in support of the Registry team’s activities, conferences, committee projects, public relations efforts, etc.

· Other duties may be assigned.


Supervisory Responsibilities: None.


Internal Relationships: This position interacts closely with the Associate Director, National Registry, Sr. Manager, National Registry, Compliance Auditors, and other Registry Account Managers


External Relationships: This position interacts primarily with existing and potential sponsors on the Registry (CPE learning providers) and, to a lesser degree, the personnel of State Boards of Accountancy, other regulatory agencies, and the personnel of State CPA Societies.

title: Software Engineer, Conversational Products & Agent Workflows
description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Software Engineer, Conversational Products & Agent Workflows
Customer Agent

About the Role

At Klaviyo, we believe the future of software lies not only in tools that help people work more efficiently, but in intelligent systems that can take action, learn from outcomes, and improve customer experiences over time.

Klaviyo serves more than 167,000 customers and processes billions of consumer profiles, messages, interactions, and conversion signals. This creates a unique opportunity to build state-of-the-art AI systems that help businesses create and execute better customer experiences at scale.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Conversational Products & Agent Workflows to join the Customer Agent team, Klaviyo’s AI-native conversational platform. You’ll help build scalable backend systems and AI-powered product experiences that enable agents to retrieve context, use tools, and take reliable action on behalf of customers.

This is a backend-heavy role with opportunities to contribute to user-facing experiences. You’ll independently own meaningful pieces of larger systems, contribute to technical decisions, and continue developing your depth across backend engineering, applied AI, and production reliability.

How You Will Make a Difference

  • Build and improve reliable backend systems and APIs that power AI-driven customer experiences.
  • Develop production agentic features involving tool use, context management, retrieval, structured outputs, orchestration, and multi-step workflows.
  • Contribute to solving applied AI problems across retrieval and RAG, grounding, hallucination mitigation, model selection, and choosing between LLM-based, deterministic, or hybrid approaches.
  • Build and use evaluation approaches including representative datasets, automated and human evaluation, regression testing, qualitative error analysis, and production signals.
  • Improve system reliability through guardrails, retries, fallbacks, observability, monitoring, and thoughtful failure handling.
  • Build asynchronous and distributed processing workflows that support AI workloads at scale.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and help diagnose, mitigate, and learn from production incidents.
  • Work with external customers and cross-functional partners to understand workflows, identify pain points, and translate feedback into product improvements.
  • Monitor shipped experiences and use quality metrics, system performance, and customer feedback to guide iteration.

Who You Are

  • You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with experience building backend systems or distributed applications.
  • You have hands-on experience building or contributing to generative AI or agentic AI applications, ideally used by real users or in production environments.
  • You are proficient in Python and have experience with modern backend frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
  • You have experience with asynchronous processing or distributed task/event systems such as Celery, Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or Redis.
  • You have working knowledge of databases, data modeling, APIs, and persistence patterns used in production systems.
  • You are comfortable working in cloud environments and have experience with technologies such as AWS, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, or CI/CD systems.
  • You can reason about tradeoffs among quality, latency, cost, reliability, and implementation complexity, and know when to seek additional technical context.
  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity, breaking larger problems into smaller pieces, and making progress without every requirement being fully specified.
  • You have experience with, or strong interest in, working directly with external customers to understand problems and improve products.
  • You care about shipping useful, reliable products and are motivated to deepen your engineering judgment in a rapidly evolving technical space.

Nice to Have

  • Experience training, fine-tuning, distilling, or otherwise adapting machine learning or language models.
  • Experience with reinforcement learning or feedback-driven optimization.
  • Experience with evaluation infrastructure such as LLM-as-judge systems, evaluator calibration, benchmark datasets, or AI quality tooling.
  • Experience operating AI systems at meaningful production scale or optimizing inference cost, latency, or throughput.

The Quality Assurance and Ingredient Chemistry (Senior) Manager (Scientist) is a key member of the Science team and reports to the Senior Director, Scientific and Regulatory Affairs. In addition, this role will provide cross-functional support and expertise in ingredient chemistry, composition, and nomenclature as needed.

Quality Assurance Leadership

Serve as the primary liaison to the Quality Committee and provide strategic leadership in the development and execution of industry-wide quality assurance initiatives, including:

  • MoCRA Implementation: Address all areas related to Quality and GMPs that impact the industry under the law and pending regulations.
  • Quality Workshop: Plan and coordinate the annual Quality Workshop held in conjunction with the PCPC Science Symposium.
  • GMP Outreach and Education: Develop topics and content for mini-workshops and webinars in anticipation of new cosmetic GMP regulations.
  • PCPC Quality Guidelines: Lead the update of the PCPC Quality Guidelines following FDA’s publication of proposed GMP regulations.
  • ISO TC-217 Support: Contribute to the ISO TC-217 Technical Advisory Group by assessing proposed standards related to GMPs and analytical methods.
  • Quality Metrics: Evaluate the continuation and scope of the annual Quality Metrics Survey.
  • Manufacturing Hygiene: Support initiatives related to manufacturing hygiene and collaborative educational programs with academic partners.
  • International GMP Monitoring: Support tracking of global legislative activity related to GMPs and provide feedback as appropriate. Collaborate with the European Federation of Cosmetic Ingredients (EFfCI) on training and review of the EFfCI GMP Guideline.

Ingredient Chemistry & Technical Expertise

Provide expert technical guidance on ingredient chemistry, composition, and nomenclature, including:

  • Ingredient Identification: Support and collaborate with the Global Strategies team as needed to identify and analyze ingredients or substances of interest or concern regulatory lists, publications, and other sources.
  • International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI): Provide support to the INCI team, as needed, in the development of standardized nomenclature for cosmetic ingredients and publication of related information in INCIpedia.
  • Cosmetic Ingredient Review (CIR): Provide technical support to CIR, as needed, for information related to ingredient chemistry and manufacture.
  • Regulatory Awareness: Interpret international regulatory developments to ensure the continued alignment of the INCI Nomenclature program with global standards.

Organizational Support

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
BisectHosting is hiring a Senior Security Engineer to take ownership of security across our entire business, from infrastructure and application security to employee awareness and internal operations.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, startup-like environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and isn't afraid to get their hands dirty. You'll have the freedom and responsibility to identify risks, set priorities, and implement solutions without needing constant direction.

This is a highly hands-on role. One day you might be reviewing code for vulnerabilities, the next conducting penetration tests, securing internal tools, or training employees on social engineering risks. You'll work directly with engineering and leadership to build practical security measures that protect our customers, employees, and infrastructure without unnecessarily slowing down the business.

What you'll work on:

  • Own and continuously improve security across applications, infrastructure, internal systems, and business operations
  • Conduct security-focused code reviews, identify vulnerabilities, and work directly with engineers to implement fixes
  • Perform hands-on penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across web applications, APIs, networks, and infrastructure
  • Secure internal and external APIs through proper authentication, authorization, access controls, and credential management
  • Own identity and access management (IAM), including employee permissions, role-based access controls, least-privilege policies, and regular access audits
  • Establish practical security standards for internal tools, third-party services, cloud environments, and production infrastructure
  • Lead employee security awareness initiatives, including phishing simulations, social engineering testing, and security training
  • Identify risks in everyday employee workflows and implement technical or procedural safeguards to reduce exposure
  • Implement and maintain security monitoring, vulnerability scanning, threat detection, and incident response processes
  • Build automated security checks into development workflows, including code scanning, dependency auditing, and CI/CD security controls
  • Investigate security incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventative improvements
  • Independently identify, prioritize, and execute security initiatives based on business risk and impact
  • Work across departments to solve security problems, even when they fall outside traditional engineering responsibilities

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify risks, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and business stakeholders.

title: Horse Wrangler (Motor Vehicle Operator)
description:
You will serve as a Horse Wrangler (Motor Vehicle Operator) with Bureau of Land Management. This position is located within the Department of the Interior, Bureau of Land Management at the following locations: Fallon, Nevada Reno, Nevada Winnemucca, Nevada Hines, Oregon Wheatland, Wyoming WG-07: First time hires to the Federal government normally start at the step 1 rate.

This position is located within the Bureau of Land Management's (BLM) Wild Horse and Burro (WH&B) Program, focusing on operations at a WH&B holding facility. The incumbent is responsible for the well-being and welfare of WH&Bs, which includes their comprehensive care, feeding, safe handling, preparation for adoption, veterinary treatment, and facility maintenance. The work of the position involves interacting with the public and adopters. The job duties are subject to requirements of the Comprehensive Animal Welfare Program (CAWP). Some of the major duties you will perform include but are not limited to the following: Receives WH&Bs from trucks and trailers into the corral system and separates them by gender. Ensures WH&Bs are handled safely in trucks, corrals, and chutes during the unloading process. Given the unpredictable and potentially hazardous nature of transporting WH&Bs for extended periods, the incumbent must adeptly handle WH&Bs to mitigate any risks of injury to the animals, themselves, and fellow workers. Operates up to 36-foot horse trailers (e.g., gooseneck and bumper pull) and other similar length trailers to haul WH&Bs. Loads, arranges, and transports WH&Bs according to BLM guidelines to ensure the safest and most comfortable transportation to reduce the incidents of injuries or deaths. Selects routes and identifies alternative routes. Trucks may be operated within facilities, over highways, interstates, off-road and in rough terrain in all weather conditions. Rides and handles saddle horses to safely control WH&Bs from horseback on the open range, in corrals and in pen areas for gathers or general care. Controls individual WH&Bs unwilling to enter traps or corral systems as well as ropes WH&Bs from horseback if the situation dictates. Operates various types of trucks or other motor vehicles with gross vehicle weights up to 26,000 pounds to haul hay, manure, dirt, gravel, water or other supplies, materials, and equipment related to WH&Bs for specific assignments or regularly established schedules. Trucks may be operated within facilities, over highways, interstates, off-road, and in rough terrain in all weather conditions. As required, troubleshoots and performs basic maintenance and seeks assistance from others when major maintenance is needed.

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National. Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service. Direct Deposit participation required. Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more, visit https://www.e-verify.gov/. Pre-employment and random drug testing are required. You will not be appointed to the position if a verified positive drug test is received. You cannot hold an active real estate license, nor can you have an interest or hold stocks in firms with interest in Federal Lands. Firearm qualification and certification are required for the role, and ongoing proficiency must be maintained. Skill and ability to ride horse back and rope Wild Horse & Burros or other closely related stock. As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you may be required to serve a 1-year probationary period or 2-year trial period to evaluate your fitness and whether your continuation of employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, the agency will consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. title: Podiatrist - Program Manager - Psychiatric Assessment and Clinical Center (PACC)
description:
This position serves as a Program Manager/Team Lead/Supervisory Psychiatrist for Psychiatric Assessment and Clinical Center (PACC) at the American Lake Division of the VA Puget Sound Health Care System (VAPSHCS) Tacoma WA. In this capacity, the physician serves as the Program Manager of PACC for the Mental Health Service Line.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package. The Psychiatric Assessment and Clinical Center (PACC)/Same Day Access (SDA) services at the American Lake Division of VA Puget Sound Health Care System provides urgent and walk-in mental health services to Veterans who are experiencing acute psychiatric conditions that are interfering with day-to-day functioning. PACC staff triage, evaluate, and manage Veterans requesting mental health services due to a wide variety of psychiatric conditions including major depressive disorder, bipolar disorder,psychotic disorder, PTSD, anxiety disorders, dementia with behavioral disturbances, delirium, dual diagnosed Veterans, and Veterans who present as imminent risk of harm to self and/or others (i.e. suicidal, homicidal, gravely disabled). In addition, PACC is also able to provide follow up medication management care in a less restrictive environment to Veterans who are in crisis but do not require admission to high intensity inpatient psychiatry, through the Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP). PACC is also the entry point for new Veterans seeking to establish treatment in mental health services, and provides assessment and care coordination of Veterans who are new to mental health. Duties may include: Provides broad program management responsibilities of a clinical care team, including leadership in the development, implementation, evaluation, and oversight of a complex program responsible for comprehensive clinical care of Veterans. Responsible for the development, implementation, and oversight of operational policies and procedures for the treatment team, with the approval of the affiliated Program Director and/or Service Line Leader. Organizes and leads team meetings in order to facilitate case disposition, care management, effective delivery of clinical interventions, and the adherence to administrative demands. Functions as the first line supervising authority (i.e., rater) for 7 employees. For these individuals, the incumbent provides administrative, as well as clinical, supervision and/or consultation as appropriate. Provides comprehensive psychiatric assessment and diagnostic services for Veterans with a broad range of psychopathology receiving care within the Psychiatric Assessment and Clinical Center (PACC), Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP),including services for patients with complex psychopathology requiring advanced diagnostic and intervention skills. Work Schedule: Monday through Friday 8am - 4:30pm Telework: ADHOC only Virtual: This is not a virtual position. title: CONTRACT SPECIALIST
description:
THIS IS A NATIONAL GUARD TITLE 5 EXCEPTED SERVICE POSITION. This National Guard position is for a CONTRACT SPECIALIST, Position Description Number T0047000 and is part of the OH USPFO, National Guard. The primary purpose of this position is to ensure successful market research, acquisition planning, contract award, contract performance management, and interpretation of contract law.

As a CONTRACT SPECIALIST, GS-1102-12, you will perform the following duties: 1. Plans the overall approach to meet contracting program objectives for a variety of requirements with multiple complexities. Analyzes difficult/controversial contracting issues, determines, recommends and/or implements course of action which may depart from previous approaches for long-term contract performance or short-term contracts with extremely stringent time frames. Provides business advice and assistance to technical personnel involved in the development of the performance work statement/statement of work/statement of objectives or data requirements. Reviews a diverse variety of requisition packages for adequacy and compliance with administrative, regulatory, and procedural requirements and consistency with current market practices and conditions. 2. Oversees the procurement of a wide variety of services, supplies, construction and architect and engineering. Researches, interprets, analyzes, and applies all regulations, business and industry practices, market trends, Government Accountability Office (GAO) and Comptroller General decisions, public law, case law, and precedents. Devises special terms, provisions, clauses, and conditions applicable to the solicitation and contract as required. Ensures that the price schedule is properly structured and determines sources to be solicited. Prepares solicitation, amendment, and contract documents incorporating applicable terms, conditions, provisions and clauses. Receives and performs oversight of quotes/bids/proposals evaluations and determines the acceptability of offers based on an analysis of financial and technical information gained. 3. Executes post-award contract performance management actions on assigned contracts. Appoints Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs) within delegated authority and manages the COR program as required. Evaluates contractor performance for compliance with terms and conditions of contracts and ensures timely submission of contract deliverables and performance metrics. Makes field site visits, if necessary, detecting and correcting labor standards violations, taking appropriate action to expedite delivery or performance when required by mission changes, monitoring the contractor's use of government-furnished property inventories, and issuing change orders as necessary. Obtains additional funds or de-obligates funds as necessary. 4. Serves as business advisor to a wide range of customers. Represents the interest of the organization in a professional manner in meetings and various contacts outside the agency on a variety of issues that often are not well defined. Provides business advice, guidance, training, and assistance to team members, technical or program personnel, functional commanders, and/or contractors on contractual language, legal responsibilities, acquisition and business-related issues. Assists in providing interpretation/clarification to contractors and customers on contractual language, contractual and federal/state/local regulatory requirements, and business opportunities. Prepares correspondence, reports, memoranda or other documents and briefings (scheduled or ad hoc) that support contractual actions or recommendations. Performs other duties as assigned. *The above duty description does not contain all details of the official position description. title: Senior AI Applied Software Engineer  (Android)
description:
The Job in Short

At Backbase, we build secure, enterprise-grade digital banking software used every day by millions of people worldwide. As a Senior AI Applied Engineer with mobile depth, you will help design, build, and evolve the Backbase Mobile Platform and the product capabilities around it.

You bring deep expertise in Android. Using AI-assisted and agentic ways of working, you will contribute across mobile platforms and the wider product stack, including UI, delivery pipelines, testing, and documentation.

This role combines mobile craftsmanship with broad product ownership. We are looking for an engineer who can make sound platform-specific decisions, use agents to move effectively through unfamiliar technology, and remain accountable for the quality, security, and business outcome of everything they ship.

Meet the Job

You will join a multidisciplinary squad responsible for delivering end-to-end digital banking capabilities, from initial discovery and technical design to release, adoption, and production support. You will solve complex product and engineering problems that cross platform and system boundaries.

As a senior engineer, you will be a technical authority within your area of depth and a force multiplier for the wider team. You will shape architecture, review critical changes, mentor peers, lead complex investigations, and create reusable patterns and automation that improve how teams work.

AI agents are a normal part of your engineering workflow. You will use them to investigate codebases, compare implementation options, create prototypes, generate and maintain tests, diagnose failures, automate repetitive work, and deliver changes beyond your strongest platform. You will define clear constraints and success criteria, evaluate the evidence, and never treat generated output as inherently correct.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, test, and maintain complex mobile applications, frameworks, libraries, and SDK capabilities for Android.
  • Lead product features across the full software development lifecycle, from ambiguous requirements and architectural design through implementation, release, observability, and continuous improvement.
  • Use AI coding agents and automated workflows to accelerate delivery across iOS, Android, APIs, services, and CI/CD without lowering engineering standards.
  • Decompose complex work into bounded, verifiable tasks; equip agents with the right context and constraints; and critically review, test, and refine their output.
  • Contribute safely outside your primary area of depth by learning unfamiliar systems quickly, following local conventions, and seeking appropriate domain review.
  • Design maintainable architectures and clear APIs while balancing performance, accessibility, security, privacy, resilience, scalability, and cost.
  • Build modern native user experiences with SwiftUI and UIKit and/or Jetpack Compose and established Android view systems.
  • Apply platform concurrency models correctly and investigate difficult runtime, threading, memory, networking, and performance problems.
  • Establish strong quality feedback loops through automated tests, static analysis, observability, evaluation, and production signals.
  • Improve modularisation, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, developer tooling, and engineering documentation.
  • Lead technical design discussions, code reviews, root-cause analysis, incident learning, and significant refactoring initiatives.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, architects, security specialists, and engineers across the stack to turn user needs into measurable product outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers and promote responsible AI use, transparent decision-making, disciplined experimentation, and continuous learning.

Who you are

  • You have 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience building complex products and have operated effectively at senior level.
  • You have deep production expertise in at least one native mobile ecosystem: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK and Jetpack libraries, Coroutines and Flow, Gradle, and the Android build and release lifecycle.
  • You have designed scalable mobile architectures using patterns such as MVI, MVVM, VIPER, Clean Architecture, or equivalent approaches.
  • You have experience building modular applications, reusable libraries, frameworks, or SDKs with stable and well-designed APIs.
  • You are strong in automated testing, debugging, profiling, CI/CD, release automation, and mobile non-functional requirements.
  • You have hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents in production software delivery and can show how they improved an outcome—not only how they generated code.
  • You understand the limitations and risks of agentic development, including incorrect output, missing context, insecure code, dependency risk, privacy, and over-automation, and you use verification and human review accordingly.
  • You are willing and able to work across both mobile platforms and adjacent systems. Existing depth in both iOS and Android is highly valued, but deep expertise in one plus evidence of effective cross-platform contribution is sufficient.
  • You turn ambiguous business problems into testable technical plans, anticipate cross-system impacts, and communicate trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You take ownership of outcomes, support colleagues and customers when needed, and balance rapid delivery with long-term platform health.
  • You communicate effectively in English and work well in an international, multidisciplinary environment.

Bonus points

  • Strong production experience in both native iOS and native Android.
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, or another cross-platform mobile technology.
  • Experience building AI-enabled product capabilities using model APIs, retrieval, evaluation datasets, guardrails, observability, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Experience with mobile security, accessibility, performance optimisation, SDK development, or enterprise application distribution.
  • Experience in banking, fintech, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience with cloud services, backend APIs, web applications, or data pipelines that support mobile products.
What We Offer
  • Growth: €1,000 annual self-development budget, a clear promotion path, and dedicated time for training.
  • Rewards: Competitive base salary plus an annual bonus and referral bonuses.
  • Hybrid Work: A flexible arrangement combining remote work with our vibrant Kraków office.
  • Office Perks: Daily lunches, community breakfasts on Wednesdays, and high-end hardware (MacBook).
  • Well-being: Private healthcare (Luxmed), Headspace app subscription, and a Work-From-Home allowance.
  • Culture: Integration events, flexible working hours, and a focus on healthy work-life balance.

Professional Experience & Soft Skills • Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating a structured design process, user research case studies, wireframes, prototypes, and final high-fidelity UI designs. • Communication: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions, research findings, and rationale to technical teams and business stakeholders. • Experience: Typically 3+ years of professional experience as a UI/UX Designer, Interaction Designer, or Product Designer.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

The job

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineers to join Flo Health. You will be developing groundbreaking features that leverage our medical expertise, technical skills, rapid adoption of new technologies (like LLMs), product knowledge, and a deep understanding of our users’ needs. If you’re passionate about technology, especially advancements in generative AI, and driven by delivering value to users, we would love to hear from you!

Your Experience

Must have:

  • 4+ years of professional experience in the field of machine learning
  • Demonstrated success in building and deploying large-scale machine learning models; experience with large-scale LLM applications is a bonus
  • Ability to devise creative solutions to intricate technical challenges, including experience in systems design with the ability to architect and explain ML/LLM pipelines
  • Strong Python programming skills for efficient model development and deployment
  • Experience with both traditional ML and modern LLM frameworks
  • Understanding of the entire ML/LLM development process, including CI/CD, version control, testing, MLOps/LLMOps, and agile methodologies
  • Experience in building and managing data pipelines using tools like Apache Spark
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with diverse teams
  • Commitment to responsible AI practices, including fairness, accountability, and transparency

Nice to have:

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field
  • Familiarity with statistical and measurement fundamentals and running and evaluating AB tests
  • Data visualisation skills
  • Experience in the MedTech domain

What you'll be doing

You'll be responsible for:

  • Explore, develop and test complex ML/AI systems to improve female health
  • Work with state-of-the-art technologies, such as most advanced LLMs and Generative AI approaches, to build solutions that are medically safe and work at scale
  • Work in a fast-paced environment to quickly build and validate product hypotheses, taking end-to-end ownership of ML/AI products
  • Build the future-proof infrastructure for serving Gen AI features at Flo, bringing our AI vision and strategy to life
  • Constantly improve our technical capabilities by researching and implementing best practices in the context of the fastly evolving space of LLMs
  • Work in a cross-functional setup alongside other engineering (ML, Backend, QA), product, and analytics teams
Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience)
£130,000—£180,000 GBP

How we work

We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.

You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it.

What you'll get

We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:

  • Competitive salary and annual reviews
  • Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme
  • Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave
  • Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents
  • Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support
  • In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office
  • 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary
  • Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks

Diversity, equity and inclusion

Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants.

title: NEPA Practitioner/Specialist
description:
Mabbett & Associates, Inc. (Mabbett®), an award-winning and industry leading environmental, health and safety, and engineering consulting firm servicing is seeking a full-time, experienced National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Practitioner/Specialist to join our team. Demonstrated experience in the implementation of the NEPA program, including early project planning support, document review, NEPA record development and tracking, training, and coordination with client program and project managers.


This position will coordinate and collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams, conduct impact analyses for environmental compliance documents, participate in project-related meetings, as well as perform other related and miscellaneous tasks.

Responsibilities include:

  • Collect, organize, and review project information needed for initial environmental reviews.
  • Assist with the development, review, and coordination of NEPA Recs, CATEX documentation, EAs, and EISs.
  • Review primary and supporting documents for completeness, consistency, and alignment with client procedures.
  • Maintain NEPA project trackers, records, schedules, status reports, etc.
  • Support preparation of NEPA-related briefings, guidance, training materials, meeting summaries, data calls and communications.
  • Assist with NEPA stakeholder and public outreach activities, including preparation of draft outreach materials, meeting logistics, comment tracking, and documentation support.
  • Review project information for potential environmental considerations, including land or facility modifications, air emissions, waste, chemical use, biological materials, radiation, noise, utility impacts, cultural resources, public health and safety, and other relevant factors.
  • Support the development and tracking of NEPA mitigation measures and associated follow-up activities.

This position will a full-time, on-site position a client site located in Washington, DC and will include occasional travel for project opportunities on a short-term basis throughout the U.S.


About the Firm

Mabbett, established in 1980, provides integrated multi-disciplinary EH&S, and architectural-engineering design services. For 46 years, Mabbett has delivered value-added professional services to Federal, state, local agencies and industry, and commercial enterprise. Mabbett is a US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Center for Verification and Evaluation (CVE), and verified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB).


Our vision is to Reduce Humanity’s Negative Impacts on Earth and our mission is to build a better future through protecting and restoring the natural environment; support a healthy workforce; develop, mentor, and retain a staff of highly qualified dedicated professionals; and provide exceptional service and sustainable solutions to our clients.


Headquartered in Stoneham, Massachusetts with regional offices in North Smithfield, Rhode Island; Plainview, New York, Alexandria, Virginia, and Mount Pleasant, South Carolina, Mabbett is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.


A comprehensive benefits package is offered to eligible employees, including: Blue Cross/Blue Shield medical insurance; Delta Dental insurance; Blue Cross 20/20 Vision plan; 401(k) plan with a company match; profit sharing retirement plan; performance and year-end bonus programs; group life, short and long-term disability, professional development programs and much more.


Any applicant who is unable to use or requires assistance with the online application process may request an accommodation by contacting Human Resources at: (781) 275-6050 or via email at careers@mabbett.com.

title: Medical Instrument Technician (Polysomnography)
description:
The Medical Instrument Technician (Polysomnography) performs a wide variety of polysomnographic studies in the sleep laboratory; routine polysomnogram, PAP titration studies including CPAP, Bi-level, ASV technologies, in the Sleep Center. The incumbent is also responsible for education of veterans and family members, as well as following all technical and hospital, federal and state regulations. Work may be done at night or day in the hospital sleep lab, and may include inpatient procedures.

The incumbent will serve as a Medical Instrument in the Sleep Center and will perform a wide variety of polysomnographic studies in the sleep laboratory; routine polysomnogram, PAP titration studies including CPAP, Bi-level, ASV technologies. The incumbent will also have responsibility for education of veterans and family members as well as following all technical and hospital, federal and state regulations as well as following recommendations of the AASM, JCAHO, BRPT, and the AAST. The incumbent needs to have a high level understanding of high and low filters, sensitivities, gain, AC/DC filters and inputs, bio-calibrations, machine calibrations, and also needs high level understanding of instrumentation and electrical safety. This can be accomplished through journals, attending educational conferences, etc. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Carries out the above duties in accordance with the standard procedures for performing, scoring, and reviewing Polysomnography and other sleep studies. Attends monthly staff meetings and educational opportunities. Troubleshoots and repairs EEG, EKG, EOG, EMG, and respiratory monitoring equipment, as necessary. Recognizes when a situation is above his/her skill level and asks for assistance of the supervisor.. Timely and accurate with patient hook up utilizing the international 10-20 system of measurement. Delivers compassionate quality care to our veteran population. Educates the veteran and his/her family on the procedures that are performed. Involves the veteran and his/her family in regards to decisions about sleep testing and therapy. Titrates patients on CPAP therapy devices, bi-level titration devices, and auto-servo ventilation devices. Recognizes when a change in device type is required to adequately treat the veteran. Demonstrates effective written and verbal communication. Demonstrates the ability to recognize and treat complex patients and can readily adapt to changing situations. Demonstrates the ability to learn to titrate patients who have the Inspire device. Programs and coordinates the initiation of home sleep study devices with patients. Follows all Joint Commission, VA, OSHA, etc safety policies and procedures including infection control and equipment usage. Accurately and timely records patient treatment, progress notes, etc into patient records via CPRS based program. Provides all statistical data including encounter forms in a timely manner. Information provided is complete, accurate, and work is performed within prescribed timeframes. Completes the required VA hours of training/education annually including mandatory training. title: Certified Medication Aide (CMA)
description:
Under the supervision of a Licensed Nurse, the Certified Medication Aide (CMA) prepares and administers medications and performs duties consistent with those of a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA).


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, administer, and document medications in accordance with accepted practices, policies, and regulatory requirements under the direction and supervision of a Licensed Nurse.
  • Assist residents with activities of daily living (ADLs), including bathing, grooming, toileting, changing bed linens, and positioning in and out of beds or chairs; support resident recreational activities; prepare residents for meals and snacks; assist with feeding as needed; and accurately record food and fluid intake.

title: Medical Instrument Technician Advanced-Gastroenterology
description:
The Advanced Medical Instrument Technician (MIT) is a member of the Gastroenterology Procedure Team (GPT) provides assistance to the physician, nurse manager, registered nurse, & other team members during diagnostic examinations or medical treatment procedures as part of the diagnosis and treatment of patients. The MIT participates with the GPT members in planning & implementing complex procedures under the general supervision of the physician, nurse manager, & registered nurse.

Functions as a primary person responsible for knowledge and handling instruments, supplies, and equipment during GI procedures, such as but not limited to: argon plasma cautery, colonoscopy, cytology, digestive tract biopsies, esophageal banding, esophageal biopsy, esophageal dilation, esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD), percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG), polypectomies, sigmoidoscopy, BARRX (RFA), and endoscopic mucosal resections (EMR). Place IT ticket requests and/or contact Biomed for equipment issues and notifying GI Manager and/or Charge Nurse as issues arise. Prepares procedural rooms for the performance of GI procedures, including the set-up/ testing of the video imaging system, computers and monitors, cautery units, pill cameras, data collectors, appropriate endoscope for procedure, specialized accessories and supplies. Responsible for performing Fibroscans and reporting results to liver providers. Turns procedure rooms over within an average of ten-minute time frame. Responsible for demonstrating and maintaining full competency in the use pre-cleaning of reusable medical equipment. Must ensure that the appropriate Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and manufacturer's instructions are followed for any step in the use of RME and RME storage (pre-cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, maintenance) in which he/she is involved. Plans and discusses each procedure with the GPT professionals and assures that all supplies and equipment are available prior to the GI procedures. Prepares, organizes, and maintains highly complex GI set-ups. Observes and responds promptly to each stage of the GI procedures and anticipates the needs of the physician and/or registered nurse by maintaining a high level of concentration for extended periods of time. Utilizes universal precautions and follows all infection control policies and procedures when handling specimens, supplies, equipment. Recognizes potentially hazardous situations (i.e. frayed cords, water on floor, etc.) and takes corrective action. Assists the GPT members with the care of the patient, i.e., positioning, and obtaining supplies. Applies various monitoring equipment, i.e. BP/O2 Sat/ ECG, etc., when assisting with patient preparation. Responsible for the accountability of all GI instruments and equipment during the procedure. Restocks procedure room at the end of the procedure day, rotates stock in order to assure usage before outdated, assuring that the room is ready for procedures at all times. Assists the physician, and/or registered nurse with instrumentation necessary to perform the required procedure and treatment such as obtaining biopsies, brushings, performing polypectomies, inflation of balloon dilators, injection of contrast solutions and other agents during GI procedures. Prepares diagnostic biopsy specimens, assesses the adequacy of each, properly orientates the biopsy and place in appropriate specimen bottle with appropriate labeling to meet pathology laboratory specifications during procedures. Responsible for performing final biopsy check with the endoscopist post-procedure, verifying that patient labels on the specimen are correct. The MIT is responsible for ensuring that all specialized GI accessories, including, but not limited to, snares, injection needles, esophageal and are monitored for availability through Logistics in a timely fashion. Specialized, patient specific, items require consultation directly with the Gastroenterologist for proper sizing, etc. Comply with all safety/fire prevention rules/regulations, using protective equipment when required and provided. Promptly reports all accidents and notifies supervisors of unsafe/unhealthful conditions in the workplace. Attends scheduled training sessions and participates in medical center/service level safety promotions as directed by the supervisor. Knows fire drill and emergency plans for work area, including location of all emergency fire equipment. All employees shall be familiar with how their activities impact VA's goal to implement sound stewardship practices that are protective of the air, water, land, and other natural and cultural resources. In accordance with the goals of the VA GEMS Program, it seeks to cost-effectively meet or exceed compliance with applicable federal, state, and local environmental; public health; and resource protection laws, regulations, and VA requirements; seeks to incorporate practices necessary to implement the requirements of EO 13423. The MIT will assist the charge nurse and RNs with other duties as assigned. Will take call for afterhours procedures. Trains technicians and other staff to assist with endoscopic procedures. Work Schedule: M-F 8:00am-4:30pm. Telework: Not Available. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Functional Statement #: 51890A. Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized. Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized.

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job. All applicants tentatively selected for VA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with VA. Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959. Must be proficient in written and spoken English. title: Data Engineer, AI & Automation
description:
POSITION: Data Engineer, AI & Automation

Location & Hours: Fort Lauderdale HQ | On-site, Full-time

Department: Sound Income Strategies

FLSA Classification: Exempt


Who We Are

Sound Income Strategies, a Sound Income Group company, is a Registered Investment Adviser (RIA) with $4.5 billion in assets under management. The firm provides discretionary and non-discretionary investment management services to independent financial advisors and their clients nationwide. As a fiduciary, Sound Income Strategies is committed to portfolio oversight, regulatory compliance, and disciplined investment implementation aligned with clients’ objectives.


Position Summary

Sound Income Strategies is seeking a Data Engineer, AI & Automation to modernize our operational data infrastructure, reporting, and business workflows. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this hands-on individual contributor will serve as the primary internal owner of backend data engineering and applied AI automation.


This role combines Snowflake expertise, strong data analysis, and production software engineering to consolidate information from custodians, trading platforms, portfolio reporting systems, and other business sources. The ideal candidate can understand how our teams work, identify valuable improvements, and independently build, deploy, and maintain reliable tools that employees use in their daily work.


Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering and Data Quality

  • Develop and maintain backend data pipelines, integrations, and data models in Snowflake to support accurate, accessible operational data.
  • Learn and work within the existing data aggregation architecture; integrate and reconcile information from custodians such as Schwab, trading platforms such as Orion, portfolio reporting systems such as Black Diamond, and supplemental sources.
  • Analyze source data, investigate discrepancies, and implement validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure reporting and downstream applications use complete, accurate information.
  • Translate complex data into useful business outputs and partner with internal stakeholders and front-end contributors to validate dashboards, reports, and application functionality.

Applied AI and Workflow Automation

  • Meet directly with Operations and other SIS teams to understand manual processes, define requirements, and prioritize improvements with the CTO.
  • Build and deploy backend services, internal tools, and automations that improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Develop production AI functionality using Anthropic Claude, including document retrieval, text extraction, document understanding, and multi-step workflows.
  • Implement and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI applications to approved tools and data sources, with appropriate permissions and human review.
  • Use managed model platforms such as Snowflake Cortex, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or comparable services to support practical business applications.

Production Ownership and Collaboration

  • Own solutions from requirements and design through testing, deployment, documentation, user adoption, and ongoing support.
  • Monitor data pipelines and AI workflows; troubleshoot failures, evaluate output accuracy, and improve reliability, performance, and operating costs.
  • Implement access controls, logging, and appropriate safeguards for sensitive client and financial data in collaboration with the CTO and Compliance.
  • Participate in vendor and platform implementation meetings, learn existing systems, and coordinate technical dependencies across internal teams and external partners.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and user guidance, and communicate priorities, progress, risks, and results to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

title: Conference Coordinator Volunteer
description:
Volunteer Program at PE Insights

Nordics Largest PE Conference. Stockholm, November 10th & 11th

Ready to take a major leap towards private equity, M&A, banking or consulting? This is your chance to get a view behind the scenes of the world’s largest private equity community and be part of the volunteer team shaping the future of finance.

Challenge yourself to go outside your comfort zone with likeminded individuals who for two days will be your partners in the trenches facilitating the room of top-of-the pyramid PE professionals.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the most world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

You’ll be supporting the Private Equity Insights team in delivering the conference for sharp insights and inspiration, and outstanding network opportunities for the PE professionals we serve. Among other things the opportunity offer:

  • Peer network: you join a select group of ambitious volunteers who will keep crossing your path for the next 40 years working in the industry.
  • Insider knowledge. Where the day allows, you can sit in on panels, the same ones attendees come to hear. In fact, we encourage you to do so.
  • Confidence under pressure: after two demanding conference days, high-stakes moments at work will feel easier.
  • Master persuasion: learn to influence high-caliber professionals to deliver win-win results.
  • A certificate to show on your CV and LinkedIn that you volunteered at Private Equity Insights.
  • Fuel: food and refreshments on both days.
  • Global programme: The long term opportunity to lead teams and become the person who shows the way for others, or even join Private Equity Insights full time.

Your responsibilities

This is hands-on, operational work focusing on making the conference run. The work changes hour by hour, and you are expected to step in and help wherever the conference needs you.

What the future hold for you with PE Insights

Whether you are with us for 1 conference or 10+, we believe this lays the foundation for a very successful career.

Exceptional volunteers have in the past been offered roles at Private Equity Insights, such as Investor Relations or Entrepreneur in Residence.

Others have gone on to join firms such as McKinsey, BCG, JP Morgan, Deutsche Bank, Ardian and Verdane.

What we expect from you

We are looking for final-year undergraduates, master's students and early-career professionals with an interest in private equity, M&A, banking, consulting or conferences. We expect you to:

  • Have a relentless drive to become the very best at what you do
  • Bring outstanding energy and a positive mindset from the first hour to the last
  • Set aside 2 full days for the conference + online training leading up to
  • Be curious to learn from top private equity professionals
  • Stand out as the person others want beside them on a hard day
  • Speak English at a professional level. Spanish is a plus

This is an unpaid role. Applicants from outside Stockholm are welcome. You fully arrange your own travel and accommodation.

We review every application and invite shortlisted candidates to a short call. If you hold yourself to the standard described here, apply.
