Contact VHAEDRPProgramSupport@va.gov, the EDRP Coordinator for questions/assistance Pay: Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, regular salary increases Paid Time Off: 50-55 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year and possible 5 day paid absence for CME) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory CME: Possible $1,000 per year reimbursement (must be full-time with board certification) Malpractice: Free liability protection with tail coverage provided Contract: No Physician Employment Contract and no significant restriction on moonlighting The physician serves as a Program Manager/Team Lead/Supervisory Psychiatrist for Psychiatric Assessment and Clinical Center (PACC) at the American Lake Division of the VA Puget Sound Health Care System (VAPSHCS) Tacoma WA. In this capacity, the physician serves as the Program Manager of PACC for the Mental Health Service Line. title: Sr Business Analyst
description:
Guild Mortgage Company, closing loans and opening doors since 1960. As a mortgage banking firm we are dedicated to serving the home owner/buyer. Our goal is to provide affordable home financing for our customers, utilizing the best terms available while providing a level of professionalism and service unsurpassed in the lending industry.

Position Summary

The Senior Business Analyst supports Client Experience initiatives by leading analysis for medium to complex projects across the mortgage loan lifecycle, including application, origination, and servicing. This role requires a self-starter who digs beyond initial requests, develops clear business, system, data, and API/integration requirements, and drives work from discovery through delivery. The Senior BA partners with business, Product, Engineering, and QA to support backlog refinement and analyze end-to-end impacts across front-end web and mobile experiences, back-end APIs and middleware, legacy systems, and upstream/downstream integrations. The role develops process, user, system, and data-flow diagrams, communicates risks and dependencies, and mentors other BAs to strengthen analysis practices and consistency.

Essential Functions

  • Partner with project sponsors, Product Owners, business stakeholders, Engineering, QA, and other cross-functional teams to define business problems, project objectives, desired outcomes, scope, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria.
  • Analyze project scope to identify stakeholders and impacts across the mortgage loan lifecycle, including application, origination, and servicing, and across client-facing web and mobile applications, back-end APIs and middleware, legacy platforms, and upstream/downstream systems.
  • Independently lead discovery and requirements elicitation through interviews, workshops, document and system analysis, process observation, data analysis, and other appropriate techniques; dig beyond initial requests to identify underlying business needs, gaps, dependencies, and impacts.
  • Develop clear, complete, and testable business, functional, system, data, API/integration, and nonfunctional requirements, including business rules, assumptions, constraints, exceptions, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze APIs and system integrations, including source and target systems, integration points, data flows and mappings, dependencies, error and exception scenarios, and upstream/downstream impacts.
  • Decompose complex business and system requirements into well-defined features, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria that are ready for refinement and development.
  • Create and maintain current-state and future-state process flows, user flows, system and integration diagrams, data flows, and other visual models to clearly communicate business and technical requirements.
  • Actively participate in and help drive backlog refinement and grooming, story mapping, sprint planning, design discussions, standups, and other Agile delivery activities, ensuring work is sufficiently defined and ready for development.
  • Proactively drive assigned work from discovery through implementation and post-production support, following up on open questions, decisions, dependencies, and action items and providing timely updates on progress, risks, blockers, and delivery readiness.
  • Partner with Engineering and QA to ensure requirements are interpreted correctly and establish appropriate testing and validation strategies, including test scenarios, cross-system impacts, regression considerations, defect resolution, and production validation.
  • Support implementation and release activities by coordinating stakeholder readiness, validating expected business and system behavior, supporting defect triage, and assisting with post-production issues.
  • Participate in peer reviews of requirements and related work products to ensure quality, completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment with established BA standards.
  • Identify opportunities to reuse requirements, business rules, process models, and other analysis artifacts across projects and products.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of BA standards, templates, documentation practices, processes, and tools.
  • Mentor and support other Business Analysts, sharing business, systems, and analytical knowledge and providing guidance on requirements quality, systems thinking, and effective BA practices.
  • Use Senior BA expertise and independent judgment to identify and resolve complex business and system issues, facilitate decisions, and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, or blockers when appropriate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree directly related to the position or equivalent, required.
  • Minimum six years' experience.
  • Relevant experience in mortgage lending and/or consumer lending technology; Experience in mortgage operations segment is highly preferred.
  • Experience leading/working with teams in agile setting, managing backlog/release plan, writing and collaborating on epics and user stories strongly preferred.
  • Analytical skills and a demonstrated talent for scrutinizing complex work processes and streamlining them for increased output; ability to abstract up from low-level information to a more general understanding.
  • Modeling skills necessary to represent requirements information in graphical forms.
  • An understanding of how to practice requirements engineering according to several software development life cycles in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication required; able to effectively manage communication with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to interview subjects, facilitate group discussions, gather information, and report on results.
  • Strong proficiency with applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, MS Teams, Jira (a plus).
  • Ability to write simple SQL queries.
  • Ability to work under pressure, in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and lead projects with a strong attention to detail.

Supervision

  • Low to intermittent supervision required, depending on experience
  • High-level of independent judgment and discretion used in decision-making; uses sound judgment in executing core responsibilities
  • Travel: 0%

Requirements

Physical: Work is primarily sedentary; mobility in an office setting.

Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of computer keyboard and mouse.

Audio/Visual: Ability to accurately interpret sounds and associated meanings at a volume consistent with interpersonal conversation. Regularly required to accurately perceive, distinguish and interpret information received visually and through audio; e.g., words, numbers and other data broadcasted aloud/viewed on a screen, as well as print and other media.

Environmental: Office environment – no substantial exposure to adverse environmental conditions.

Guild offers a pleasant work environment, competitive compensation and excellent benefits package; including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, LTD and 401(k) with employer match.


Guild Mortgage Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Lead Identity & Access Management Specialist
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

With flexible, distributed-first ways of working, you'll have the support to do your best work, wherever you are. As the Lead Identity & Access Management Specialist you will be the primary architect and team leader driving our cloud application security posture. Your mission is to balance business agility with absolute data protection across our sprawling SaaS ecosystem (including M365, Slack, Salesforce, etc).

In this role, you will bridge the gap between user enablement and risk management by owning Identity and Access Management (IAM), deploying SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) tools to prevent configuration drift, and governing the entire lifecycle of our business applications. Crucially, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of IT engineers with a strong security mindset, fostering a collaborative culture rooted in automation and proactive risk reduction.

Your Impact:

  • By building and automating robust Identity pipelines: You will design, configure, and maintain our Identity Providers (IdP) using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0. You will leverage SCIM to automate provisioning and ensure immediate, airtight offboarding to prevent orphan accounts.
  • By hardening our SaaS posture against configuration drift: You will deploy and manage SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) tools. You will establish and enforce security baselines (such as CIS benchmarks) across our key tools, catching unauthorized administrative changes in real time.
  • By governing the security of third-party integrations: You will audit, restrict, and manage OAuth permissions granted to third-party add-ons and AI extensions, ensuring our enterprise data remains inside approved boundaries.
  • By mitigating Shadow IT and assessing third-party risk (TPRM): You will analyze CASB, proxy, and endpoint logs to discover unauthorized SaaS usage. You will partner with Procurement to assess the security profiles of new software vendors by auditing SOC 2 reports, ISO certifications, and CAIQ sheets.
  • By championing technical leadership and team growth: You will build, mentor, and guide a dedicated team of IT professionals. By establishing engineering best practices, leading agile workflows, and promoting continuous learning, you will multiply your impact across the entire organization and cultivate the next generation of cloud security talent.

Your Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in Cloud Security, IAM Administration, or IT Security Operations, including 1-2 years of experience leading, mentoring, or acting as a technical coordinator for other engineers.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Deep expertise in identity protocols: SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SCIM.
    • Hands-on administration experience with modern IdPs (Okta or Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD).
    • Scripting capabilities in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to automate security workflows and interact with SaaS APIs.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills to explain complex security practices to non-technical stakeholders, combined with a pragmatic, problem-solving mindset and proven leadership capabilities to unblock and motivate team members.

Standout Qualities:

  • You hold an industry-recognized Cloud Security certification like CCSP or CCSK (Cloud Security Alliance).
  • You hold a specialized identity certification like Microsoft SC-300 or an Okta Certified Professional/Administrator credential.
  • You have direct experience deploying and running enterprise-grade SSPM or DSPM solutions (e.g., Wiz, AppOmni, Reco, or Defender for Cloud Apps).
  • Leadership Excellence: You have a proven track record of designing technical roadmaps, translating business objectives into actionable engineering sprints, and successfully leading a small-to-midsize IT or Security team through complex migrations or infrastructure overhauls.

Team Dynamics:

  • Reporting: You will report directly to IT Ops Lead, joining a team that values proactive protection and automated operations.
  • The Neighborhood: You will collaborate daily with IT Operations, HR Ops (for automated onboarding/offboarding workflows), Security, Procurement (for vendor assessments), and departmental leads across the company.
  • Our Work Style: We operate in a highly flexible, remote-friendly, and data-driven environment. We live in Wrike for project management, utilize Okta / Entra ID, and scripting (Python, PowerShell) for API-driven automation.
  • Our Philosophy: We follow a Zero Trust security approach. We believe in securing through smart automation and user education rather than simply "blocking" productivity tools.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation + 5 RTT Recovery Days + Seniority Leave
  • Parental Leave: 16 Weeks Maternity / 4 Weeks Paternity + Reserved Daycare Spot
  • Health Insurance - Competitive Coverage - for employees + dependents
  • Hybrid Work – Flexible hybrid working model with a monthly home office allowance of €20 (hybrid) or €50 (fully remote).
  • Public transportation: Coverage of 75% of subscription fee / Sustainable mobility package 200€/year
  • CSE Specific Benefits i.e. vacation vouchers, negotiated fees etc.

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

#LI-AV1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Lead Risk Management
description:
Joining Capco means joining an organisation that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can. We believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.

ABOUT CAPCO

Capco is a global business, data and technology consultancy, focused on the Financial Services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.

We are:

  • Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management
  • Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Resilience etc.
  • Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there
  • Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

ROLE DESCRIPTION

We are looking to recruit financial risk transformation candidates into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance (FRRF) capability.

Successful candidates will

  • Develop a holistic understanding of portfolio evolution across different Securitization asset verticals, regions and product types within the current portfolio.
  • Produce forward-looking portfolio intelligence, identifying emerging portfolio trends, vulnerabilities and opportunities
  • Provide independent challenge to portfolio strategy and portfolio construction decisions.
  • Identify emerging structural risks affecting securitisation markets.
  • Produce strategic portfolio intelligence, insights and recommendations that support strategic decision making by senior management
  • Work collaboratively with 1LOD PM team (Credit & Asset Mgmt. Team) to evaluate strategic portfolio actions.
  • Independently assess proposed portfolio optimization, hedging and de-risking initiatives.
  • Analyse portfolio construction and diversification across products, asset verticals, geographies, industrial sectors and counterparties.
  • Identify/complement 1LOD to detect opportunities to improve portfolio resilience, capital efficiency and risk adjusted returns.
  • Portfolio Risk Measurement Architecture – Development & Ownership in collaboration with 1LOD PM team
  • Conduct structured portfolio deep-dives by asset class (ABS, RMBS, CLO, SPF etc.).
  • Surveillance and reporting of portfolio migration trends (ratings, delinquencies, collateral performance, covenant metrics, leverage trends, RWA utilization, structural and counterparty trends…).
  • Assess early warning signals (EWS) and trigger governance escalation where required – transaction level as well as asset vertical, industrial sector, securitization product, country, and regional level.
  • Undertake Quarterly Portfolio Review of third-party financing book (deck preparation, analytical inputs in liaison with 1LOD and 2LOD, SCOs, presentation to QPR Committee, minutes preparation).
  • Quarterly production of Securitisation Credit Dashboard a
  • Involved in advising on risk frameworks and controls, and delivering transformation across the Risk functions of our clients, in support of their Chief Risk Officers (CRO). This includes implementation of regulatory changes (e.g. Basel, IFRS9, BCBS-239, FTRB), delivery of data to support IRB and VaR modelling, and automation of risk controls, control gap assessment and control implementation.

The types of projects we cover are:

  • Our clients are predominantly within Financial Services and look for support in delivering solutions to improve risk management practices and control frameworks. This may include Risk Assessments, Target Operating Model design and implementation, Risk Rating Methodologies and Models, Gap Analysis, data and reporting
  • Gap analysis and implementation of regulatory changes and remediation of identified issues
  • Identification and implementation of technology and data solutions to support credit, market, liquidity, and capital risk management processes.
  • As a Risk Management SME at Capco, you may be required to communicate risk policies and processes for an organisation, develop risk models involving market, credit, liquidity, capital and/or operational risk, ensure controls are operating effectively, and provide research and analytical support.
  • You will also be encouraged to support Capco in client account planning, business development and relationship building / networking within the FRRF capability and Capco Domains. This may include contributions to Capco’s Risk Management thought leadership and client campaigns.

SKILLS AND EXPERTISE

The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience and will be able to perform the following activities:

  • Good knowledge of regulatory requirements around Basel, FRTB, IFRS9, BCBS-239 etc with specific focus on credit, market, liquidity and capital risks.
  • Experience analysing, defining solutions and implementing regulatory change, including remediation of gaps
  • Ability to evaluate the client’s current risk management processes (e.g. analyse potential impacts of key current and emerging risks, trends, reports, statistics, and relevant documentation)

title: Lead Software Architect
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Lead Software Architect

At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Why this role matters now

This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.

So, what’s the role all about?

We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:

  • Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.
  • Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.
  • Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.
  • Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.
  • Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.
  • Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.
  • Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.

How will you make an impact?

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.
  • Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.
  • Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.
  • Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.
  • Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.
  • Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.
  • Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.

Have you got what it takes?

  • Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.
  • Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.
  • Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.
  • Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.
  • Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.
  • Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.
  • Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.
  • Good knowledge of SOLID principles.
  • Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.
  • Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.
  • Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.
  • Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.
  • Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.

You will have an advantage if you also have:

  • Security best practice (OWASP top ten)
  • Azure SQL Server
  • DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub
  • Windows services
  • Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.
  • Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).

What we do not require

We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.

About the interview process

The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.

What’s in it for you?

Learn more about the Benefits at NICE

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!

Enjoy NICE-FLEX!

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

#LI-Hybrid

Role Type: Individual Contributor

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

title: Assistant Aquatics Director
description:
Make a Splash in Your Next Leadership Role!


Whitin Community Center (WCC) is looking for our next Assistant Aquatics Director!

If you’re passionate about aquatics, enjoy developing people, and love creating safe, positive experiences for swimmers of all ages, this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Assistant Aquatics Director, you’ll play a key leadership role in the day-to-day operation of WCC’s aquatics programs. You’ll oversee swim lessons, support and develop our lifeguard and swim instructor teams, coordinate schedules, work directly with families and participants, and help ensure our pools are safe, welcoming, and running smoothly.

This is a hands-on position, so you won’t spend your entire day behind a desk. You’ll have opportunities to teach, lifeguard, train and mentor staff, develop programming, and make a direct impact on our members and community.


What You’ll Do - Lead & Support Our Aquatics Team

  • Supervise, train, schedule, and support lifeguards, Water Safety Instructors, and other aquatics staff.
  • Partner with the Aquatics Director to recruit and train qualified team members.
  • Help ensure appropriate lifeguard and swim instructor coverage for programs and lessons.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and training to help aquatics staff succeed.
  • Step in as a lifeguard or swim instructor when needed.

Create a Great Swim Lesson Experience

  • Coordinate all aspects of the swim lesson experience, from registration and welcoming families through swimmer evaluations and recommendations for future lessons.
  • Assist with seasonal swim lesson schedules, class ratios, instructor assignments, attendance tracking, and parent/guardian communication.
  • Help develop and maintain private swim lesson programming.
  • Ensure swim lessons are delivered safely, enthusiastically, and in accordance with American Red Cross guidelines.

Support Safe & Successful Pool Operations

  • Help maintain a safe environment for WCC members, guests, swimmers, and staff.
  • Assist with regular facility safety inspections.
  • Monitor pool conditions and chemical levels and maintain required records.
  • Help keep pool areas, equipment, and supplies clean, organized, and properly maintained.
  • Assist with pool maintenance projects and seasonal pool shutdowns.
  • Respond calmly and appropriately to emergency or potentially hazardous situations.

Help Grow Our Programs

  • Bring ideas and creativity to the development of new aquatics programs.
  • Support aquatics programming for children, youth, and adults.
  • Coordinate and supervise aquatics activities for Camp Whitin.
  • Collaborate with WCC’s Child Care team to develop and implement age-appropriate recreational activities.
  • Assist the Aquatics Director with seasonal programming recommendations, scheduling, and department budget planning.

description:

Pilots advanced, single or multi-engine military airplane, high performance military fighter aircraft on tactical/non-tactical assigned missions using advanced precision instrument flight techniques in conjunction with air navigational aids. Maintains a thorough knowledge of the aircraft systems and procedures under normal, instrument, and emergency conditions. Maintains mission qualifications in the assigned airplane. 2. title: District Partnership Specialist, New England (Connecticut)

IXL Learning, a global edtech leader with personalized learning products used by millions of students worldwide, is seeking a District Partnership Specialist to join our Professional Learning team and support districts in New England.

title: Medical Records Technician (CDIS In/Out)
description:
This position is located in the Health Information Management (HIM) Section, under the Business Office, at the VA Medical Center, Atlanta, Ga. Medical Records Technicians (Coders) are skilled in classifying medical data from patient health records. These coding practitioners analyze patients' health records and assign alpha-numeric codes for each diagnosis and procedure.

Major Duties Include but are not limited to: Reviewing the overall quality and completeness of clinical documentation. Applying comprehensive knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy & physiology, disease processes, treatment modalities, diagnostic tests, medications, procedures as well as the principles and practices of health services and the organizational structure to ensure proper code selection. Reviewing clinical documentation and providing education to clinical staff on inpatient and outpatient episodes of care. Preparing and conducting provider education on documentation processes in the health record to include the impact of documentation on coding, workload, quality measures, reimbursement, and funding. Providing education to providers on the need for accurate and complete documentation in the health record, ensuring documentation supports the codes selected to the highest degree of specificity. Adhering to accepted coding practices, guidelines, and conventions to ensure ethical, accurate, and complete coding. Ensuring provider documentation is complete and supports the diagnoses and procedures coded. Serves as the liaison between health information management and clinical staff and is responsible for facilitating the improved overall quality, education, completeness and accuracy of health record documentation through extensive interaction with clinical coding, and other associated staff to ensure clinical documentation supports services rendered to patients, appropriate workload is captured, and resources are properly allocated. Reviews documentation and facilitate modifications to the health record to ensure accurate severity of illness, risk of mortality, complexity of care, and utilization of resources. Responsible for reviewing the overall quality and completeness of clinical documentation. Inpatient CDI focuses on the concurrent review of patient records with an emphasis on improving documentation while the patient is still in-house while outpatient CDI focuses on improving clinical staff documentation of outpatient encounters through retrospective, ideally prior to coding and billing, review of outpatient encounters and extensive provider education. Queries clinical staff to clarify ambiguous, conflicting, or incomplete documentation and reviews the appropriateness of and responses to queries through review of query reports. Obtains appropriate corrective action plans from responsible clinical service directors and recommend improvements or changes in documentation practices, when applicable. Reviews VERA input on missed opportunities in provider documentation identified by the VERA coordinator and coordinate provider documentation education with the VERA coordinator. Ensures documentation supports codes based on guidelines specific to certain diagnoses, procedures, and other criteria used to classify patients under the Veterans Equitable Resource Allocation (VERA) program that categorizes all VA patients into specific classes representing their clinical conditions and resource needs. Incumbent develops and conducts seminars, workshops, short courses, informational briefings, and conferences concerned with health record documentation, educational and functional training requirements to ensure program objectives are met for clinical and Health Information Management (HIM) staff. Work Schedule: Full-time, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm. (Subject to change based on agency need.) Telework: 5 Days per pay period Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Functional Statement #: 60956F Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

title: Digital Strategy Manager
description:
As a Digital Strategy Manager on the Client Strategy team, you will own the digital strategy for a book of OEM and dealer accounts across the construction, agriculture, and trucking equipment industries. You will partner with an aligned group of sales reps to turn client business goals into integrated programs that span off-platform paid media, on-platform inventory across CCJ, Overdrive, Equipment World, and Trucks Parts Service, and content from our in-house Content Studio.

You will act as the strategic engine behind the sale, joining pitches, shaping proposals, and guiding clients on what their media is intended to do for their business. Alignment is intentional on this team: you will build continuity with your accounts over time, earning the trust needed for longer-term, multi-year partnerships.

Your success will be measured across three areas: revenue impact within your aligned book, client health, and operational excellence in proposal turnaround, and strategy planning.

What You Will Do:

Client Strategy & Planning
  • Build annual and campaign-level digital strategies for an assigned book of OEM and dealer accounts, grounded in each client's market position, sales cycle, and dealer network.
  • Translate client business goals, such as demand generation, dealer traffic, market share, and product launches, into clear media and content plans with defined KPIs.
  • Sequence programs across the client year so each quarter builds on the last, creating a multi-quarter roadmap that supports renewal and long-term partnership.
Sales Partnership & Pitch Support
  • Serve as the dedicated strategic partner for an aligned group of sales reps, joining discovery calls, pitches, and renewal conversations from start to finish.
  • Run pre-pitch research on accounts, competitors, and category trends so every client conversation starts from insight rather than inventory.
  • Assist sales with proposal builds and RFP responses using Fusable's data and marketing insights.
Integrated Program Design
  • Combine off-platform paid media across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and programmatic offerings with on-platform inventory into unified, multi-channel programs.
  • Recommend channel mix, audiences, targeting, and budget allocation based on client objectives, data, and performance history.
  • Brief the Content Studio on written, video, and audio assets that strengthen the media plan and give each program a clear story.
Execution Handoff & Performance Oversight
  • Hand off approved programs to Digital Specialists and Account Coordinators with complete, clear briefs that set up flawless execution.
  • Turn performance data into client-ready insights and support quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that highlight results and next steps.
Industry Expertise & Team Contribution
  • Stay ahead of emerging digital platforms, ad products, and measurement approaches, including new AI search and chat ad formats, and help bring them to market.
  • Enable sales reps on new digital capabilities so they can position and sell them with confidence.
  • Contribute to the team's reusable tools, including packaging, audit frameworks, research kits, and templates, and bring field feedback into product decisions.

What You Need:

  • 4+ years of experience in digital media strategy, media planning, or client strategy, preferably in an agency, publisher, or digital media environment.
  • Hands-on knowledge of digital marketing disciplines, including paid search, paid social, programmatic, audience targeting, and campaign measurement.
  • Proven experience building proposals and presenting strategy to clients, agencies, and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering closely with sales teams in a pre-sales, solutions, or sales engineering capacity.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect digital performance to client business outcomes.
  • Analytical, data-driven mindset with the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a direct and structured style.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, proposals, and deadlines at once.
  • Experience in B2B, industrial, or equipment markets (construction, agriculture, transportation) and familiarity with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Programmatic DSPs, or CM360 is a strong plus.

15%

title: Rust System Engineer
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a high-caliber Rust Systems Engineer to design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency backend systems and infrastructure. In this role, you will go beyond web APIs—tackling low-level performance bottlenecks, complex state management, parallel compute algorithms, and concurrent data processing pipelines.

If you thrive on deterministic memory management, zero-cost abstractions, and writing safe, blazingly fast concurrent systems, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • High-Performance Architecture: Design and implement zero-cost, high-throughput, low-latency engine components and data processing pipelines in Rust.
  • Concurrent & Thread-Safe Systems: Build thread-safe, lock-free, or fine-grained locked data structures and state machines capable of scaling across multi-core architectures without race conditions.
  • Priority & Real-Time Threading: Design custom thread pools, task schedulers, and execution queues with priority-based task scheduling and resource allocation controls.
  • Algorithmic Optimization: Implement complex computational logic, including high-efficiency recursive algorithms, tail-call optimizations, and dynamic cache-friendly data structures.
  • Resource & Memory Management: Leverage Rust’s ownership model, lifetime annotations, custom allocators, and non-blocking I/O to achieve predictable low-latency profiling (minimizing allocations and cash misses).
  • System Profiling & Benchmarking: Conduct continuous benchmarking (criterion), flame graph analysis, memory profiling (Val grind/heap track), and CPU SIMD/vectorization optimizations.

Key Skills:

  • Core Rust & Functional Programming
    • Advanced Rust Mastery: Deep experience with Rust internals (stdsync, stdcell, custom Drop, unsafe Rust boundaries, and macro systems).
    • Closures & Higher-Order Functions: Mastery of Rust’s functional traits (Fn, FnMut, FnOnce), capturing environments, move semantics within closures, and passing unboxed closures for zero-cost abstractions.
    • Advanced Recursion & Tree Processing: Ability to structure complex recursive functions, tree/graph traversals, and dynamic programming patterns efficiently while preventing stack overflows (e.g., using explicit stack vectors or trampoline patterns).
  • Systems & Concurrency Engineering
    • Thread Safety & Sync Primitives: In-depth understanding of memory models, cache coherence, atomic operations (AtomicBool, AtomicPtr, CAS), memory ordering (Acquire/Release/SeqCst), Send/Sync traits, and synchronization primitives (Mutex, RwLock, mpsc/crossbeam channels).
    • Priority Threading & Scheduling: Practical experience implementing or customizing task schedulers, thread priority assignment, work-stealing thread pools, and priority queues (Binary Heap, custom priority locks).
    • High-Performance Computing (HPC): Experience writing data-intensive, low-latency software. Knowledge of cache alignment, SIMD vectorization, memory-mapped files (mmap), and lock-free/wait-free data structures.
  • General Systems Knowledge
    • Systems Architecture: 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years writing production-grade Rust (or a strong C/C++ background transitioning into production Rust).
    • Performance Analysis: Proficiency with profiling tools (perf, Flame graphs, Criterion, Coz) and debugging async execution (tokio-console, tracing).

Good to Have

  • Experience with custom memory allocators (jemalloc, mimalloc) and bare-metal/no-std Rust environments.
  • Knowledge of asynchronous runtime architectures (Tokio internals, reactor/proactor patterns, custom Future implementations).
  • Familiarity with hardware-level optimizations (cache line padding, false sharing avoidance, NUMA-aware architectures).
  • Experience with cross-language FFI (e.g., C/C++ interop or WebAssembly bindings).

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it;

Develop strategic, tactical and technological plans and processes and budgets to support HUD's mission. The Construction Instructor is a temporary, full-time position responsible for providing classroom-based and hands-on construction training to YouthBuild participants, equipping young adults with the technical knowledge, practical skills, and work readiness needed to pursue careers in the construction industry.   • Uses standards of student feedback that are clear, fair, and followed consistently throughout the course.
  • Requires levels of instructor and student effort sufficient to the mastery of the subject or skills in the course.

  • Orders instructional materials, equipment and textbooks with sufficient lead time.
  • Exercises good judgment in the use of and/or management of facilities, equipment, and supplies.
  • Attends assigned meetings as requested and works well with peers, staff, and administration.

title: EXECUTIVE VICE PRESIDENT, PUBLIC AFFAIRS & COMMUNICATIONS
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

The Personal Care Products Council (PCPC) is seeking an accomplished senior executive to lead the organization’s public affairs, policy communications, media relations, and external engagement efforts.


Reporting directly to the President and CEO and serving as a member of PCPC’s executive leadership team, the EVP will help shape and execute the organization’s policy and communications strategy and serve as a highly credible voice for the cosmetics and personal care products industry.


This is a policy-driven public affairs leadership role, not simply a communications position. The successful candidate will understand complex regulatory, political, and policy issues; translate them into compelling narratives and advocacy strategies; build consensus among diverse member companies; and effectively engage policymakers, media, industry partners, and other stakeholders.


Given the importance of PCPC’s relationships with FDA, congressional policymakers, media, industry stakeholders, and other national trade associations, a strong preference will be given to candidates based in the Washington, DC area.


THE MANDATE


The EVP will:


Lead strategy. Develop and execute an integrated public affairs, advocacy, communications, and external engagement strategy aligned with PCPC’s strategic priorities.


Lead external engagement. Develop trusted relationships with media, industry organizations, coalitions, and other stakeholders. Represent PCPC publicly and serve as a principal external voice for the organization.


Shape the narrative. Translate complex scientific, legal, regulatory, and policy issues into clear, persuasive messages that advance the industry’s interests and strengthen PCPC’s voice.


Drive advocacy communications. Work closely with government affairs, regulatory, legal, scientific, and other PCPC teams to develop strategies around federal and state legislative and regulatory priorities.


Build alignment. Navigate differing perspectives among member companies and build consensus around common industry positions. Cultivate strong relationships with key volunteer leaders and engage them effectively in PCPC’s advocacy efforts.


Build trust and reputation. Establish and maintain a positive, credible reputation for PCPC and the overall industry among key stakeholders, partners, media, and other influential audiences. Earn trust through consistent, thoughtful engagement, sound judgment, transparency, and follow-through, recognizing that strong relationships and institutional credibility are essential to effective advocacy.


Committee engagement. Serve as the staff lead for PCPC’s Communications Steering Committee, working closely with the Committee Chair and member company representatives to establish priorities, develop agendas, facilitate meetings, build consensus, and advance committee initiatives aligned with PCPC’s strategic objectives.


Lead the function and drive partnership. Manage and develop the Public Affairs & Communications team; establish priorities, allocate resources, and oversee departmental performance. Develop and manage the department’s annual budget, including forecasting resource needs, establishing spending priorities, monitoring expenditures, and ensuring resources are aligned with PCPC’s strategic objectives. Build strong partnerships across PCPC and with external stakeholders and provide candid, strategic counsel to the CEO and Board.


Manage issues and reputation. Anticipate emerging policy and reputational issues and partner with member companies to develop timely, coordinated responses to breaking news, crises, and other developments.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The successful candidate will be able to take a complicated issue, quickly understand its substance and political dynamics, determine an appropriate advocacy strategy, develop the narrative, align PCPC’s membership, and effectively communicate the organization’s position to the right audience.


This individual will be a trusted strategic counselor to the CEO and Board, an effective advocate for PCPC’s members, a collaborative leader within the organization, and a credible external voice for the industry.


The successful candidate will also proactively shape the industry’s narrative by translating complex issues into clear, compelling stories that resonate with policymakers, media, and other audiences and strengthen understanding of the essential role of the beauty and personal care industry.


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate will be a seasoned public affairs executive who combines policy expertise, political judgment, communications excellence, executive presence, and the ability to build consensus and influence others.

The candidate will bring:


Deep Policy & Regulatory Expertise
A sophisticated understanding of the U.S. federal and state policy and regulatory environment, with the ability to quickly understand complex issues and assess their political, regulatory, and reputational implications. Experience with the FDA and regulated industries is highly valued, as is familiarity with the regulatory environment affecting cosmetics and personal care products.


Trade Association & Membership Experience
Meaningful experience working in or closely with a trade association or membership organization, including an understanding of how to represent diverse member interests, develop consensus, and translate those interests into effective advocacy.


Integrated Public Affairs Leadership
A proven record of developing and executing integrated public affairs and policy communications strategies. The candidate should understand how communications, advocacy, government relations, coalition building, and stakeholder engagement work together to achieve policy objectives.


Public Affairs Campaign Experience
A track record of developing and executing public affairs campaigns that bring together advocacy, communications, coalition engagement, stakeholder outreach, and other tactics to advance policy or reputational objectives. Experience leading multi-channel campaigns and mobilizing diverse stakeholders around a common objective is preferred.


Political Acumen
Strong instincts for Washington and state political dynamics, including the ability to anticipate developments, understand stakeholder motivations, identify opportunities and risks, and determine when and how PCPC should engage.


Executive Presence
The credibility and confidence to engage effectively with CEOs, corporate executives, Board members, policymakers, journalists, association leaders, and other senior stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable representing PCPC publicly and advising the CEO and Board candidly.


Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
Demonstrated ability to build and sustain strategic relationships across a broad network of stakeholders, including coalition partners, NGOs, advocacy organizations, industry groups, scientific organizations and other external influencers. The candidate should have a track record of identifying opportunities for collaboration, aligning interests among diverse stakeholders, and leveraging partnerships to advance policy, advocacy, and reputation objectives while strengthening the industry's voice and credibility.


Leadership & Execution
A demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams, establish priorities, manage resources, drive collaboration, and execute effectively in a fast-moving environment. The candidate should be strategic while remaining willing to engage directly in important issues and deliverables.

Provides USACE leadership for the Ohio River Basin Alliance (ORBA, which includes multiple state and federal agencies), the Southeast Power Administration (SEPA), the International Joint Commission (IJC, which includes state and federal representatives from Canada and the USA), and the Asian Carp Regional Coordination Committee (ACRCC, which includes multiple federal and state agencies and the Council on Environmental Quality). Chairs the Regional Programs Review Board to ensure program execution of the Civil Works, Military, Regulatory, Operations, and Environmental Programs. Advises the Division Commander as necessary on major policy matters and keeps the Commander informed of the status of assigned programs. Decisions are accepted as authoritative and recommendations directly affect the successful accomplishment of the Division's and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) programs. Completed work is subject to review for attainment of objectives.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT: Must be a U.S. Citizen. You will be required to provide proof of U.S. Citizenship. One year trial/probationary period may be required. You will serve a one-year probationary period unless you have previously completed the probationary period in the SES. If you are a male applicant born after December 31, 1959, certify that you have registered with the Selective Service System or are exempt from having to do so. You must be able to submit and pass designated and/or Random Drug Testing as required. File a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report OGE-278e within 30 days of appointment and annually from then on. Appointment is subject to the completion of a favorable suitability or fitness determination, as determined by a background investigation. You must be able to obtain/maintain the appropriate clearance and access level for this position. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal. Direct deposit of pay is required. The incumbent is required to travel on both scheduled and unscheduled aircraft, and other modes as required, under conditions specified under the DoD Joint Travel Regulations. The incumbent is expected to travel on short notice to attend high level meetings to obtain resolution of problems and gather information to assist in the decision-making process. Mobility: An essential element of the SES is mobility across geographic, organizational and functional lines. Individuals selected for Army SES positions may be subject to reassignment that requires them to be mobile. The U.S. Army senior leadership considers mobility to be an integral part of employment as an SES member with the Department of the Army. You must sign a mobility agreement. There are three key documents that contain important information about your rights and obligations. Please read and retain these documents: Noncriminal Justice Applicant's Privacy Rights, for those who undergo an FBI fingerprint-based criminal history record check for personnel vetting, which includes Rap Back, FD-258 Privacy Act Statement - FBI (this is the same statement used when your fingerprints are submitted as part of your background investigation), and SEAD-3-Reporting-U.pdf (dni.gov), (applicable to those who hold a sensitive position or have eligibility for access to classified information).

title: TAP & Employment Readiness Specialist
description:
This position is assigned to Commander Navy Installation Command (CNIC), Fleet and Family Readiness Department (N9), Family Readiness Division (N91), Work and Family Life Branch (N911). Incumbent serves as the Transition Assistance Program (TAP) and Employment Readiness Specialist. The position is to facilitate the TAP and employment supportive programs and provide support to installations, regional TAP and employment initiatives, and promote family readiness.

In order to qualify for this position, resumes must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties of the position. Applicant resumes are the key means for evaluating skills, knowledge, and abilities as they relate to this position therefore, applicants are encouraged to be clear and specific when describing experience. Duties include but are not limited to: Facilitate and provide the full scope of operational management and oversight of TAP services for transitioning military members and/or family members, retirees, reservists, and Department of Defense (DOD) civilian members. Coordinate with counterparts from the Department of Defense (DoD), Department of Labor (DOL), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Small Business Administration (SBA) to plan and schedule various training events for service members and their families to prepare them for success in civilian life. Coordinate with counterparts on providing separating service members and their families access to an array of workshops, programs, services and support to meet their needs on various topics (i.e., relocation assistance, personal financial management, career coaching and planning, resume writing, interview preparedness, job hiring fairs and job search strategies, military and civilian social service resources; and non-medical individual and family counseling). Assist clients with creating and maintaining their Individual Transition Plan (IDP) and identifying personal and vocational needs to help them outline milestones to achieve their goals. Work with separating service and family members, individually and in groups, on their career, occupational, volunteer, and educational goals to equip customers with career/job search skills, resume development, and interview techniques to assist in obtaining employment. Provide personalized guidance and advise on resume development, interview techniques, salary negotiation, military spouse employment and licensure reimbursement, etc. Facilitate classes for customers on applying professional analytical skills and negotiation techniques to identify job opportunities and develop an automated inventory to list such job opportunities. Develop a volunteer recognition system to acknowledge volunteer milestones during the All-Hands meetings, installation volunteer recognition event, upon completion of short-term projects, etc. Provide staff training on volunteer-related topics such as: utilizing, motivating, and recognizing volunteers; procedures for recruiting, interviewing, and placing volunteers; making accommodations, when necessary; and providing diverse volunteer opportunities to assist individuals with disabilities to become involved. Brief organizations on the FFSC Volunteer Program, and encourage staff to promote volunteerism in programs, presentations, and briefings. Monitor and network with local installation and community organizations seeking volunteers. Launch and support volunteer programs to grow services offered by the FFSC, installation, state, and local community. Collect and process volunteer data for reports and disseminate quarterly reports reflecting pertinent statistical information. Manage the overall implementation of group volunteer events. Oversee major volunteer projects and assignments, including installation-wide, state/local family events and outreach activities. Manage Memorandums of Understanding (MOU) and contracts with significant partner organizations, including large local colleges and universities. Represent the organization during communications between the FFSC and partner agencies, including corporate, educational, and faith-based supporters. Maintain and update TAP and FERP records and statistics, and complete required reports timely and accurately, utilizing the Fleet and Family Support Management Information System (FFSMIS), Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) and applicable databases. Maintain certification standards for the local TAP and FERP per CNIC FFSP certification standards. Disseminate pertinent transition and employment information to various individuals and stakeholders within the local area (e.g., commands, command ombudsman, family members, enrollees) via newsletters, emails, and/or social media. Serve as an active participant on DoD and CNIC TAP/FERP working groups and in transition/employment seminars, carrying out various tasks such as updating curricula, facilitating aspects of programs, and hiring fairs, etc. Develop, maintain, and update marketing materials and maintain up-to-date inventories on available transition and employment services and providers. Research and write articles and prepare and deliver briefings to market TAP and FERP and inform target population of programs and services. Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Lead Digital Designer
description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

The Lead Digital Designer defines how True Anomaly’s brand lives, moves, and communicates across digital experiences. Working closely with the Head of Graphic Design, Brand & Identity, and the broader Brand & Creative team, this role leads the design of major web, editorial, campaign, and interactive experiences. The role translates brand, content, product, and business strategy into compelling digital experiences and helps evolve the systems, patterns, and principles that support True Anomaly’s digital expression.

Your primary focus will be designing and evolving our web ecosystem, including a new editorial publication and an interactive company website. This is a hands-on design role for someone who combines exceptional visual craft with strong systems thinking, editorial judgment, and an understanding of how people experience content, products, and brands on the web. You can develop a bold creative direction within a broader creative framework, translate it into a flexible design system, and remain closely involved as the work is built and launched.

Beyond our core web platforms, you will contribute to product launches, integrated marketing campaigns, social content, and the digital expression of events and other significant brand moments. You will think across the end-to-end experience, understanding how individual interactions, content, and touchpoints work together to create a coherent relationship with the brand.

This is not a motion design role, but motion is an important part of the medium. You should understand how interaction, animation, transitions, and responsive behavior can improve hierarchy, storytelling, and usability and be able to concept and direct that work in partnership with motion designers and developers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Web and Interactive Design

  • Lead the creative development and design of True Anomaly’s company website, editorial publication, and other priority digital experiences.
  • Translate brand, audience, product, content, and business objectives into clear digital concepts, information architecture, user journeys, page systems, and interaction models.
  • Design responsive experiences from early concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity design, prototyping, development, quality assurance, and launch.
  • Create high-fidelity interactive prototypes that communicate responsive behavior, motion, transitions, and complex user flows with enough specificity to guide implementation.
  • Develop and articulate a distinctive point of view for how the True Anomaly brand behaves online across typography, imagery, layout, interaction, and motion, aligned with the broader brand direction set by Brand & Creative leadership.
  • Partner with developers from the beginning of a project to explore what is possible in the browser and use technical constraints and emerging capabilities as inputs to the creative process.
  • Balance expressive storytelling with clarity, accessibility, performance, ease of use, and the needs of different audiences.
  • Maintain creative quality through development, testing, and launch.
  • Review qualitative and quantitative signals after launch and evolve digital experiences based on audience behavior, content performance, and changing business needs.

Editorial Design and Publishing

  • Create the design system for a new editorial publication that can support long-form journalism, technical storytelling, interviews, essays, multimedia, and evolving content formats.
  • Partner with Editorial Content Strategy, Communications, Creative Strategy, and subject-matter experts to determine how stories should be structured and experienced.
  • Partner with Editorial, Content Strategy, and developers to define the publication’s content model, taxonomy, CMS requirements, and relationships between stories, formats, authors, and topics.
  • Design for the full publishing system—not only individual articles—including discovery, navigation, archives, series, author pages, related content, search, and emerging editorial formats.
  • Develop flexible article templates and editorial components without making every story feel identical.
  • Use typography, pacing, imagery, data, interaction, and motion to make complex ideas understandable and compelling.
  • Ensure the system supports editorial flexibility, efficient publishing, accessibility, and long-term growth without sacrificing the character of individual stories.
  • Help establish scalable workflows and standards for publishing and evolving content.

Digital Brand Systems

  • Build and evolve reusable digital design systems, including typography, color, layout, components, interaction patterns, and motion principles, in partnership with the Head of Graphic Design, Brand & Identity and relevant creative and technical partners.
  • Partner with internal teams and external collaborators to scale, refine, and evolve design across digital systems and experiences.
  • Ensure consistency across the company website, editorial experiences, campaigns, launches, events, and social platforms.
  • Create templates and kits of parts that allow the team to move quickly while maintaining a high creative standard.
  • Identify when a digital experience should extend the existing system and when a moment warrants a more bespoke approach.
  • Document systems and provide clear design direction to internal teams, developers, agencies, and production partners, escalating major brand or strategic decisions as appropriate.
  • Explore emerging tools and formats—including creative coding, generative design, data visualization, real-time 3D, and AI-assisted workflows—when they create a more meaningful or effective digital experience.

Campaigns, Launches, and Brand Moments

  • Develop digital creative for integrated marketing campaigns and product launches, including landing pages, interactive stories, digital toolkits, social assets, and supporting content.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Communications, Social, Events, and other teams to create cohesive experiences across channels.
  • Shape the digital layer of important events, demonstrations, installations, and live brand moments.
  • Adapt ideas intelligently across formats rather than treating each deliverable as an isolated asset.
  • Maintain a high level of craft across both flagship experiences and faster-turn work.

Interaction and Motion for the Web

  • Define how motion and interaction support navigation, hierarchy, comprehension, and storytelling across digital experiences.
  • Create prototypes that communicate intended behavior, transitions, and responsive states.
  • Collaborate with motion designers on more complex animation, films, and motion systems.
  • Work closely with developers to ensure motion is purposeful, performant, accessible, and faithful to the design intent.
  • Distinguish between moments that benefit from movement and those where restraint creates a stronger experience.

Strategy, Research, and Partnership

  • Champion user research and audience understanding as inputs to creative direction, content structure, interaction design, and ongoing iteration.
  • Frame ambiguous problems and opportunities through clear strategic briefs that connect audience needs, product and business objectives, content, technology, and brand.
  • Present design vision, strategy, concepts, prototypes, and work in progress to creative leadership, business stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Work closely with Creative Strategy to translate the company’s narrative, priorities, and product context into effective digital experiences.
  • Partner directly with developers, content teams, product partners, and specialists from the beginning of a project to align creative ambition with technical feasibility and end-to-end experience needs.
  • Prepare thoughtful design specifications, prototypes, assets, and annotations that enable high-quality implementation.
  • Review builds across screen sizes, devices, browsers, and interaction states; identify quality issues and direct refinements before launch.
  • Partner with content, analytics, accessibility, SEO, and performance specialists, using their expertise to improve the experience without independently owning those disciplines.
  • Build and maintain a trusted network of digital studios, independent designers, developers, and specialist partners.
  • Evaluate outside partners based on creative fit, technical capability, executional quality, and responsible investment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in digital, web, brand, editorial, product, or experience design, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact digital platforms and cross-functional initiatives.
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional web design, strong brand thinking, sophisticated visual craft, and final launched work. A portfolio link is required.
  • Experience designing content-rich editorial, brand, product, or storytelling-focused websites and digital experiences.
  • Strong command of typography, layout, hierarchy, image-making, responsive design, interaction design, and digital design systems.
  • Experience developing digital work from concept through high-fidelity design, prototyping, development, quality assurance, launch, and ongoing iteration.
  • Strong understanding of user journeys, information architecture, end-to-end experience design, accessibility, and responsive behavior.
  • Experience using user research, audience insights, analytics, or other forms of evidence to inform design decisions and improve experiences.
  • Experience designing for CMS-driven publishing platforms and collaborating on content models, taxonomies, and authoring workflows.
  • Fluency in Figma and other current digital design and prototyping tools.
  • Ability to prototype sophisticated interaction and motion using appropriate tools; familiarity with creative coding or browser-based experimentation is valuable.
  • Ability to concept and direct motion and interaction for the web; hands-on motion design capability is valuable but not required.
  • Experience collaborating closely with developers and enough technical fluency to understand feasibility, performance, implementation, and browser-related tradeoffs.
  • Understanding of how accessibility testing, SEO requirements, performance constraints, and content strategy should inform design decisions.
  • Experience presenting design vision, strategy, and work to creative leadership, business stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience directing agencies, independent designers, developers, illustrators, motion designers, and other creative partners.
  • Ability to work within defined budgets and schedules while protecting the quality and intent of the work.
  • Strong presentation, communication, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the function, systems, and workflows are still being built.
  • Experience with data visualization, 3D, generative tools, creative coding, or other emerging digital formats is valuable but not required.
  • Experience with technology, aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial design, or another technically complex category is helpful but not required.
  • Genuine interest in aerospace, defense, or national security is a meaningful signal. Domain expertise is not required; intellectual seriousness about the mission is.

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $135,000 - $200,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA, for hybrid opportunity.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Hybrid

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

Establish operational plans, pattern, and reference architectures across both Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) environments, ensuring all initiatives advance bureau mission goals while bridging high-level federal mandates with utility delivery. Act as the designated executive and technical authority supporting the Chief Technology Officer (OCTO) for evaluating and approving the operational deployment of high-impact SI systems-including applications corporate/back-office functions, transmission grid planning and operations, regional hydro planning, and NERC-CIP-protected control room and field cyber assets.
