title: Senior Bring up and Characterization Engineer
description:
Bring-Up and Characterization Engineer

Multiple roles across different levels

Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Bengaluru which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing.

We are looking for a Characterisation and Bring-Up engineer to work with Architecture, Silicon Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Operations (device manufacture) and Product teams to help create and execute the bring-up and characterisation of our cutting-edge silicon devices and system platforms. Graphcore design and develop leading edge silicon processors and high-power high-speed blade systems at the forefront of AI technology. As such you will need to develop a detailed understanding of our silicon and platform products. Your role will be to create and execute bring-up and characterisation plans of our silicon devices in systems to show that they will operate correctly over all conditions in the final product. You will concentrate on automated and manual testing of systems in the lab and datacentre. The results will be integrated with data from other teams to provide the complete characterisation solution for the product. For example, a large amount of device testing can be performed by the production test team using high-speed production test equipment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Understand the architecture and design of silicon devices and systems, and clearly document the requirements for characterisation
  • Creation of product specific characterisation plans
  • Liasing with engineering teams to understand what are tests are available for characterisation purposes and driving change where appropriate
  • Create and maintain an automated system for running characterisation testing, capturing the results to a central database and performing data analysis
  • Execution of manual characterisation tests where automation is not appropriate
  • Report regularly on progress and issues during the characterisation
  • Produce characterisation reports containing platform test results and feeding them up into the overall product characterisation report

Essential skills

  • A proven track record of delivering technical output, perhaps as an individual contributor, manager, or project manager
  • Solid experience and understanding of silicon digital device design characterization
  • Knowledge of silicon process technology and how that impacts device performance at transistor and system level
  • Knowledge of high-performance processor and system-on-chip systems
  • Experience of high-speed digital interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet or DDR
  • Knowledge of measurement automation and data analysis
  • The ability to code or script automation and data analysis using appropriate coding languages such as Python, JMP for example
  • An ability to work independently without daily oversight

Desirable skills:

  • Knowledge of PCBA and system level technologies
  • Background knowledge of ATE systems and capabilities. Whilst you will not be directly involved with such testing, some of the characterisation work will be performed on such systems

Benefits:

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers a competitive benefits package. We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

title: Franchise Success Coach and Learning Development Specialist
description:
Franchise Success Coach and Learning Development Specialist
Department: Franchise Success
Location: American Fork, UT — Hybrid/On-Site
Employment Type: Full-Time
Travel: Periodic travel to support assigned franchise locations, training, and company events


Position Overview

The Franchise Success Coach and Learning Development Specialist helps franchise owners improve business performance while building the training and knowledge resources that support success across the Zerorez network.

This role coaches an assigned portfolio of franchise owners on profitability, operational marketing, leadership, and growth. As an active member of The Circle of Success Center of Excellence (CoE), this person also helps build and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS) and Global Knowledge Base, turning approved expertise and proven field practices into clear, practical resources.

The role connects franchise support with organizational learning: recurring challenges identified through coaching inform new training, and effective training helps franchise owners and their teams execute consistently.


Key Responsibilities

-Franchise Coaching

  • Build trusted relationships with an assigned portfolio of franchise owners and serve as their primary coaching contact.
  • Develop practical action plans with clear goals, owners, and follow-up dates; coach franchisees through implementation.
  • Guide owners in applying brand standards and approved practices across sales, staffing, customer service, and daily operations.
  • Connect franchisees with marketing, technical, and other specialists when their needs require additional expertise.
  • Deliver targeted workshops, webinars, and coaching sessions for franchise owners, managers, and their teams.

-LMS Administration and Learning Development

  • Administer the LMS, including user access, course organization, learning assignments, completion tracking, and routine learner support.
  • Help build and maintain role-based learning paths for priority audiences, including technicians, customer service representatives, managers, franchise owners, and coaches.
  • Work with CoE leadership and subject matter experts to turn approved procedures, technical information, and operational playbooks into practical learning materials.
  • Create and update courses, short instructional videos, job aids, quizzes, and assessments using consistent templates and available authoring tools.
  • Coordinate subject matter review and approval before publishing technical or operational content.
  • Track participation, completion, assessment results, and learner feedback to identify where training needs improvement.
  • Coordinate platform issues requiring technical support with the LMS vendor or appropriate internal resources.

-Knowledge Base and Center of Excellence Contribution

  • Help build and maintain the Global Knowledge Base as an organized, searchable source of approved operational guidance.
  • Establish consistent content categories, naming conventions, version control, and review schedules with CoE leadership.
  • Convert recurring franchise questions and successful field practices into reusable articles, FAQs, checklists, and playbooks.

  • Support selected field trials and rollouts by preparing instructions, training materials, and feedback surveys.

title: Senior Product Manager - Integrations
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

The opportunity

Location: Madrid - we will only consider candidates already based in Madrid or open to relocation.

Fever is growing through acquisition as well as organically - we expect to bring more companies into the Fever family over the next few years. Each one arrives with its own product, its own codebase, and its own way of doing things. This role exists to make sure that growth actually compounds instead of creating fragmentation: someone who can walk into an acquired company's stack, understand what's genuinely differentiated versus redundant, and drive the decisions that turn "two products" into "one better product."

Fever already operates at global scale, and acquisitions are how we grow even faster. Every company that joins makes the whole group stronger: together, we’re far more than the sum of our parts.

Every company that joins brings talented teams, strong products and deep expertise in its market. The opportunity is to connect them on one Fever platform, so that what one company builds can power all the others, and every new company gets the scale of Fever from its first day with us.

That’s what this role is about. You’ll shape how the Fever group scales as a platform: the vision and architecture for the capabilities our companies share, the playbook that helps every new company get up and running with Fever, and the hands-on work of making each integration a success. You’ll work across products, markets and teams spanning the whole group, close to the leadership decisions that shape where Fever goes next.

It’s a senior individual contributor role.

About the role

  • Define the product vision and strategy for the Fever group platform: decide which capabilities (payments, invoicing, seating maps, access control, box office, point of sale and more) should become shared group services, and work with engineering to productize them so any group company can integrate.
  • Own the integration playbook: the standard, prioritized path every acquired company follows to run on Fever’s shared services.
  • Assess each acquisition feature by feature, produce a keep / kill / merge plan, and shape integration decisions with engineering leads on APIs, data models and migration.
  • Run partner and customer migrations end to end, coordinating BD, account management, operations and support.
  • Be the bridge between acquired teams and Fever’s product and engineering org in the first 6–12 months, and report integration progress to leadership.

About you

Basic skills and qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or similar, 5+ years in product management (ideally platform or technical products), and professional English.
  • Deep technical fluency: comfortable with architecture, APIs and data models, and with trade-offs like consolidation, migration and build vs. reuse.
  • Proven experience building a shared-services strategy and leading post-M&A or platform integration, including keep / kill / merge calls.
  • Strong program management in ambiguous, cross-team settings with legacy systems.
  • Clear communicator and analytical thinker, with high ownership and urgency.

Preferred skills and qualifications

    • PM experience in a company that grew through acquisitions, ideally including M&A due diligence.
    • Domain knowledge in ticketing, live entertainment or commerce (payments, access control, box office, seating).
    • Prior hands-on experience as a backend or platform engineer.
    • Track record of earning trust with acquired teams and managing change.
    • Experience defining integration metrics and mentoring other PMs.

Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
  • Stock options.
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Home office friendly
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
  • English Lessons
  • Gympass Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

The incumbent will serve as a Veterans Service Representative (Authorizer) at a VA Regional Office. Identify training needs and obtain tools to develop, implement, and manage programs that promote a patient-centered culture. Ensure programs also address employee needs that support sustaining a patient-centered environment. Program Planning - (20%) Engage fully with leadership and staff to promote shared ownership of the Patient Experience across the healthcare system.- Assist committees and program offices in developing and managing patient experience-supportive programs. Support management in planning, organizing, developing, directing, and evaluating operations related to Patient Experience. Report and document routine summaries of patient and family concerns to inform improvement strategies and service recovery efforts. title: Government Information Specialist
description:
VA Hudson Valley is looking to fill the position of a Government Information Specialist at it's Montrose or Castle Point and must travel to both campuses as needed. The position provides comprehensive support in the execution, oversight, and continuous advancement of Privacy Act, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability ACT (HIPAA), Privacy, and Records Management operations across VA Hudson Valley Health Care System (VAHVHCS).

The position functions as a critical extension of the Privacy/FOIA Program, contributing to the planning, coordination, and administration of all program components. The work supports the implementation of statutory and regulatory requirements, including the Privacy Act, FOIA, HIPAA, and Title 38 confidentiality statues, ensuring the organization's compliance with federal law, VA policy, and VHA directives. This includes active participation in the development of policies, safeguards, and internal processes that maintain consistency, mitigate privacy risks, and strengthen information governance practices across all service lines. The duties of the position may include but, are not limited to: The role involves supporting facility-level determinations on disclosures, redactions, denials, release authorizations, and records management requirements, ensuring that decisions are well-informed, defensible, and aligned with federal guidance and agency precedent. Central to the position is the Responsible for collaborating and engaging frequently with internal stakeholders and external partners. This includes working with Veteran Service Organizations, Congressional offices, community leaders, attorneys, affiliate academic institutions, commercial organizations, and members of the public. Assists in advancing strategic initiatives that strengthen the Health Care System's control of sensitive information. This includes contributing to the development, revision, and maintenance of local privacy practices; reviewing and recommending improvements to business workflows including but not limited to data disclosure workflow, consent and authorization, privacy investigation and breach response and FOIA and record management workflow; and promoting the adoption of sound data governance practices across clinical, administrative, and operational settings. Maintaining program sustainability. Supports internal and external communication strategies designed to enhance awareness, reinforce compliance expectations, and promote a strong culture of privacy within the organization. Provides technical and analytical assistance in areas involving data governance, partnering with senior leadership, law enforcement, the Office of Chief Counsel, VISN leadership, and VHA program offices to resolve complex issues. Contributes to the analysis of intricate policy questions involving the collection, use, disclosure, and protection of information throughout the facility. Advanced legal and regulatory research, including review of federal and state laws, case law, and decisions by oversight bodies. Provides support for privacy investigation responsibilities, assisting in the planning, coordination, and execution of investigative activities tied to the organization's data governance goals. Collaborates with the Office of Chief Counsel, Human Resources, executive leadership, and labor partners is essential for reviewing complex cases involving the mishandling, unauthorized disclosure, or impermissible access of sensitive information. Supports evidence collection, case analysis, briefings, and the development of recommended actions for leadership when violations occur. Supports incident response functions, including documentation and remediation activities for impermissible access, unauthorized disclosures, and breaches involving PHI or PII. Designing and delivering training, providing targeted guidance to service areas that exhibit compliance deficiencies, and supporting staff education regarding legal and regulatory requirements governing information handling, access, and disclosure. Performs assessments of privacy related risks associated with business activities that involve the processing of personal and sensitive data. Independently investigates privacy related noncompliance matters occurring within the organization and involving external partners when VHA information may be affected. Contributes to the development and execution of strategic management initiatives that strengthen the facility's control of information and ensure consistency across service lines. Identifies policy gaps, assessing staff knowledge, and supporting program improvements as privacy and FOIA requirements evolve. Assists in training employees on general data protection principles and service specific privacy practices essential to their daily responsibilities. title: Area Vice President, ANZ
description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

The Area Vice President (AVP), ANZ will lead Commvault’s growth across Australia and New Zealand. You will be accountable for driving accelerated revenue, positioning Commvault’s SaaS, cloud-native, and cybersecurity solutions as the trusted choice for enterprises, and building a high-performing, digitally fluent sales organisation.

This role requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution - a leader who can shape the regional go-to-market strategy, drive disciplined sales performance, and embed a culture of coaching, accountability, and continuous development across the team.

How you will make an impact:

  • Accelerate Commvault’s growth across ANZ by acquiring new customers and expanding strategic enterprise accounts.

  • Position Commvault as the partner of choice for cyber resilience, SaaS data protection, and secure, cloud-native and multi-cloud environments.

  • Develop frontline sales leadership, creating a culture of accountability, deal inspection, and continuous improvement.

  • Strengthen and expand Commvault’s partner ecosystem across ANZ, enabling hyperscalers, MSPs, GSIs, and regional channels to drive joint success.

  • Champion digital-first and AI-enabled approaches to selling, including data-driven pipeline management, customer engagement, and forecasting.

  • Act as a visible and credible leader in the ANZ market, engaging senior stakeholders and representing Commvault across key customers, partners, and industry forums as a trusted voice who consistently demonstrates integrity and builds lasting professional relationships.

What you will bring:

  • 15+ years of enterprise technology leadership, with at least 7 years in cybersecurity, data resilience, or cloud security, and a proven record of growth in the ANZ market.

  • Demonstrated success in building, leading, and scaling high-performing sales organisations, with a strong track record in coaching and developing leaders and teams.

  • Deep experience in SaaS, cloud-native, and multi-cloud environments, with strong understanding of digital transformation trends and enterprise architectures.

  • Strong technical and commercial acumen across cybersecurity, data protection, and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Proven ability to embed structured sales methodologies (e.g. MEDDPICC) and drive consistent, disciplined execution at scale.

  • Experience leading through partners and ecosystems, including hyperscalers, MSSPs, GSIs, and regional channels within ANZ.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Toast has grown to be a leading hospitality software company in the US and is now setting its sights on our next stages of growth. As the business continues to grow, there is increased demand to enhance the enterprise level of support in the product. Toast customers who managed several restaurants a few years ago are now expanding their business and adding new locations. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is looking for a Software engineer to join our enterprise Away team. You will get to work across the entire Toast platform, including the partner ecosystem. As a member of the enterprise team, you will help ensure that the product is being built to meet the new and expanding needs of these customers.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and deliver features in Toast’s enterprise management products
  • Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
  • Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success
  • Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features
  • Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast
  • Work with experienced engineers to deliver design and code review

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, or front ends
  • Comfortable working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin
  • Experience building complex web applications with React is a plus
  • Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
  • Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
  • Experience delivering high quality, reliable services to production
  • Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at .

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more:

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: Navigator
description:

Position: Navigator

Division: Education and Career Services

Department: Career Counseling

Supervised by: Program Manager

Position Overview:

The Navigator will be responsible for the operation and coordination of the OIC of WA Resource Room reception station. The Navigator will create a trusting relationship with all who enter the Resource Room and assist with addressing barriers clients may be experiencing. This position will serve as a liaison between the public and OIC of WA’s programs and services. The Program Specialist (Navigator) will be responsible for the initial assessment of the client’s household needs. This role will involve the use of a helpdesk computer system. This position will also be responsible for processing inbound calls and greeting “walk-in” clients.   • Must maintain a high level of confidentiality and possess strong ethics.
  • Must be meticulous and can spend long periods of time reviewing eligibility documents.
  • Able to demonstrate a genuine concern and respect for all cultures and diverse populations served by OIC.


Work Environment:

The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be considered to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Frequently required to stand, walk, and sit. Frequently required to talk and hear. Successfully pass a Criminal History & Background Check. Successfully pass a pre-employment drug test. Valid WA State Driver’s License and proof of insurance if requested.

title: R&D Programs & Operations Lead
description:
About ROLLER

ROLLER isn't your average SaaS company. We operate globally across 30+ countries, powering millions of real-world experiences in the leisure and attractions industry. What we build doesn't just live on a screen. It shows up in busy venues, peak weekends, and unforgettable moments for guests.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: help operators run better businesses while creating great guest experiences. That means solving complex, real-world problems across ticketing, point of sale, self-service, memberships, kiosks, and digital waivers, all at meaningful scale.

Just as importantly, it's the people. We're a team of 300+ smart, grounded, and genuinely passionate humans working across the globe. We care about quality, ownership, and doing work we're proud of, without taking ourselves too seriously.

We're growing fast, aiming high, and building something that matters. If you want to work on real problems, with real customers, alongside people who care deeply about their craft and impact, ROLLER is a great place to do it.

About the Role

Are you ready to be the driving force behind operational excellence? Join us as our R&D Programs & Operations Lead, where you'll be the wheel that keeps our department rolling smoothly. Reporting directly to our Chief Product Officer and partnering closely with our VP of Engineering, you'll be responsible for fine-tuning how we operate as a department and in unison with other departments. You'll take the operational load off our leaders, from planning cycles and all-hands meetings to cross-team communication, so they can focus on building great products and great teams.

Your main goal? To ensure the Product department runs like a well-oiled machine, with processes that are both efficient and effective, laying the groundwork for operational success.

In this role, you'll be the maestro of departmental cadences, communications, and goal tracking. You'll coordinate strategic initiatives, steering them towards triumphant outcomes by facilitating seamless communication between project owners. Simply put, you'll be the go-to person for anything operational within the department that needs attention.

Leveraging your expertise in program and project management, administration, relationship-building, and storytelling, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams and working groups. Together, we'll aim to achieve the level of operational efficiency, cooperation, and collaboration that our teams need to hit our company and department goals.

This role is required in Sydney to facilitate close collaboration with our Chief Product Officer who is based there.

What You'll Do


Guide Department Operations:

  • Lead operations from start to finish.
  • Establish robust cadences and administrative frameworks.
  • Spearhead tracking initiatives and own annual and quarterly planning end to end.
  • Champion company-wide product development adherence.
  • Design and maintain how Product works: development framework and gates, forum structure, etc.
  • Refine Department strategies as ROLLER expands.
  • Orchestrate and streamline meeting frameworks with clear objectives, purposes, and agendas.
  • Provide continuity and cover for the Chief Product Officer and VP of Engineering, holding context and actions across absences.
  • Continuously enhance the Department's operational rhythm.

Ensure Effective Communication:

  • Manage seamless collaboration among teams and partners.
  • Uphold communication best practices and thorough documentation.
  • Share comprehensive context and promptly address concerns.
  • Own what the business hears from Product and when: roadmap publication, company-wide broadcasts and the narrative that connects the plan to company goals.
  • Support Board and strategic customer communications.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders in other departments and work with them on shared initiatives.
  • Ensure timely escalation to appropriate stakeholders for resolution.

Propel Initiatives Forward:

  • Coordinate and monitor timelines, milestones, and statuses.
  • Flag impediments promptly and keep programs/projects on course.
  • Break down assignments into manageable tasks for trackability and successful delivery.

Serve as the Department's Cohesive Force:

  • Orchestrate Department-wide events and company-wide occasions.
  • Organize and execute celebrations and milestones.
  • Ensure recognition of the Department's hard work, boosting morale and camaraderie.

Forecast and Anticipate Opportunities:

  • Collaborate with Department Leadership and People Business Partners.
  • Anticipate and forecast emerging opportunities.
  • Devise and implement proactive solutions.
  • Continuously scan for areas of improvement, ensuring agility and readiness for success.

About You

  • Proven experience in taking products to market, with a deep understanding of the entire product lifecycle and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure product delivery.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Events, Program, or Project Management, ideally within the dynamic realm of start-ups or scale-up tech environments.
  • Proven experience in Organizational Change Management & Communications, showcasing your ability to navigate and facilitate transitions seamlessly.
  • A track record of effectively prioritizing, managing, and tracking multiple projects concurrently, thriving in the autonomy of a fast-paced, high-growth setting.
  • An innate attention to detail coupled with an unwavering commitment to maintaining the highest standards of excellence in every aspect of your work.
  • Genuine self-motivation, coupled with a relentless drive to continually learn, evolve, and pioneer in a role that is primed for growth and specialization.
  • Exemplary integrity and trustworthiness, paired with the humility and openness to challenge one's own assumptions in pursuit of continuous improvement.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, enabling you to quickly establish rapport and expand internal networks with ease.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence; comfortable operating in uncertain situations where information may be incomplete and priorities can shift rapidly. Your aptitude for bringing clarity to such scenarios will be invaluable in driving success.

We believe AI is a career-defining inflection point. ROLLER is a fast adopter of new technology like AI, and every team member is empowered to own their learning and use the latest tools to supercharge their impact. We're looking for candidates with the proficiency and curiosity to embrace AI and technology - not just as a technical skill, but as a core competency to help us achieve big goals.

Perks!

🚀 You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry - check out Capterra and G2 reviews.

💙 Team member Assistance Program to proactively support our team's health and wellbeing - accecc to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.

🍼 16 weeks Paid Parental Leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental Leave for secondary carers.

💡 Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.

title: Financial Institution Intern (Risk Management)
description:
The Financial Institution Internship (FII) is a one-year paid internship that may lead to a post-graduation employment offer as a Financial Institution Specialist. Financial Institution Interns will be assigned to the Division of Risk Management Supervision (RMS). Internships will begin May 2027. Additional selections may be made from this announcement to fill identical vacancies that arise later.

Interns will be engaged primarily in insured financial institution examinations. Under the direction and supervision of an Examiner or higher graded team member, the incumbent will participate in and/or independently perform the following: Reviews and determines the accuracy of the consolidated Reports of Condition and Income. Assists in evaluating the adequacy of the insured financial institutions procedures and internal routine and controls. Performs audit test checks on income and expense accounts and assists in the preparation of other information requisite to a thorough analysis of the earnings of the institution. Computes capital ratios, reconciles capital accounts, and reviews capital account activity since the previous examination. Assists in the review of liquidity including the analysis of fluctuations in loans, securities, deposits, and borrowings. Participates in other phases of an examination as assigned. Prepares drafts of schedules, exhibits, and comments for inclusion in the completed report of examination. Reviews fixed asset accounts and assists in assessing the adequacy of related insurance coverage; reviews depreciation entries both on the general ledger and for income tax purposes. Assists in reviewing and determining the adequacy of fidelity and other indemnity protection. Program Completion and Conversion Eligibility: Conversion is not automatic nor guaranteed. After successful completion of the program requirements and based on the FDIC's needs, you may be non-competitively converted to the Financial Institution Specialist (Risk Management), CG-570-7 position in the competitive service with promotion potential to the CG-13 grade level. For more information regarding the FII program, visit: Financial Institution Intern Program | FDIC.gov.

title: Senior Director, Power Plant Engineering
description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

The Senior Director of Power Plant Engineering is the senior technical and organizational leader accountable for the technical adequacy, maturity, integration, and execution of the designs produced by the Power Plant Engineering organization. Reporting to the Vice President of Engineering Design, this position holds final design decision authority for the Power Plant Engineering organization.

The position ensures that the organization produces technically sound, mature, coordinated, and executable designs that meet established plant requirements, design criteria, codes and standards, safety objectives, and program commitments. This is a working senior leadership role requiring hands-on technical experience and active engagement. The Senior Director establishes technical direction, assigns clear decision authority within the organization, and ensures that consequential engineering decisions have an adequate technical basis and are made by qualified decision-makers. The Senior Director holds leaders accountable while personally engaging in consequential technical decisions, design reviews, issue resolution, and recovery of critical engineering work when necessary.

Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the Plant Engineering department which includes Reactor Systems, Pebble Handling and Storage Systems, Reactor Coolant Auxiliary Systems, Instrumentation, Control, and Electrical Systems, and the Balance of Plant Systems.
  • Establish technical direction, maintain engineering standards, and ensure consistent execution of high-quality engineering products in accordance with the Design Control Program and systems engineering practices established by Design Assurance.
  • Ensure that system and discipline designs satisfy applicable requirements, codes and standards, safety functions, and are aligned with program objectives.
  • Ensure that design assumptions, margins, uncertainties, limitations, and technical risks are identified, documented, communicated, and appropriately managed.
  • Make or approve technical decisions and accept technical risk within delegated authority.
  • Hold senior technical leaders accountable for the technical quality, maturity, timeliness, and completeness of their organizations’ work.
  • Resolve technical disagreements that cross system or discipline boundaries.
  • Ensure that Power Plant Engineering provides technically complete and timely inputs to plant layout, process design, plant design, design analysis, licensing, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and operations activities.
  • Maintain visibility of significant technical risks, decisions, assumptions, margins, interfaces, and unresolved issues across the organization and ensure they are communicated to affected stakeholders.
  • Ensure the integrity and controlled evolution of the plant design and technical baseline, including appropriate incorporation of approved technical decisions and design changes.
  • Ensure significant technical decisions, design changes, and issue resolutions are appropriately documented, traceable, and incorporated into affected engineering products and requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate technical review and escalation of issues that could materially affect plant safety, licensing basis, design requirements, or overall plant integration.
  • Maintain the technical capability and decision-authority structure necessary to support effective engineering execution across the organization.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S degree in Nuclear Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
  • 20+ years of engineering experience supporting nuclear power generation, nuclear design, analysis, licensing, construction, or plant operations.
  • 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including managing large, multidisciplinary engineering organizations, typically comprising 100 or more employees.
  • Prior experience serving as a Chief Engineer, Design Authority, Engineering Director or comparable senior technical leadership capacity.
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more core engineering disciplines including Mechanical, Civil/Structural, Nuclear, or other disciplines relevant to nuclear power plant design, with working knowledge across major nuclear engineering disciplines/workstreams.
  • Demonstrated experience applying design control, configuration management, and technical baseline management principles within a complex nuclear or similarly regulated engineering environment.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and how they interact with design and operations, quality assurance programs, design control processes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering projects through multiple stages of design maturity and making consequential technical decisions.
  • Demonstrated success holding senior engineering leaders and organizations accountable for technical quality, ownership, and follow-through across multiple geographic locations.
  • Experience with first-of-a-kind technologies or programs involving significant technical uncertainty, evolving requirements, and development organizational capability is desired.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of nuclear power plant design and operation, including nuclear safety principles, safety classification, defense-in-depth, reactor design and analysis, plant operational design (accident and transient response), and radiological design.
  • Knowledge of the functions and interactions of major power plant systems and the relationship between detailed system design and overall plant safety, performance, operability, reliability, maintainability, and constructability.
  • Knowledge of system and discipline design development from conceptual and preliminary design through detailed design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and operation of large complex industrial plants.
  • Knowledge of engineering decision-making, technical authority, design reviews, technical baselines, interface management, design margins, uncertainty management, and risk acceptance.
  • Knowledge of configuration management and engineering change control principles as they apply to maintaining an established plant design and technical baseline.
  • Skill in leading multiple engineering departments, plant system organizations, managers, and senior technical leaders toward common technical and execution objectives.
  • Skill in evaluating plant-level technical tradeoffs involving safety, performance, operability, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and design maturity without compromising established requirements or safety objectives.
  • Skill in evaluating complex system and discipline designs for technical adequacy, maturity, completeness, compliance, and integration.
  • Skill in developing, documenting, and implementing consequential technical decisions using incomplete or evolving information.
  • Skill in assessing, coaching, and developing directors, managers, technical authorities, and senior engineers and in providing direct, actionable performance feedback.
  • Ability to recognize the broader plant implications of decisions originating within an individual system or engineering discipline.

title: Senior Manager, Campaign Operations, UCANZ
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

As the Senior Manager, Campaign Operations, UCANZ, you will be the regional campaign operations leader responsible for planning, orchestrating, and executing Crunchyroll’s integrated marketing campaigns across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

You will sit at the center of campaign strategy, creative development, project management, and channel execution. You will translate UCANZ marketing priorities into clear campaign plans, briefs, workback schedules, asset requirements, and launch plans, ensuring campaigns are scoped, localized, approved, and delivered on time and on budget.

You will serve as a key campaign operations partner to UCANZ Growth and Marketing leadership. You will work closely with Creative Services, Project Management, User Acquisition, Social, Influencer Marketing, Lifecycle, Editorial, Content, Curation & Programming, and the Global Centers of Excellence.

Success requires exceptional organization, creative judgment, clear communication, and strong cross-functional leadership. You will navigate complex workflows, manage competing priorities, and translate regional needs into high-quality campaign execution for fans across UCANZ.

In the role of Senior Manager, Campaign Operations, UCANZ, you will report to the Senior Director, Brand & Community, UCANZ.

We are considering applicants for the locations of Los Angeles or Dallas.

Core Areas of Responsibility

UCANZ CAMPAIGN PLANNING & INTEGRATED EXECUTION

  • Partner with UCANZ teams (Growth, Partnerships, Community, Membership Value, PR, etc) and Partner Relations & Content Marketing teams to translate campaign priorities into integrated plans and actionable workstreams.
  • Develop and manage workback schedules, milestone calendars, dependencies, review cycles, and launch readiness plans across multiple concurrent campaigns.
  • Ensure campaign briefs are complete, cohesive, and aligned to objectives, audiences, title priorities, channels, markets, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate regional and global stakeholders to maintain clarity, accountability, and momentum from kickoff through launch.
  • Anticipate risks, surface decisions, and proactively remove blockers that could affect quality, timing, or budget.

CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT & ASSET OPERATIONS

  • Partner with Creative Services and Project Management to define campaign asset suites across video, static, copy, social, digital, experiential, and other relevant formats.
  • Serve as a strategic and operational resource to Title Marketing and Brand Management during campaign development.
  • Consolidate feedback and coordinate internal, external, brand, creative, and licensor reviews to keep communication clear and efficient.
  • Ensure assets align with the campaign strategy, regional requirements, brand standards, platform specifications, and delivery timelines.
  • Support asset tracking, version control, production status, and final delivery across the campaign lifecycle.

REGIONAL LOCALIZATION & VERSIONING

  • Collect, document and prioritize localization, versioning, market and channel requirements across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
  • Translate regional insights and market needs into clear creative requests and execution plans for global and regional teams.
  • Coordinate approvals and ensure localized assets are accurate, culturally relevant, brand-compliant, and delivered in the required formats.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline regionalization, reduce duplication, and create scalable approaches to campaign adaptation.

CHANNEL & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ORCHESTRATION

  • Partner with User Acquisition, SVOD Marketing, Social, Influencer Marketing, Lifecycle, Editorial, and other channel teams to ensure cohesive full-funnel campaign execution.
  • Align campaign plans with content, product, partnership, promotional, and UCANZ region marketing launches.
  • Coordinate inputs from Content, Curation & Programming, Product, Analytics, Marketing Operations, and other stakeholders as needed.
  • Maintain visibility into channel requirements, dependencies, open decisions, and launch readiness across the UCANZ campaign portfolio.
  • Facilitate weekly campaign check-ins and provide concise updates, action items, and escalation points to regional and global teams.

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

  • Establish and maintain campaign documentation, trackers, status reporting, creative briefs, asset inventories, and shared sources of truth.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to improve workflows, tools, intake processes, review structures, and campaign governance.
  • Identify process gaps and implement practical improvements that increase speed, visibility, quality, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and resource planning to ensure campaign execution remains aligned with approved plans.
  • Develop reusable playbooks, templates, and best practices for UCANZ campaign planning and execution.

PERFORMANCE, REPORTING & LEARNING

  • Track campaign milestones, deliverables, launch readiness, risks, and post-launch follow-up across the regional portfolio.
  • Partner with Analytics and channel teams to organize performance reporting, campaign learnings, and recommendations.
  • Support post-campaign reviews that identify opportunities to improve process, creative effectiveness, localization, and channel execution.
  • Provide clear, executive-ready updates on progress, issues, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Mentor project partners and contribute to a collaborative, high-ownership, and solutions-oriented team culture.
  • Delegate effectively when appropriate while remaining willing to step into detailed execution when needed.
  • Share knowledge, tools, and best practices across UCANZ, Marketing Operations, Creative Services, and global teams.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

  • 8+ years of experience in global campaign operations, integrated marketing, creative production, project management, or brand & title marketing within entertainment, media, technology, gaming, or streaming.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex global campaigns from strategy and briefing through creative development, localization, approvals, and launch.
  • Experience executing campaigns across multiple markets, channels, and time zones, with a strong understanding of international mastering, versioning, and distribution.
  • Experience working with the creative process across video, static, copy, social, digital, and experiential assets.
  • Strong project management skills, including workback schedules, milestone tracking, dependencies, risk management, and cross-functional communication.
  • Experience partnering with Title Marketing, Brand Management, Creative Services, and channel teams such as User Acquisition, Social, Influencer Marketing, and Lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to consolidate feedback, manage ambiguity, prioritize competing needs, and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with distributed teams across multiple cultures and time zones.
  • Strong organizational, written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience with Airtable, Wrike, Asana, Figma, or equivalent creative workflow and project management tools.
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management experience is a plus.
  • Passion for anime, entertainment, streaming, gaming, or fandom-driven brands is highly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

About the Team

The UCANZ Brand & Community team brings together regional marketing leaders and cross-functional partners to turn Crunchyroll’s biggest priorities into integrated, fan-first campaigns across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Working at the intersection of creative, content, growth, and channel teams, the group drives clear, culturally relevant launches that deepen fandom and deliver meaningful business impact.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

  • Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
  • Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
  • Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Health Saving Account HSA program
  • Health care and dependent care FSA
  • 401(k) plan, with employer match
  • Employer paid commuter benefit

  • Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

title: Android Engineer (Fixed-term)
description:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

The EU engineering team in London is looking to hire an Android Engineer to join our team on a 12 month fixed term contract basis. In this role, you will work to strengthen the infrastructure behind our app, used by millions of diners worldwide. You will play a crucial role in improving the foundations of a large Kotlin codebase while shaping the technical roadmap for new data integrations and architecture. By collaborating across teams, you will help build and maintain the Android capabilities that support our marketing technology initiatives, including attribution and deep linking. Ultimately, your work will empower restaurants to thrive by creating reliable, high-performance experiences that encourage diners to return time and again.

Note: This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the technical roadmap of new data integrations, application architecture, and scalability efforts.
  • Enhance the core Android app’s architecture to ensure the codebase remains maintainable, scalable, and modern.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize marketing technology integrations, including attribution SDKs, measurement tools, and deep linking capabilities.
  • Elevate the app’s overall reliability, performance, and testability while simplifying complex areas of the codebase.
  • Leverage data and diagnostics to identify potential issues, validate technical improvements, and optimize both end-user and developer experiences.
  • Share technical knowledge and help shape best engineering practices across multiple squads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining scalable, modern, and high-performing Android applications.
  • Proven track record of improving the architecture of an established Android app.
  • Strong proficiency in writing maintainable Kotlin code with a deep value for testing, reliability, and performance.
  • Hands-on experience working with mobile analytics or attribution integrations, such as Firebase or attribution SDKs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, marketing, and data stakeholders, explaining technical decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across Android applications and the backend services that support them, including server-side Java.
  • Passion for enhancing developer experience, infrastructure, and internal tooling.
  • Familiarity with creating and contributing to shared Android infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated appetite for continually refining the end-user experience through data-driven insights.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the Role

G-P is seeking a senior, highly diligent Employment Counsel for APAC to provide strategic, high-quality legal guidance and operational oversight on complex employment matters across the Asia-Pacific region. Reporting to the Employment Counsel APAC Director this role requires a proactive legal professional with exceptional work ethic, strong independent judgment, and a commitment to operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in owning outcomes, demonstrates a true willingness to go the extra mile during high-stakes regional initiatives, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative, global environment.

What you will do

  • Strategic Employment Advice: Provide high-quality legal oversight and strategic guidance on critical employment matters, regulatory compliance, and workforce management throughout the APAC region.
  • Dispute Resolution & Risk Management: Develop creative, business-sensitive approaches to managing legal risks and oversee employment-related disputes and litigation using in-house and outside counsel resources.
  • Proactive Stakeholder Support & Engagement: Partner closely with Global Operations and People Team to ensure prompt, thorough, and high-touch legal follow-through on regional employee relations matters.
  • Scale: Effectively work with a growing and geographically dispersed team within the region fostering a culture of high performance, resilience, and mutual accountability.
  • Process & Template Standardization: Partner cross-functionally to build scalable, compliant processes, employment contracts, and regional handbook templates.
  • In-House Training & Knowledge Sharing: Own, develop, and deliver practical in-house legal training sessions for internal business units and operational teams.
  • Regional Legal Tracking: Maintain deep, current knowledge of national and local labor laws across key APAC jurisdictions.
  • Project Execution: Coordinate, drive, and take end-to-end ownership of cross-functional employment legal projects through to completion.

What we're looking for

Minimum requirements

  • Legal Qualification: Qualified to practice law in Malaysia, Philippines, or another major Common Law jurisdiction within APAC.
  • Experience: 8+ years of combined employment law experience, including solid law firm practice and at least 2 years of in-house legal experience within a fast-paced multinational employer
  • Work Ethic & Professional Diligence: Demonstrated track record as a highly diligent, dependable, and hardworking self-starter who consistently goes above and beyond to meet critical team SLAs and business objectives.
  • Resilience & Professional Agility: Excellent emotional intelligence, grace under pressure, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset when handling last-minute business requests or urgent escalations.
  • Legal & Business Acumen: Impeccable legal judgment, strong creative problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance legal risk with commercial imperatives.
  • Communication & Languages: Superior written and verbal communication skills in English. Professional working proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia, Mandarin, or another regional APAC language is a strong advantage.
  • Relationship Management: Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build trust, form strong working relationships internationally, and influence cross-functional business units effectively.

Preferred requirements:

  • Domain expertise: Experience working in global EOR/tech platform or Broader HR Tech

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

Benefits

title: Seven Research Spring Camp - Undergrad Student
description:
Seven Research Spring Camp – March 12-13, SoHo, NYC

Seven Research invites exceptional STEM students to our New York office for an immersive exploration of quantitative research, advanced technology, and modern financial systems. This program is designed for students who are early in their exposure to quantitative finance. Over the course of the program, participants will learn about mathematical and financial concepts central to quantitative research, the fundamentals of electronic trading systems, and the research, testing, and validation processes that power our unique, systematic approaches. The experience includes interactive technical sessions, hands-on problem-solving activities, and 1:1 conversations with leaders across our teams. Participation may qualify students for an accelerated process for future internship and full-time roles.

Program Details

  • Program Dates: March 12-13, 2027
  • Location: Seven Research, SoHo, New York City
  • Travel, meals, and lodging: Fully covered
  • Arrival/Departure: Arrive by the evening of March 12 and depart by the morning of March 14. The main sessions are on March 13 with optional activities on the evening of March 12.

What to Expect

  • Tech Talks on quantitative concepts, machine learning applications, and demonstrations of how research and engineering teams design, test, and iterate on ideas
  • Collaborative Challenges mirroring real research tasks, including pattern identification, model reasoning, and structured puzzle-solving
  • Conversations with Team Members about research methodologies, problem-solving strategies, AI-driven tooling, careers paths in quantitative research, and interview preparation
  • Community-Building Events including a team dinner, games, and dynamic group activities

Who Should Apply

  • Full-time Bachelor’s students in computationally rigorous fields such as computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, and physics
  • Graduating in 2028, 2029, or 2030
  • Strong quantitative and/or programming background
  • Interest in applying technology to analytical, real-world challenges

Application Details

  • Deadline: December 17, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (applications reviewed on a rolling basis)
  • Materials: Resume, transcript, and a written response (up to 300 words)
  • Next Steps: Selected applicants will take part in a brief, non-technical call with our Recruiting team
  • Decisions: All invitations will be sent by January 31, 2027

Applicant Privacy

Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice for information about how we handle candidate information.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of our application or interview process, please contact careers@sevenresearch.com. We’ll work with you to support your participation.

title: Project Manager
description:
About us:

We are inspired Placemakers who enhance the built environment with a focus on brand and culture. Across multiple studios, Elements provides a comprehensive portfolio of products and services for the interior built environment. We combine our interiors expertise with construction capability and the collaborative, cross-functional process of human-centered design. This holistic approach to the built environment creates a seamless experience and exceptional results for our clients.


This position is with our studio, Slate: A premier commercial Steelcase furniture dealer. We are a dynamic, high-performing team that thrives in a collaborative environment, committed to crafting inviting and memorable spaces that reflect our clients' visions and foster long-term customer loyalty. We celebrate creativity and innovation, ensuring that every project not only meets but exceeds expectations.


Elements Core Values:

we before me | stay curious | know your impact | bring it | own your craft | enjoy the ride


About the role:

As a Project Manager in our Slate studio in Fort Collins, you will lead commercial furniture installation projects from concept to completion, with a focus on technical excellence, client satisfaction, and successful project delivery. Serving as a primary point of contact for delivery and installation, this role manages timelines, budgets, and communication across customers, internal teams, installers, subcontractors, and other project partners.

This is a hands-on role that balances on-site coordination with project planning and oversight. Managing multiple projects at different stages requires the ability to navigate competing priorities and proactively address challenges to keep work on schedule and within budget. The role plays a key part in bringing each project across the finish line, delivering quality work and a client experience that builds lasting relationships.


What you’ll do:

  • Own commercial furniture project lifecycles from purchase order through closeout, ensuring scope, deliverables, and key milestones align with customer expectations.
  • Develop project plans and coordinate procurement and installation logistics, including resource allocation, labor estimates and quotes, shipment arrival dates, installation schedules, pre-installation meetings, site readiness, and delivery requirements.
  • Oversee installation execution and quality through site visits and punch walks, providing direction to internal and external teams, and ensuring work meets project specifications and quality standards.
  • Manage subcontractor relationships, including obtaining quotes, issuing POs, coordinating schedules, inspecting work, and identifying opportunities to improve installation performance.
  • Oversee project labor budgets and financial tracking, monitoring costs, assessing risks, and identifying opportunities to control expenses and maintain profitability.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers and project stakeholders, including GCs, Owner’s Representatives, A&D firms, end users, and internal teams, providing timely communication and proactively resolving issues.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and weekly status updates, including vendor arrival dates, outstanding issues, photos, action items, and weekly reports using tools such as PlanGrid and Bluebeam.
  • Lead project closeout activities, including resolution of outstanding items, invoicing and closeout documentation, lessons learned, and process improvements.

title: Front Office Supervisor
description:
Are you ready to apply your expertise to a rewarding career with a leader in the hospitality industry? Join the DelMonte Hotel Group team! We are currently seeking experienced and driven candidates just like you to serve as a Front Desk Supervisor.

You will play a key role to ensure a great guest and colleague experience. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, a tight-knit and supportive work environment, plus numerous opportunities for professional development and advancement. Become part of our family and see why so many of our associates have made DelMonte Hotel Group their career home. Contact us today – we’re waiting to hear from you!

Job Responsibilities

As a Front Desk Supervisor, you will assist in the supervision of associates in the Front Office Department and carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include assisting with hiring and training associates; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining associates; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Your specific duties in this role will include:
• Greet, register, and assign rooms to guests.
• Answer telephone.
• Post charges (i.e. room, food, telephone), compute bill, collect payment, and make change for guests.
• Make and confirm reservations.
• Monitor room availability.
• Block rooms.
• Program wake-up calls.
• Handle guest mail and messages.
• Perform check-out services.
• Open and close shifts making cash drops as necessary.
• Maintain market stock and coffee area as needed.
• Assist in ensuring proper cash and key control procedures are followed.
• Assist in maintaining proper shift coverage including covering meal breaks and call offs.
• Schedule shuttle runs and provide safe transportation to all guests as needed (hotels with shuttle only).
• Provide guests with information pertaining to available services and hours of the hotel, i.e. restaurant, pool, lounge.
• Provide guests with directions and information regarding the local area.
• Assist in ensuring effective departmental communication through logs, daily stand up meetings and monthly department meetings.
• Assist in the training of all Front Office staff, i.e. position training, brand training, food safety training (if applicable)
• Assist in ensuring food quality, sanitation and proper food handling standards are being met (if applicable).
• Perform various administrative tasks supporting management, i.e. room forecasting, processing of guest billing issues, recordkeeping of service trends, cash drawer/deposit reconciliation, accurate inventory of supplies, processing department payroll and handling any accounting and purchasing functions
• Maintain up to date records and files.
• Provide information pertaining to hours and available services of the hotel, i.e. restaurant, lounge, room service.
• Ensure the cleanliness of the Front office, lobby and surrounding areas.
• Assist in checking all fixtures, equipment and conditions (lights, music, heating/cooling, furniture, wallpaper, etc.) for proper operations, settings and maintenance. Report deficiencies.

Job Requirements

We are looking for a self-motivated Front Desk Supervisor with a strong work ethic and a drive to exceed expectations. It is also important that you have excellent communication skills.

Specific qualifications for the role include:

• 6 months to 1 year related experience; One year college or technical school; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Solid organizational, time-management and prioritization skills
• Exceptional customer service skills
• Maintain a valid Driver’s License from the state which you reside with no major violations


Benefits

As a Front Desk Supervisor with DelMonte Hotel Group, you will be part of a hospitality leader that prides itself on cultivating a workplace that feels like home and that brings out the best in you, each and every day. It’s the kind of company where many of our associates come for a job, but stay for a career—the kind of place where your strengths will be appreciated, and where each of us can truly be ourselves.

Your hard work and professional dedication will be rewarded with excellent compensation packages, which may vary somewhat depending on location.

• Compensation: $17.00 - $17.25
• Comprehensive benefit packages for full-time positions
• Hotel room discounts at our locations around the globe
• Discounts on food and beverages
• Professional development and advancement opportunities
