title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

Job Description: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer

Location

India (Pune / Bangalore / Remote India)

Reports To

Snr. Director of AI and Data, Enterprise Data Services (UK)

Level

Individual Contributor (3-4 years experience)

Team

Enterprise Data Services — AI Engineering

Contract

Permanent, Full-Time

HRFs   

BTF27272, BTF27273

About the Team

Enterprise Data Services (EDS) is Bottomline's AI Engineering function. We don't build AI as a side tool — we build AI-native solutions where intelligence IS the product. Our platform runs on Snowflake, and we use Snowflake's native AI capabilities (Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, ML Functions) to solve business problems directly in the data platform, no external ML infrastructure, no separate serving layer, no handoffs between teams.

We currently ship: churn prediction agents, contract intelligence, partner reporting automation, a governance control plane, and much more. Everything runs in Snowflake. Everything is versioned, tested, and production-governed.

The Role

We're looking for an Forward-Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) who can take a business problem and solve it natively in Snowflake — from feature engineering through model training to deployment as a live service. This is not a platform-building role. You won't be designing schemas or managing pipelines. You'll be the person who turns business questions into working AI solutions that run in production.

What You Will Do

  • Take business problems (e.g. churn risk, propensity to buy, anomaly detection, document intelligence) and design AI solutions using Snowflake-native capabilities
  • Build and evaluate ML models using Snowflake ML Functions, Snowpark ML, and Cortex AI
  • Design and implement Cortex Agents that combine structured data queries with unstructured document intelligence
  • Create evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops) to prove solutions meet success metrics
  • Work with Cortex Analyst semantic views to enable natural language access to business data
  • Build Cortex Search services over unstructured documents (contracts, support tickets, product docs etc.)
  • Collaborate with AI and Data Engineers who handles platform infrastructure, you focus on the science, they handle the plumbing
  • Present findings and recommendations to business stakeholders in plain language
  • Contribute to the AI project lifecycle: framing problems, running spikes, evaluating results, and iterating

Requirements

Must Have

  • 3-4 years experience in data science, machine learning, or applied AI
  • Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy), you think in DataFrames
  • SQL fluency, comfortable writing complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs
  • Experience building classification or regression models and evaluating them rigorously (precision, recall, F1, AUC)
  • Experience with at least one of: NLP, document extraction, recommendation systems, or anomaly detection
  • Comfortable working with messy real-world data — missing values, inconsistent formats, multiple sources
  • Great communications skills and can work directly with stakeholders end to end
  • Can communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders clearly

Strong Preference

  • Snowflake experience (Snowpark Python, Cortex AI functions, ML model registry)
  • Experience with LLMs in production (prompt engineering, RAG architectures, evaluation of generative outputs)
  • Understanding of Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, or Cortex Analyst
  • Experience building evaluation sets and measuring AI quality systematically (not just accuracy, precision/recall tradeoffs, error analysis)
  • Familiarity with feature engineering for tabular business data (customer signals, transaction patterns, contract attributes etc)

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Fintech, B2B payments, or B2B SaaS
  • Familiarity with A/B testing or causal inference methods
  • Experience with Streamlit for rapid prototyping of data apps

Our Tech Stack

  • Snowflake (everything lives here): Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, Snowpark Python, ML Functions, Dynamic Tables
  • Python: pandas, scikit-learn, snowpark-ml, evaluation frameworks
  • Version control: Git, Snowflake stage-based deployment
  • Visualisation: Streamlit in Snowflake, Cortex Code (IDE), PowerBI

Why This Role Is Different

  • AI-native, not AI-assisted: You will build solutions where the AI IS the product, not a feature bolted onto something else
  • No ML infrastructure tax: Everything runs natively in Snowflake — no Docker, no Kubernetes, no model serving endpoints to manage
  • You will have business impact from day one: with a prioritised backlog of Quick Win candidates waiting for someone to build them
  • Direct line to stakeholders: No layers of middle management between you and the business problem.
  • Modern AI engineering practices: Lifecycle-governed (Framing > Spikes > Build > Evaluate > Governance > Adoption), evaluation-driven, with a real governance plane

Your First 90 Days

Days 1-30: Learn

  • Understand the Snowflake platform and Cortex AI capabilities
  • Run through the AI project lifecycle on a small candidate

Days 30-60: Spike

  • Own your first AI candidate from the prioritised backlog
  • Run a timeboxed spikes: build the crudest version that proves positive signal
  • Create your first golden evaluation dataset
  • Present spike findings to the team

Days 60-90: Build

  • Build your spike to production standard with proper evaluation
  • Pass through governance gates
  • Ship your first AI solution to production

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

title: TELECOMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST (Title 32)
description:
THIS IS A NATIONAL GUARD TITLE 32 EXCEPTED SERVICE POSITION. This National Guard position is for a TELECOMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST (Title 32), Position Description Number D1835000 and is part of the OK 137th Special Operations Wing, Oklahoma Air National Guard.

This position is located at an ANG Aviation Wing, Air Support Operations Group (ASOG) Air Support Operations Squadron (ASOS) and Tactical Air Control Party (TACP). The purpose of this position is to design, deploy, install, operate, maintain, modify, and recover various types of communications transmission systems and their components. These systems transfer voice and data information within service component and to outside agencies and services. Incumbent is also responsible for maintaining currency requirements as a Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC)Instructor or Evaluator. Joint Terminal Attack Controllers (JTAC) are the final authority in the sensor to shooter kill chain for U.S. and coalition airborne, ground and naval forces expending ground-to-ground and air-to-ground munitions in close proximity to friendly conventional and special forces. Mission Ready currency requirements for the purposes of training entail performing duty while exposed to a variety of climates and in austere conditions. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILIITIES: Incumbent plans and establishes tactical communications between all echelons of coalition land, sea and air forces to ensure joint air operations are conducted effectively and efficiently throughout the battlefield. Works with multi-service staffs to integrate and adapt existing systems and plans integration of future technologies to meet user requirements. Develops operating procedures to standardize use of voice and data communications equipment and designs training programs to implement those procedures. Develops and refines telecommunication policies, in coordination with outside agencies, which provide user guidelines. Ensures policies and procedures fall within established agency policies and recommends changes to policy when required. Provides technical assistance, guidance and training to users on all current and new equipment. Provides system design and equipment functionality defining user requirements to program managers and contractors (who manufacture tactical military ground-to-air or ground-to-ground telecommunications equipment). Incumbent defines basic and contingent needs as they pertain to the point-to-multi point transmission of targeting data and time critical information. Instructs on all aspects of air support operations encompassing doctrine, theory, formal classroom, and field performance for joint terminal attack control tactics techniques and procedures. Develops instruction and techniques on Close Air Support doctrine, Tactics, Techniques and Procedures to other services. Integrates a synergistic Close Air Support operation function within the land forces scheme of maneuver. Develops, implements and executes all training and evaluation programs by complying with Major Command (MAJCOM), Air National Guard(ANG) and Air Force Instructions to include unit commanders training objectives, combat readiness reports, Joint Terminal Attack Control evaluations and currency requirements on any multi-purpose/bombing range. Analyzes and identifies trends of problems to recommend best corrective action to include procurement of new equipment or changes to staffing and standards. Analyzes costs of life cycle replacement and advises if new technology or equipment would better serve the needs of users. Manages telecommunication programs by forecasting unit and community equipment and technology requirements. Recommends changes to existing equipment authorizations to functional managers at National Guard Bureau (NGB) and active duty. Manages the radio and frequency spectrum for multiband and multiple nets analyzing assigned nets for effectiveness in the transmission of information. The incumbent will operate and configure the protocols and configurations of highly complex analog and digital communications-electronics equipment, to include Top Secret communications equipment providing voice, data and full motion video capabilities. Provides data transmission by operating communications transmission systems, sub-systems and components. Installs, configures and programs multiplex radios (Ultra High Frequency, Satellite Communication and High Performance Waveform) using military and commercial protocols. Develops, establishes and maintains work center training programs. Plans and schedules tasks and training activities for drill status guard members. Oversees and conducts on-the-job training (OJT) for personnel. Ensures mobilization readiness of section personnel and equipment. Assembles cables and connectors to interface with commercial and military transmission systems and sub-systems. Understands and implements proper security principles (Operations Security and Information Security) and reporting procedures for electronic counter measures in a tactical and non-tactical environment.

title: Health Technician (Ophthalmology)
description:
This position serves to support Ophthalmologists in diagnosis, treatment, prevention, follow-up care and patient counseling. They perform a range of standard, but complex, diagnostic procedures, assisting during clinic-based surgical procedures, educating patients and legal representatives, and assisting with the education of medical students and residents.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional At the GS-0640-8 grade level, a Health Technician (Ophthalmology) serves at the Full Performance Level within the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). Technicians at this tier operate with a high degree of independence under the general supervision of an Ophthalmologist or Chief Lead Technician. They are responsible for executing standard but highly complex diagnostic protocols and surgical assistance. Major duties for this position may include (but are not limited to): Checks and performs calibration of technical ophthalmology screening instruments. Obtains patient physical history, to include chief complaint; reason for visit, pertinent signs and symptoms, current medication allergies; past medical history both ocular and general medical history; family history both ocular and general; social history; and review of medications and allergies, including current ocular prescription and nonprescription medications. Accurately tests visual acuity at distance and near with and without correction or with and without pinhole. Measures eyeglass prescription using manual or automated lensometer, recording sphere, cylinder, axis, and prism in both plus and minus cylinder. Performs pupil evaluation recording pupil size, shape, symmetry, reaction to light and accommodation. Performs swinging light test to detect a relative afferent pupillary defect. Performs basic refractometry utilizing an autorefraction or habitual eyeglass prescription in the phoropter. Instills eye medications (drops or ointment, including anesthetic, dye, dilating drops, cycloplegic drops, or antibiotic). Measures intraocular pressure with standard techniques, including Goldmann applanation tonometry. Performs pachymetry to determine corneal thickness and manual keratometry or automated topography to determine corneal curvature. Performs intra-ocular lens calculations using IOL Master or equivalent device. Performs automated visual field testing using various perimetry techniques. Performs external photographs and fundus photography. Performs optical coherence tomography (OCT) of the anterior segment, retina and optic nerve. Performs patient screening and triage of potentially urgent ocular conditions. Assists during clinic-based ophthalmic surgery, including revision of wounds, biopsies of eyelid lesions, cultures of conjunctiva or cornea; reformation of anterior chamber; evacuation of hyphema repositioning of corneal endothelial grafts; intravitreal injections; and laser procedures. Educates patients and legal authorized representatives in eye care, including preoperative and postoperative instructions. Assists in the education and training of medical students, residents and fellows in those facilities with medical school affiliations. Ensures proper cleaning and disinfection, calibration maintenance, backup, annual inventory and ordering of instruments supplies and equipment; obtains quotes as needed; and reports needed to repairs to biomedical engineering. Performs other duties as necessary. Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA). In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: 1. Ability to perform advanced tonometry and pupil evaluation; 2. Ability to perform calculations for selection of intraocular lens; 3. Knowledge of clinic based ophthalmic surgical assisting; 4. Knowledge of eye anatomy and physiology; 5. Knowledge of medication effects and proper instillation in the eye; 6. Knowledge of optics; and 7. Knowledge of proper cleaning and maintenance of clinic equipment. Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 0800-1630 PM EST Recruitment Incentive (Sign-on Bonus): Not authorized Permanent Change of Station (Relocation Assistance): Not authorized Telework: Not available Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Functional Statement #: 62401F Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job. All applicants tentatively selected for VA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with VA. Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959. Must be proficient in written and spoken English. Must pass pre-employment physical evaluation/examination. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP). title: Senior Specialist Cloud Architect
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud DevOps Automation Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in automating infrastructure and application deployment using a variety of tools and platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and cloud services, with a focus on Python programming, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, and Ansible.

How will you make an impact?

  • Infrastructure Automation: Design, implement, and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform and Kubernetes for scalable and reliable infrastructure deployment.
  • Cloud Management: Leverage AWS services to design and manage cloud infrastructure, ensuring high availability, security, and performance.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with development, PS, and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and operation of applications.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure that the infrastructure and deployment processes comply with industry security standards and best practices.

Have you got what it takes?

  • Total 10+ and Programming Experience: 3+ years of development experience in Python.
  • Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration and management.
  • Container deployments experience using helm.
  • Application deployment and configuration using ansible.
  • Managing AWS infrastructure using terraform.
  • In-depth knowledge of AWS services and best practices for cloud architecture and management.

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

title: Venue Manager (Freelance)

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE

Fever is looking for a Venue Manager for the launch of our newest immersive experience in Bangkok, Thailand.

Dopamine Land is a multisensory experience combining media, technology and play in one place. Whether you fancy a day out with the kids or one of our late evening adult-friendly sessions, this interactive museum wants everyone to embrace their inner child and explore all the colorful installations. So, don’t miss out! Take a break from your everyday life and get those dopamine levels up!

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Strong command of English and Thai, both written and verbal, is essential for this role.
  • Act as the primary duty manager and solo operator of the experience.
  • Demonstrate a highly proactive, hands-on, and self-reliant approach to every working day.
  • Demonstrate the ability to coordinate and host live, fast-paced event experiences.
  • Manage the overall organization, planning and operations of set-up and teardown sequences linked to each area.
  • Coordinate with the local producer for the successful execution of the experience to ensure a positive guest satisfaction.
  • Responsible for scheduling and managing all staff through the agency platform and validating employee time sheets. All recommendations for staffing fluctuations should be pro-actively discussed with the Fever producer team and any changes to number of staff need to be approved.
  • Support, onboard, and coordinate backup staff or a direct assistant as needed to ensure continuous operational coverage
  • Promote and maintain the highest standard of customer service through direct, high-energy hosting and guest interaction.
  • Resolve customer complaints, concerns & general needs. Any notable items should be reported to the producer team with anything urgent flagged in a timely manner.
  • Oversight of the stock and cleanliness of all points of the overall experience.
  • Assist in leading Fever training sessions and program development, providing ongoing support as needed for new hires or for regular staff refreshers.
  • Must understand the technical requirements needed to run and service the experience, and be able to troubleshoot, document, and report technical issues if and when they occur.
  • Work with the Fever team regarding all ticketing operations and report on any challenges or roadblocks. Responsible for ticket validation devices and check in process controlling the flow of guests.
  • Create an inviting atmosphere and ensure all staff are interacting with guests and encouraging engagement with staged photo opportunities.
  • Outreach to local groups (local hotels, schools, universities, large companies, etc.) to drum up sales, for additional sales opportunities.
  • Maintain & manage the on site equipment, ensuring all health & safety standards are being followed.
  • In coordination with the Fever Ops team, manage & set up the POS systems located at each point of sale.
  • Communicating with various vendors (security, janitorial, etc.), and landlord or venue owner and their representatives as needed to ensure smooth operations.
  • Guest Recovery communications with patrons.

  • Proactively communicate any challenges, opportunities, and suggestions to the Fever producer team for consideration and/or appropriate action.
  • Undertake any other daily duties required to ensure the smooth, seamless running of the venue.
  • Demonstrate practical use of Excel, Word and Slides for basic administrative tasks.
  • Responsible for completing a daily report, weekly check in calls, and consistent communication with the Fever producer and project management teams.
  • Be comfortable managing local expenses and taking financial responsibility for the day-to-day site budget.

title: Supervisory Transportation Specialist (Division Chief - HAZMAT) (Open to both U.S. Citizens and Federal Employees)
description:
The incumbent in this position serves as the Chief of the Hazardous Materials Division. The incumbent directs and manages the Division, within the Office of Enforcement and Compliance and the primary responsibility is the development, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of the overall goals, objectives, procedures, and methods to improve the safe transportation of motor carriers subject to FMCSA jurisdiction.

As a Supervisory Transportation Specialist (Division Chief - HAZMAT), you will: Provide overall guidance to a staff of specialists with an in-depth and comprehensive knowledge of the motor carrier and hazardous materials industry as well as applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedures. Direct the development and administration of FMCSA policies and guidance to implement safety including development of rulemaking support papers in the event of new legislation. Provide guidance and develops strategies to ensure efficient processes are implemented accurately; to assist the motor carrier and hazardous materials industry; and determine options to supplement enforcement efforts. The ideal candidate has experience applying analytical and evaluative principles and measurement techniques to evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of agency-wide programs; expert knowledge of Federal and State government policies, directives, and other regulatory guidance as it pertains to motor carriers; expert knowledge of the Hazardous Materials Regulations; skill in oral and written communication to provide technical expertise, policy and procedural interpretations on the policies, directives, and other requirements in a clear, concise manner; and ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing complex and technical information to diverse audiences about FMCSA programs.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT: As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance the organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest. SELECTIVE SERVICE: Males born after 12/31/1959 must be registered for the Selective Service. GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CARD: This position involves travel. A government contractor-issued travel card will be issued and must be retained for official business only. SUPERVISORY PROBATIONARY PERIOD: You must complete a one-year supervisory probationary period (unless already completed). BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION: A background security investigation is required for all selected individuals. Appointment will be subject to the applicant's successful completion of the security investigation and favorable adjudication. Failure to meet these requirements will be grounds for termination. PROBATIONARY PERIOD: You must complete a one-year probationary period (unless already completed). TIME-IN-GRADE: Federal applicants must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade in the competitive or excepted service in the executive branch to satisfy time-in-grade restrictions contained in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. DEU REQUIREMENTS: Applicants selected under delegated examining procedures may be required to successfully complete a one-year probationary period (unless already completed).

title: SUPERVISORY PROGRAM MANAGER
description:
You will serve as a SUPERVISORY PRINCIPAL ASSISTANT PROGRAM MANAGER in the PMS 397 Program Office of TEAM SUBMARINE.

You will serve as the lead Acquisition and Business Manager for Columbia class submarines.

You will provide overall direction and guidance for the program organization, administration and civilian personnel.

You will lead all aspects Acquisition Planning, Strategy, contracting and financial budgeting/execution for the COLUMBIA Class Submarine program.

You will use advanced principles, practices and techniques of PPBE, Acquisition and Contracting.

You will utilize the Office of the Secretary of War (OSW) and and Navy organizational structure and skill in interrelationships sufficient to lead and coordinate different complex activities.

You will communicate orally and in writing to prepare presentations, briefings and talks to high-ranking military (through Flag Officer) and civilian (through Senior Executive Service) managers.

You will conduct and document use of a wide range of qualitative and or quantitative methods to assess and improve program effectiveness and to improve complex management processes and systems.

title: Health Information Specialist I
description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a highly collaborative, remote-first team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare. We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. Datavant is a distributed, remote-first team, and we empower Datavanters to shape their working environment in a way that suits their needs.

This is an entry level position responsible for processing all release of information (ROI), specifically medical record requests, in a timely and efficient manner ensuring accuracy and providing customers with the highest quality product and customer service. Associates must at all times safeguard and protect the patient’s right to privacy by ensuring that only authorized individuals have access to the patient’s medical information and that all releases of information are in compliance with the request, authorization, company policy and HIPAA regulations.

You will:

  • Receive and process requests for patient health information in accordance with Company and Facility policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security with all privileged information.
  • Maintain working knowledge of Company and facility software.
  • Adhere to the Company's and Customer facilities Code of Conduct and policies.
  • Inform manager of work, site difficulties, and/or fluctuating volumes.
  • Assist with additional work duties or responsibilities as evident or required.
  • Consistent application of medical privacy regulations to guard against unauthorized disclosure.
  • Responsible for managing patient health records.
  • Responsible for safeguarding patient records and ensuring compliance with HIPAA standards.
  • Prepares new patient charts, gathering documents and information from paper sources and/or electronic health records.
  • Ensures medical records are assembled in standard order and are accurate and complete.
  • Creates digital images of paperwork to be stored in the electronic medical record.
  • Responds to requests for patient records, both within the facility and by external sources, retrieving them and transmitting them appropriately.
  • Answering of inbound/outbound calls.
  • May assist with patient walk-ins.
  • May assist with administrative duties such as handling faxes, opening mail, and data entry.
  • Must meet productivity expectations as outlined at a specific site.
  • May schedules pick-ups.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you will bring to the table:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Ability to commute between locations as needed.
  • Able to work overtime during peak seasons when required.
  • Basic computer proficiency.
  • Comfortable utilizing phones, fax machines, printers, and other general office equipment on a regular basis.
  • Professional verbal and written communication skills in the English language.
  • Detail and quality oriented as it relates to accurate and compliant information for medical records.
  • Strong data entry skills.
  • Must be able to work with minimum supervision responding to changing priorities and role needs.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks.
  • Able to respond to requests in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points if:

  • Experience in a healthcare environment.
  • Previous production/metric-based work experience.
  • In-person customer service experience.
  • Ability to build relationships with on-site clients and customers.
  • Comfortable bringing new ideas, process improvement suggestions, and feedback to internal stakeholders.

description:

Coordinates with interagency working groups, National agencies, DOD agencies, U.S. intelligence agencies, and other commands.

Develops, coordinates, and implements matters of special operations plans, policy, exercises, and strategy as they relate to Special Operations in the Area of Responsibility (AOR).

title: Engineering Technician (Civil)
description:
This is a Direct Hire Authority (DHA) solicitation utilizing the DHA for Certain Personnel of the DoD Workforce to recruit and appoint qualified candidates to positions in the competitive service. About the Position: This Engineering Technician (Civil) position is with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Southwestern Division, Galveston District, Engineering and Construction Division, Construction Branch, Northern Area Port Arthur Resident Office with a duty station location of Port Arthur, TX.

Direct and participate in preparation of preliminary plans and specifications and accompanying data sheets covering dredging operations.

Review plans and specifications from a technical engineering viewpoint for practicability, conformance with existing standards, policies, and feasibility with the available funds.

Maintain a detailed history of the dredging operations and compiles data used to prepare future dredging programs.

Prepare reports, maintains record checks and evaluates contract documents relating to contract performance, modifications, payment estimates, completion, and data necessary for the administration of contracts and the monthly and annual reports.

Assist in the coordination, operation, and maintenance of two different survey systems (land and hydrographic).

Prepare preliminary and final drawings using the CADD system to accompany reports pertaining to inspections of marine accidents, for removal of wrecks and obstructions in the waterways.

Provide technical guidance to 2-4 technicians. Plans, assigns, coordinates and approves the work for technical adequacy and progress.

title: ELL/ENL Specialist
description:
The ELL Specialist provides support to the instructional process by serving as a teacher with specific responsibility for developing English Learner students’ ability to effectively perform courses of study in the English language; supervising students within the classroom and other assigned areas; developing lesson plans and delivering group and individual student instruction within established curriculum guidelines; collaborating with other teachers, other professional staff, and administrators in addressing instructional and/or classroom issues; and responding to a wide range of inquiries from students’ parents or guardians regarding instructional program and student progress.


The ELL Specialist is responsible for coordinating with the Classroom teacher to direct instruction through curriculum implementation, lesson planning, data disaggregation, and classroom management. Additional responsibilities include maintaining compliance with individual student Education Plans, Section 504 Plans, etc. They will ensure operational and functional knowledge of best practices in education, state and federal education law, FERPA and FAPE law, parent relations, behavioral management, documenting and reporting, and process-driven accountability.

title: Information Technology Specialist (Operating Systems)
company: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
description:
This position is in the Department of the Chief Information Technology Officer, Infrastructure and Platform Services Office (IPSO), Infrastructure Services Division, Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). IPSO engineers, delivers, and operates a secure, resilient, and modern technology ecosystem. IPSO provides the foundational infrastructure and platform services that empower the judiciary's mission, drive innovation, and accelerate secure service delivery.

The IT Specialist (Operating Systems) serves as a technical expert for enterprise Windows and Linux server operating systems keeping them secure, stable, and compliant with Judiciary IT policy. As a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) member, the incumbent will cross train on and support other CCOE platforms, including virtualization, virtual desktop, and cloud services. Duties Include: Installing, configuring, and maintaining enterprise server operating systems and systems software. Analyzing systems requirements in response to business requirements, risks, and costs, and recommending solutions aligned with the judiciary's IT architecture and standards. Evaluating, selecting, verifying, and validating the systems software environment, including operating system builds, patches, and upgrades, through formal change management before production deployment. Evaluating, selecting, and installing compilers, assemblers, scripting runtimes, and system utilities. Integrating hardware and software components within the systems environment, including server hardware, storage, firmware, device drivers, and middleware. Monitoring and fine-tuning performance of the systems environment through capacity analysis, resource tuning, and Tier 3 troubleshooting of operating system failures. Ensuring information security is integral to the operating environment by applying judiciary IT security policies, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication 800-53 controls, secure configuration baselines (e.g., Center for Internet Security (CIS) Benchmarks), Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIG), patch management, and vulnerability remediation. Evaluating new systems engineering technologies and their effect on the operating environment and supporting judiciary IT modernization and cloud migration initiatives. Cross-training on, and providing operational support for, other CCOE platforms, including virtualization, private cloud, virtual desktop infrastructure, and public cloud service provider environments, as mission needs require. Participating in incident response, on-call rotation, and continuity of operations activities to sustain court operations; maintaining standard operating procedures and technical documentation; and mentoring other engineers.

title: Supervisory Security Specialist

title: Management Analyst
description:

description:

title: Psychology Technician
description:
About the Position: This position is located at Eisenhower Army Medical Center, Fort Gordon, GA. Serves as Psychology Technician with the Defense Health Agency - providing individualized and group direct and indirect patient care to clients that are primarily active-duty military Soldiers and other eligible personnel, and consultation. This is a Direct Hire Solicitation

Provide paraprofessional and technical assistance to licensed mental health providers to support direct patient care and clinical operations.

Conduct structured clinical interviews, standardized assessments, and symptom inventories under provider direction to gather diagnostic data and inform treatment planning.

Work with military service members presenting with complex clinical needs to support therapeutic engagement and continuity of care.

Facilitate psychoeducational and skills-based groups (stress management, coping strategies, sleep hygiene) and therapeutic activities aligned with individualized treatment plans.

Monitor patient progress, documents mental observations, and reports concerns promptly to supervising providers. Supports crisis intervention efforts through suicide risk monitoring, safety checks, and de-escalation techniques.

Function as a provider extender under supervision by carrying a patient caseload as clinic census allows.

Co-facilitate therapeutic groups with credentialed practitioners to reinforce treatment goals.

Administer and score psychological assessments under the supervision of a clinical psychologist to support diagnostic clarification, treatment planning, and evaluation of intellectual, cognitive, and emotional functioning.

Support intensive outpatient and partial hospitalization programs by assisting with patient orientation, psychoeducational sessions, and therapeutic programming.

Provide structured activities and therapeutic engagement for complex, high-risk patients requiring higher levels of care.

Conduct daily assessments of suicidal and homicidal risk and identifies appropriate interventions with support from licensed clinicians.

Manage specialized data systems (e.g., Psychology Data System) to ensure accurate entry, retrieval, and reconciliation of psychological testing and clinical documentation.

title: Assistant Housing Management Specialist
description:

The purpose of this position is to assist in managing a network of temporary lodging hospitality houses known as the Air Force Fisher House (AFFH) Program. The incumbent is responsible for assisting the Program Manager (PM) in overseeing the AFFH program and ensuring the program is executed in accordance with applicable regulatory laws and policies. Assists PM in developing policies, procedures, and any applicable changes or deviations, governing the operations and maintenance of Air Force Fisher Houses. title: Asset & Logistics Specialist
description:
Asset & Logistics Specialist works closely with engineering, construction, facilities, finance, legal, supply chain and site operations to ensure technical equipment and services are commercially sound, delivered when required and accurately managed throughout their lifecycle.

The Team

The Asset & Logistics team supports Data Center Engineering by coordinating the procurement, movement, management and lifecycle of equipment required to build, commission, operate and maintain data-center and laboratory environments.

Working closely with technical and operational teams, the team helps ensure equipment is available when needed, supplier and logistics issues are resolved effectively, asset information is accurate and purchasing activities support infrastructure delivery.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead day-to-day sourcing and purchasing activities for data-center and laboratory equipment, infrastructure, technical services and facility requirements.
  • Translate engineering specifications, bills of materials, construction schedules and operational requirements into clear purchasing and supplier activities.
  • Review supplier quotations, technical scopes, pricing, lead times, warranties, delivery requirements and commercial risks.
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions, warranties, service commitments and other commercial terms within agreed parameters.
  • Coordinate supplier onboarding, compliance reviews, confidentiality agreements, internal approvals, purchase orders and supporting contract documentation.
  • Implement sourcing and purchasing plans that support project schedules, local site requirements and supplier availability.
  • Identify and resolve supplier issues that could affect cost, equipment availability, construction schedules, commissioning or site readiness.
  • Lead and support the Asset & Logistics team, setting clear priorities, coordinating workloads and helping team members deliver effectively.
  • Oversee equipment receipt, identification, storage, installation, commissioning, transfer, maintenance and retirement.
  • Coordinate freight, receiving, rigging, storage, delivery scheduling and domestic and international movement of equipment.
  • Maintain accurate asset records covering equipment location, ownership, serial numbers, purchase orders, warranties, service agreements and operating status.
  • Coordinate equipment delivery and installation activities with suppliers, construction partners, commissioning teams and site personnel.
  • Resolve delayed, damaged, incomplete or incorrectly delivered equipment issues.
  • Reconcile purchase orders, invoices, change orders, payments, budget commitments and remaining balances, working with relevant teams to resolve discrepancies.
  • Partner with engineering, finance, legal, facilities, construction, supply chain and accounts payable teams to resolve commercial and operational issues.
  • Produce clear reporting and dashboards covering purchasing activity, asset status, delivery performance, supplier risk, financial commitments and infrastructure readiness.
  • Communicate risks, mitigation actions, decisions and resource requirements to relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify and implement practical improvements to procurement, asset management, logistics and reporting processes.

Candidate Profile

Essential

  • Significant experience in technical procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, asset operations, logistics or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Data-center experience, with a good understanding of construction, commissioning and operational requirements and relevant electrical, cooling, rack and facility infrastructure.
  • Experience leading a team or coordinating the work of others within procurement, asset management or logistics.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation experience, including supplier pricing, payment terms, warranties, service commitments and delivery conditions.
  • Ability to interpret technical requirements, equipment specifications, bills of materials, construction schedules and commissioning requirements.
  • Experience managing supplier performance and resolving commercial, delivery and operational issues.
  • Good financial and analytical capability, including experience reconciling purchase orders, invoices, budgets, payment records and capital commitments.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across engineering, finance, legal, facilities, construction, supply chain and other stakeholder groups.
  • Experience developing reporting or dashboards covering procurement activity, financial commitments, asset status, supplier performance and delivery risk.
  • Strong judgement, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with purchasing systems, financial platforms, asset databases, spreadsheets, workflow tools and reporting applications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain, business, construction, operations, finance or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Desirable

  • Master’s degree in engineering, supply chain, business administration, construction, operations, finance or a related field.
  • Experience sourcing electrical, cooling, mechanical, controls, rack, hardware or commissioning requirements for data-center environments.
  • Experience coordinating international freight, equipment storage, rigging, site delivery, installation and commissioning.
  • Knowledge of capital-expenditure controls, statements of work, change orders, asset governance, warranties and supplier-performance measurement.
  • Experience improving procurement, asset management or logistics processes across multiple locations.

title: Supervisory Audiologist
description:
This position is located in the Audiology and Speech Pathology Service at VA Pittsburgh Healthcare System. This position serves as a Supervisory Advanced Practice Audiologist with duties and responsibilities carried out throughout all clinical and other patient care areas involved with the Audiology section of the Audiology and Speech Pathology Service, including University Drive and HJ Heinz Divisions as well as VA Pittsburgh's Community Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs).

The work location of the Supervisory Audiologist position will be based on geographical location, near the Pittsburgh VA Health System's Community-Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs). In carrying out the clinical duties and responsibilities of the position, the incumbent: Uses a wide range of knowledge of, and skill in applying, a wide range of theories, principles, and methodologies in the practice of audiology to a wide range of populations Develops coherent treatment strategies Maintains knowledge of clinical services and the ability to perform them independently Conducts assessments, provides treatment interventions Provides consultation to other health care professionals In carrying out the supervisory and administrative duties and responsibilities of the position, the incumbent: Develops, organizes, directs, manages, supervises, controls, and implements policies and procedures for the Audiology section of ASP in conjunction with another Audiology Supervisor. Plans, assesses, and evaluates Audiology programs/functions to ensure proper coordination between care delivery within the section and the overall delivery of health care. Makes decisions that affect staff and other resources associated with the section with wide latitude of control and independent judgment. Plans and schedules work assignments of Audiology staff; accepts, amends or rejects completed work; assures that clinical productivity and quality requirements are met; appraises performance and recommends performance standards and ratings; assigns delineated clinical privileges; approves leave; effects disciplinary measures. Sets priorities, delegates tasks, meets multiple deadlines, analyzes organizational problems, and develops and implements effective solutions. Analyzes and uses data effectively to manage workload, quality, performance, access, and productivity within the section. Skillfully executes interpersonal communications and fosters positive working relationships in dealing with employees, team leaders, and managers. Utilizes evidence-based practices and clinical practice guidelines in Audiology and guides Audiology providers in applying these tools. Analyzes organizational and operational problems and develops and implements solutions that result in efficient section operation. Skillfully executes problem solving tasks and conflict resolution. Verifies supervisees meet national and agency standards for OSHA and JCAHO. Ensures that work areas are clean and free of safety hazards. Responds per hospital policy to fire drills, codes and emergency preparedness situations. Incumbent assures that all OWCP forms are accurately completed, in a timely manner, in accordance with the Human Resources Management Service (HMRS) guidelines. Always enforces confidentiality of patient and employee's information. Ensures immediate action is taken to correct any breach of confidentiality. Enforces disposal of sensitive data following applicable regulations. Follows applicable informed consent, HIPAA rules on privacy and protecting patient rights. Incumbent enforces respect, equal treatment, and equal service for all persons, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, origin, disability or reprisal. In carrying out the educational duties and responsibilities of the position the incumbent: Participates in the professional development of colleagues through mentorship and teaching. Demonstrates leadership in defining and attending to professional practice issues. Keeps current with theory and practice through continuing education programs, journals, textbooks, and other literature. Provides orientation/training of medical staff Orients and trains new Audiology staff Assists in the training and supervision of students, trainees, externs and fellows, providing feedback on progress toward established educational goals In carrying out the administrative duties and responsibilities of the position the incumbent: Participates in developing guidelines and protocols, new patient programs, and evaluation of existing programs Complies with Advanced Access scheduling procedures as specified in VHA Directive 1230. Maintains patient records and other data required by the clinic, service, and medical center Maintains, supplies, equipment and clinical areas to optimize safety and efficiency May be requested to serve on service-level committees or task forces or to represent to service/section on medical center, network, or national committees Follows applicable informed consent, HIPAA rules on privacy and protecting patient rights Work Schedule: M-F 7:30am-4:00pm Compressed/Flexible: Not Authorized Telework: Not Authorized Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Functional Statement #: GS-065-13 Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

title: Director of Facilities - Typhoon Texas Austin
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Facilities is responsible for overseeing the safe and efficient operations of rides, pools, buildings, and infrastructure. This role leads the facilities team in preventive maintenance, repairs, and compliance with all safety and regulatory standards. The Director owns the facilities operating and capital budgets, approves contractor agreements, and develops the Maintenance Manager while ensuring daily readiness of the park for guests. They serve as a strategic partner for park leadership, balancing cost efficiency with reliability and uptime..


Position Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day operations of the facilities department, ensuring safety and efficiency.
  • Oversee compliance checklists, safety standards, and regulatory requirements (OSHA, ADA, Fire Code, Health Dept., etc.).
  • Ensure compliance with state amusement ride inspection and insurance requirements, Health Department pool permits and inspections, and all regulatory audits.
  • Manage inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, and emergency response protocols.
  • Set and approve the preventive maintenance program and work-order system, and hold managers accountable for its execution.
  • Develop and maintain emergency and disaster preparedness plans for the facilities department, including severe weather, power loss, and chemical or equipment emergencies.
  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of pool, ride, and building systems, including pumps, motors, valves, and filters.
  • Supervise building, plumbing, HVAC, Food & Beverage equipment, and general maintenance tasks.
  • Recruit, train, coach, schedule, and enforce policies while promoting a safety culture.
  • Lead, develop, and evaluate the Maintenance Manager; build succession plans and develop team members into future leaders.
  • Develop, own, and manage the facilities operating and capital budgets, track expenses, and maintain accurate records of inventories and work orders.
  • Build and maintain a long-range capital plan for asset repair and replacement, prepare capital requests, and lead off-season rehabilitation projects.
  • Coordinate facility projects with contractors, vendors, and departmental leadership.
  • Negotiate, approve, and manage vendor and contractor agreements, ensuring work meets cost, quality, schedule, and contract expectations.
  • Collaborate with all departments to support guest experience, resolve issues, and provide input for strategic planning.
  • Perform all duties in a manner that reflects and models the Pyek Core Values of Hardworking, Self-Aware, Can-Do Mentality, Unoffendable, and Kind.
  • Other duties as designated by the General Manager, Vice-President(s), and/or President.

This Scheduling Operations Officer position is located at Richmond International Airport (RIC), Transportation Security Administration, Department of Homeland Security (DHS). title: Software Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit .

In 2024, Yext acquired Hearsay Systems, bringing together two industry leaders to form one unified organization. By combining Yext’s brand visibility expertise with Hearsay’s best-in-class compliant engagement solutions, we’re delivering even greater value to our customers. Our integrated approach unlocks a deeper set of data, insights, and recommendations — empowering brands to convert prospects into customers faster and more effectively.

This is a hybrid position, offering the flexibility of remote telework with the requirement to be on-site at least one day per week on average. Occasional adjustments may be made based on team needs or project demands.

At Yext, Product Engineering builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We’re looking for software engineers who want to solve meaningful technical problems, contribute to systems at scale, and help shape what we build next.

We work in an agile environment with two-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. From day one, you’ll contribute directly to the codebase and collaborate with experienced engineers from a wide range of leading universities and technology companies.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join Team Artemis, which builds and maintains key features of Yext's Social products. The team owns systems that help businesses create, manage, and distribute social media content at scale, including content libraries, campaign management, post scheduling, and publishing workflows. The team also works on AI-powered content creation, helping customers simplify and automate their social media activities.

As part of Artemis, you'll work on a mix of customer-facing features and the backend services that power them, from building intuitive user experiences to developing scalable systems that process and distribute content. You'll have opportunities to work across the full stack, solve interesting technical challenges, and build reliable solutions used by businesses to manage their social media presence.

This role is based in our Budapest office, where in-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We’re looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least one day per week. At the same time, we don’t prescribe specific in-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration.

What You’ll Do

  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing operation
  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and deployment of highly scalable and reliable systems
  • Develop storage systems, libraries, and frameworks
  • Proactively contribute ideas for new features and identify opportunities to improve our products, systems, and engineering practices
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across engineering and with partners throughout the company
  • Write clean, tested, and well-documented code
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate engineering work, explore solutions, improve code quality, and reduce repetitive tasks
  • Critically evaluate, test, and validate AI-generated output rather than treating it as inherently correct
  • Maintain ownership of all work produced with AI assistance, including its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with our engineering standards

What You Have

  • A bachelor's degree (BSc) or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • A strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Fluency with Java, C++, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go)
  • Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment
  • The ability to evaluate technical solutions critically, including code and recommendations produced by AI tools
  • Experience using—or a demonstrated interest in learning—AI-assisted development tools as part of a responsible engineering workflow
  • Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools

title: Service Ambassador
description:
Sarab Lounge | The St. Regis Doha
Located within the iconic setting of The St. Regis Doha, Sarab Lounge is a distinguished destination where timeless elegance meets contemporary luxury. Renowned for its opulent ambiance, bespoke service, and sophisticated culinary offerings, Sarab provides an exceptional experience for discerning guests seeking refined social gatherings, indulgent afternoon moments, and memorable evenings. Reflecting the legendary St. Regis tradition of luxury hospitality, Sarab Lounge delivers unparalleled service, exquisite attention to detail, and an atmosphere of effortless sophistication
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

title: Director, Education & Events
description:
Overview

The Personal Care Products Council (PCPC) seeks a strategic, hands-on director of education and events to lead its educational programming, deliver exceptional live and virtual events, and grow sponsorship, exhibition, and other non-dues revenue. This leader will build the processes, partnerships, and infrastructure that strengthen PCPC’s events portfolio and support long-term growth and member value.

Educational Strategy

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive 12-month educational plan that includes virtual, hybrid, and in-person programming.

  • Identify emerging topics, regulatory developments, and scientific advances that offer opportunities for timely, high-value programming.
  • Establish feedback and measurement tools to evaluate programming, track outcomes, and guide improvements.
  • Ensure educational offerings remain accessible, inclusive, and consistent with PCPC’s brand and mission.
  • Build relationships with speakers, facilitators, and content contributors to expand programming quality and reach.

Live & Virtual Event Management

  • Lead planning and execution for PCPC’s Annual Meeting, Science Symposium, and Legal & Regulatory Conference, from site selection through post-event reporting.
  • Manage venue contracts, contractor agreements, banquet event orders, and event logistics.
  • Select and manage vendors for audiovisual services, production, livestreaming, transportation, and other event needs; obtain competitive bids and negotiate agreements.
  • Establish staff responsibilities, timelines, communications, and budget updates for each event.
  • Direct on-site operations and resolve issues during live and hybrid events.
  • Collaborate with the president and CEO and executive assistant on in-person board meetings.
  • Partner with IT to select and optimize registration platforms, virtual event tools, mobile apps, and survey technology.
  • Create engaging virtual and hybrid experiences that meet PCPC’s production and brand standards.
  • Evaluate emerging event technology, formats, and audience engagement practices.

Financial Management

  • Develop and manage event budgets, monitor performance against projections, and adjust plans as needed.
  • Collaborate with the EVP, marketing team, and CFO to establish attendee pricing strategies.
  • Prepare complete financial and operational close-out reports for the EVP and CFO following each event.

Sponsorship, Exhibits & Revenue Growth

  • Develop tiered sponsorship packages and exhibition opportunities for PCPC’s signature events.
  • Identify new sponsorship categories, partnership models, and revenue opportunities to grow the live event business.
  • Cultivate and manage sponsor relationships across all three signature events, demonstrating return on investment and alignment with PCPC’s mission.
  • Create valuable sponsor experiences through programming, networking, and visibility opportunities.
  • Establish annual sponsorship and exhibit revenue targets, track pipeline activity, close rates, and renewals.
  • Partner with membership and marketing teams to strengthen sponsor engagement and PCPC’s broader member community.

Leadership & Strategic Operations

  • Manage and develop the manager of education while building a collaborative, accountable team culture.
  • Create standardized event processes, guidelines, and playbooks to improve consistency, reduce risk, and support growth.
  • Align education and event activities with PCPC’s strategic goals and business objectives.
  • Represent PCPC at external meetings and industry forums and serve as a spokesperson when requested.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

description:
About Man Group

Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Headquartered in London, we manage $253.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at www.man.com

At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants here.

* As at 30 June 2026

The Team

Our Global Macro is the business unit responsible for global macro strategies across all asset classes. The team trade all markets, from liquid to alternative universe, with strategies spanning multiple holding periods.

This role sits within the Systematic Global Trend And Volatility sector. This role's research mission is to model the behaviour of global macro assets and identify alpha signals, with a particular focus on understanding and modelling what drives trends in macro assets and the timing of this style.

The Role

You will conduct original alpha research on global macro assets, building and testing predictive signals that inform live trading strategies. You will work across the full research lifecycle — from hypothesis generation and statistical modelling through to implementation and ongoing performance analysis — with direct exposure to live strategy management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and develop alpha signals across global macro asset classes, with a focus on trend timing and directional strategies
  • Model the dynamics of macro assets (rates, FX, equities, commodities) to identify exploitable patterns
  • Design and evaluate predictive signals using rigorous statistical and quantitative methods
  • Contribute to portfolio construction and risk analysis across the sector's strategies
  • Monitor live strategy performance and translate observations back into research hypotheses
  • Collaborate with researchers across AHL Global Macro and contribute to the broader research agenda

Background and education:

  • Minimum 2 years buy side experience within a systematic environment (essential)
  • 2+ years of experience researching alpha signals across macro assets (essential)
  • Solid grounding in statistical and mathematical modelling; able to choose the right tool for the right problem
  • Strong Python skills; comfortable working with large financial datasets
  • Understanding of portfolio construction and risk analysis
  • Familiarity with transaction costs and their impact on signal design is a plus
  • Strong academic record with a degree in a quantitative discipline — Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering or Economics from a leading university; a PhD or Masters is advantageous
  • Intellectually curious with a genuine interest in financial markets and the macro forces that move them
  • Hands-on and rigorous: you enjoy following an idea all the way from intuition to tested, implemented signal
  • Self-organised with the ability to manage multiple research threads in parallel
  • Clear communicator: able to present quantitative findings concisely and engage constructively with alternative views
  • Collaborative; comfortable working closely with researchers, technologists and portfolio managers

Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. We are hiring a Solutions Architect to join our Customer Success team and support strategic customers across APAC.
This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role for someone with strong Kubernetes, SRE and DevOps experience. You will work alongside Technical Account Managers and Client Partners, becoming the escalation point when a customer conversation requires deeper technical expertise, stronger architecture guidance or support with a complex production issue.
You will work directly with customers to understand their Kubernetes environment, diagnose technical challenges, guide them towards the right Cast AI solution and help them realise more value from the platform. You will also identify and support expansion opportunities, including positioning Omni where it can solve a meaningful customer problem.
This is not a traditional post-sales support role. You need to be comfortable in front of senior technical stakeholders, able to explain complex Kubernetes topics clearly and willing to travel to customer sites when needed.
The role covers APAC.

Requirements:

  • Six to twelve years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Solutions Engineering or a similar role.
  • Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience. You need to understand how clusters, workloads, networking, scaling and resource management operate in production.
  • Meaningful prior experience as an SRE or DevOps Engineer. This is essential. Candidates without a real operational background are unlikely to succeed in the technical interview or the role.
  • Experience troubleshooting production incidents, including diagnosing root cause, resolving the issue and implementing improvements afterwards.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and modern cloud-native tooling.
  • Able to communicate technical concepts in a logical, clear and customer-friendly way.
  • Comfortable speaking with engineering leaders, platform teams, SREs, DevOps teams and senior technical stakeholders.
  • Interested in a customer-facing role, whether you already work with customers or want to move from a deeply technical role into one.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, less structured environment where ownership and initiative matter.
  • Willing to travel to customer locations for a few days per month.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point for strategic and complex customer conversations.
  • Partner with Technical Account Managers on customer onboarding, adoption, technical risk and platform value.
  • Work with Client Partners to identify and support expansion opportunities within existing customers.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to understand their Kubernetes architecture, workloads, operational challenges and priorities.
  • Advise customers on Kubernetes reliability, efficiency, scaling and platform best practices.
  • Help customers diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving Kubernetes clusters, workloads, resource management, networking or platform reliability.
  • Represent Cast AI in customer meetings, technical workshops and occasional on-site visits across APAC.
  • Support the commercial adoption of Omni by connecting product capabilities to genuine customer needs.
  • Share recurring customer feedback, technical blockers and product opportunities with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work closely with a team of SREs and cloud infrastructure specialists within Customer Success.

What’s in it for you?

  • Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.
  • Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology.
  • Equity options.
  • Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.
  • Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.
  • Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.
  • Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.
  • Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.
  • Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Hiring process

  • Screening call with Recruiter
  • Hiring Manager interview
  • 1-2 additional interviews based on the role
  • Culture Check interview with an executive

*As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.
*Please note that Cast AI does not provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.
